title: Account Manager, FSI-Fintech, Account Manager, FSI-Fintech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  
  
Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world-class candidates to join our–FSI Fintech business.  
  
As a Fintech Account Leader for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase adoption, and market penetration in large Fintech accounts to build long-term business and marketing opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess a business development/sales background that enables them to engage at all levels of a customer and partner organization, including C-levels of the business and Tech. You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a coverage plan business objectives. This is a high visibility role needing to engage CXOs of Fintechs as well as leverage internal executives to drive transformational outcomes for large Fintechs in the long term.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop long-term strategic relationships with the C-levels of Business & Tech for the given Accounts.
* Work closely with the Channels team to ensure that AWS India is the partner's preferred cloud computing platform across all service lines.
* Maintain an accurate forecast and various business reports.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS Cloud Offerings and AI offerings
* Possess the technical ability to explain (not implement) Cloud Computing, GenAI and Agentic AI, Infrastructure solutions (Server, Storage, DC Services) & Internet architectures (firewalls, load balancers, etc)
* Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
* Ensure customer satisfaction

  
A day in the life  
Research on the FSI Fintech domain and preparation for the day’s customers meetings and calls. Collaborate with Cross functional teams on pitches and solution demos for,  
  
Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls  
Stakeholder mapping  
Ensure high standards and maintain SFDC hygiene  
Ensure timely communication with External and Internal stakeholders  
  
About the team  
This team is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from enterprise-level FSI customers. The team interacts with leading FSI and Fintech companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or IaaS/SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience
* Bachelor's degree or above
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of positioning cloud technology to CXOs in assigned region experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.  
  
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience
* Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 2+ years of scripting language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud computing such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Engineer - Target India
description:
**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

As an engineer, you serve as a technical specialist delivering the engineering that powers the product. You develop keen insight into the technical architecture and design to deliver robust and scalable software components. You constantly demonstrate the depth of your expertise by solving engineering problems. You are passionate about the quality of software and balance between speed of delivering new features and robustness of the software components you implement. You can handle operational issues with little or no oversight. You actively review code to ensure the software quality and functional accuracy is maintained across the team. You are keen to learn the design and architecture of the product and participate in ceremonies that can influence both.

Use your skills, experience and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals. As an engineer, you’ll take the lead as you…  
Use your technology acumen to provide input to assist with evaluation of new technologies and contribute to the design, lifecycle management, and total cost of ownership of services. Contribute to research and proof-of-concept initiatives for new technologies and assist with code review and design review, writes, organizes and maintains code based on designs. With guidance, delivers high-performance, scalable, repeatable, and secure deliverables. Participate in structured construction, automation, debugging, and implementation activities, ensuring architectural and operational requirements and best practices are met. Participate in disaster recovery planning and disaster recovery activities and participate in functional integration and regression testing and ability to automate test scripts. Resolve frequently encountered technical issues and monitors systems capacity with minimal assistance. Search and understand metadata about various data sources and metrics. Adhere to change and incident management standards and expectations.

Core responsibilities are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

What We're Looking For

* **2-4 years of software development experience** building web applications, APIs, or distributed systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a passion for software engineering.
* Experience working in Agile teams and contributing to the successful delivery of business features.
* Self-driven individual with a strong sense of accountability and a willingness to take ownership of assigned work.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Eagerness to build scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
* Continuous learning mindset with a curiosity for emerging technologies and engineering best practices.

* **Cloud Platforms** (Exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure)

title: Ingénieur(e) En Gestion De Données ML
description:
**Faites Carrière Avec Nous**
-----------------------------

### **À propos de l'opportunité**

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne expérimentée pour le poste d'**Architecte Cloud Hybride** à **Montréal**. Dans ce rôle hybride, vous concevrez, mettrez en œuvre et superviserez des solutions infonuagiques sécurisées, évolutives et rentables, principalement sur **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**, avec une possible implication sur **GCP** et **Microsoft Azure**. Vous dirigerez des initiatives d'architecture, établirez des bonnes pratiques, soutiendrez la modernisation des applications et favoriserez l'automatisation des infrastructures, tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, la sécurité et la conformité.

### **Ce que vous ferez**

* Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des zones d'atterrissage, des stratégies multi-comptes et des architectures réseau sur AWS
* Créer et gérer des VPC, sous-réseaux, UDR et VPC Peering dans des environnements HCP
* Provisionner l'infrastructure via des outils IaC tels que **Terraform** et **CloudFormation**
* Développer des fonctions **Lambda** pour automatiser les tâches opérationnelles
* Mettre en place des pipelines **GitOps et CI/CD** pour le déploiement d'infrastructure
* Gérer des charges de travail **Kubernetes** via **AKS** et **EKS**
* Assurer la gestion des correctifs, des sauvegardes et de l'**IAM**
* Surveiller les environnements cloud avec **CloudWatch**, **Prometheus** et **Grafana**
* Optimiser les coûts cloud selon les pratiques **FinOps**
* Intégrer des approches basées sur l'**IA** pour faire progresser les capacités Cloud Hybride

### **Ce que vous apportez**

* **8 à 15 ans** d'expérience en TI, dont au moins **5 ans** sur AWS
* Solide expérience en conception réseau et développement sur AWS
* Maîtrise d'**Ansible, Python et AWS CLI**
* Connaissance des services **PaaS** (RDS, SageMaker) et de l'administration **Linux**
* Expérience avec les processus **ITIL** et la gestion des changements
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration interfonctionnelle
* Expérience en mentorat et gestion des parties prenantes

**Grow With Us**
----------------

### **About the Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced **Hybrid Cloud Architect** to join our team in **Montreal** in a hybrid capacity. You will design, implement, and govern secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions primarily on **AWS**, with potential involvement across **GCP** and **Microsoft Azure**. You will lead architecture initiatives, establish best practices, support application modernization, and drive automation — all while ensuring operational excellence, security, and compliance.

### **What You Will Do**

* Design and implement landing zones, multi-account strategies, and network architectures on AWS
* Create and manage VPCs, Subnets, UDRs, and VPC Peering within HCP networks
* Provision cloud infrastructure using IaC tools such as **Terraform** and **CloudFormation**
* Write **Lambda functions** to automate operational tasks
* Implement **GitOps and CI/CD pipelines** for infrastructure deployment
* Manage **Kubernetes** workloads using **AKS** and **EKS**
* Perform patching, backup management, and **IAM** administration
* Monitor environments using **CloudWatch**, **Prometheus**, and **Grafana**
* Optimize cloud spending using **FinOps** best practices
* Apply **AI-driven approaches** to advance Hybrid Cloud capabilities

### **What You Will Bring**

* **8–15 years** of IT experience, with at least **5 years** hands-on with AWS
* Strong background in AWS design, development, and networking
* Proficiency with **Ansible, Python, and AWS CLI**
* Knowledge of **PaaS services** (RDS, SageMaker) and **Linux OS** administration
* Familiarity with **ITIL processes** and change management

**Pourquoi se joindre à Ericsson?**

Chez Ericsson, vous aurez une occasion exceptionnelle. La chance d'utiliser vos compétences et votre imagination pour repousser les limites de ce qui est possible. Trouver des solutions inédites à certains des problèmes les plus difficiles du monde. Vous serez mis au défi, mais vous ne serez pas seul. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe d'innovateurs diversifiés, tous déterminés à aller au-delà du statu quo pour créer l’avenir.

**Que se passe-t-il une fois que vous avez présenté votre demande?**  
Cliquez ici pour trouver tout ce que vous devez savoir sur notre processus d'embauche typique.

Ericsson utilise une approche d'embauche fondée sur le mérite, qui valorise les personnes ayant des expériences, des perspectives et des compétences différentes. Nous croyons sincèrement que cette approche stimule l'innovation, essentielle à notre croissance future. Nous encourageons les gens de tous horizons à postuler et à réaliser leur plein potentiel au sein de notre équipe Ericsson. Ericsson est fier d'être un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances, en savoir plus.

Si vous avez besoin d'aide ou si vous souhaitez demander une mesure d'adaptation en raison d'un handicap, veuillez communiquer avec Ericsson au hr.direct.americas@ericsson.com.

Puisque ce rôle nécessite d'interagir avec d’autres entités d’Ericsson à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des collègues et intervenant.es dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.

**AVIS DE NON-RESPONSABILITÉ :** Les énoncés ci-dessus visent à décrire la nature générale et le niveau de travail effectué par les employés occupant ce poste. Il ne s'agit pas d'une liste exhaustive de toutes les responsabilités, fonctions et compétences requises pour ce poste, et vous pourriez être amené à effectuer des tâches supplémentaires selon les tâches.

À l'heure actuelle, Ericsson Canada Inc. n'offre pas d'aide à l'immigration ni de parrainage pour ce poste, que ce soit maintenant ou à l'avenir.

**Pays et ville principaux :** Canada (CA), Montreal (Country/ City)

**Détails du poste :** ICT Engineer

**Rémunération et avantages sociaux chez Ericsson**

Chez Ericsson, nous savons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès. Nous offrons un forfait compétitif pour répondre à vos besoins et objectifs individuels.

**Votre salaire**

Le salaire offert dépend de divers facteurs, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, l'emplacement, la combinaison de connaissances liées à l'emploi, les qualifications, les compétences, l'éducation, la formation et l'expérience du candidat.

Votre paie comprend également la possibilité d'une prime annuelle. Les primes réelles sont basées sur le rendement de l'entreprise par rapport aux objectifs de l'unité, au rendement individuel et à la cible de primes individuelles. Certaines règles d'admissibilité et de calcul au prorata s'appliquent.

Ericsson offre d'excellents avantages en santé, incluant le choix de 3 options de régime médical et dentaire qui permettent à un employé de choisir le niveau de couverture qui correspond à ses besoins. La couverture de base est entièrement financée par Ericsson.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Web App
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Stryker is one of the world's leading medical technology companies and, together with our customers, is driven to make healthcare better. We offer innovative products and services in Orthopedics, Medical and Surgical,

Neurotechnology and Spine that help improve patient and hospital outcomes.

**Who you are:**

As part of Mako and Enabling Technologies, our pre-operative clinical applications team provides high quality software to ease and improve the pre-operative flow of surgeries, as well as ensuring the link with core technology from products across Stryker including surgical robotics, image guided interventions, mixed reality solutions and patient specific implants.

We are looking for an ambitious and self-motivated Senior Front-End Engineer to design and develop rich, high-quality user interfaces for our clinical web applications. You will work closely with backend engineers building our micro-services ecosystem to deliver seamless, intuitive and reliable experiences for surgeons and clinical staff. You will have the flexibility and communication skills to operate effectively with other teams across Stryker.

**What you will do:**

* Design, develop and validate front-end applications and components, from proof of concept to product, in alignment with requirements and architecture defined,
* Be involved in technical choices definition for the UI layer, in collaboration with peers,
* Contribute to design tradeoff decisions while developing components of the system,
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers working on our micro-services ecosystem (Python/FastAPI, Rust/Axum, .NET) to define clean, efficient API contracts and integration patterns,
* Establish a working relationship with product, UX and other engineering groups across the organization to successfully implement business and clinical requirements while applying the latest available tools and technology,
* Work in collaboration with the DevOps team to ensure proper build, test and deployment of front-end solutions,
* Ensure on-schedule delivery of high-quality, accessible and performant user interfaces that meet technical and clinical requirements,
* Understand clinical workflows to enhance product usability and user experience.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering/ Computer Science or related discipline & 10+ years of work experience
* 4+ years of work experience in front-end / web development, with a strong focus on modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems,
* Strong experience with React (production-grade); experience with Vue.js or Angular is also valued,
* Experience with TypeScript, component architecture and testing practices (unit and end-to-end),
* Experience designing and consuming REST/JSON APIs; comfortable working alongside micro-services built in Python, Rust and/or .NET,
* Experience with cloud services either on AWS or Azure would be appreciated,  
  Knowledge of agile software principles and software development life cycle in a domain with strong regulatory constraints,
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English,
* Experience in web-based development using WASM or similar technologies would be appreciated,
* Experience in WebGL or data visualization libraries would be appreciated,
* Experience in medical software development would be appreciated.

  
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Software Development Engineer, IN Amazon Business
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you excited by the challenge of launching new business initiatives for Amazon in India?  
India Consumer Technology (ICT) team builds products and services that solve unique customer needs in Amazon’s fastest growing marketplace. We are a multi-billion dollar business with a huge potential to grow in a trillion dollar market. Our engineers own the complete consumer and seller experience for Amazon India, work on a wide range of technologies (including AWS and EC2) and build and operate highly scalable, low latency mobile first products and services. We are solving Know Your Customer(KYC), last mile engineering challenges around Mobile, Product Discovery, Delivery, Payments, Logistics, Customer experience, Seller experience and more.  
As a Software Engineer within Amazon India Business team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and deploying solutions to help Amazon significantly expand its selection and drive improved customer experience by enabling a new fulfillment pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a team that will be responsible for building a successful, sustainable and strategic business for Amazon, from the ground up!  
If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of millions of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today! You will work with Principal/Senior Engineers in the team to evolve the design and architecture of the products owned by this team. You will be responsible to set up and hold a high software quality bar besides providing technical direction to a highly technical team of Software Engineers.  
As part of this team you will work to ensure Amazon.in is FAST and has the best shopping experience. It’s a great opportunity to develop and enhance experiences for Mobile devices first. You will be working on a work on a wide range of technologies including AWS EC2, SQS, Amazon WW platforms, ElastcicSearch, Big Data, Machine Learning, Android, iOS, Amazon Horizonte, JavaScript, React JS to create unique experiences for India retail customers.
  
You will work on analyzing the latency across the various Amazon.in pages using RedShift, MapReduce, Java, Elastic Search and Machine Learning. You will get the opportunity to code on almost all key pages on retail website building features and improving business metrics. You will also contribute reducing latency for customers by reducing the bytes on wire and adapting the UX based on network bandwidth. You will be part of a team that obsesses about the performance of our customer’s experience and enjoy flexibility to pursue what makes sense. Come enjoy an exploratory and research oriented team of Cowboys working in a fast paced environment, who are always eager to take on big challenges.  
Position Responsibilities:
  

* Work closely with senior engineers to design, implement and deploy applications that impact the Amazon.in business with an emphasis on Mobile, Payments, and e-Commerce website development.
* Own the delivery of an integral piece of a system or application.
* Management and execution against project plans and delivery commitments
* Assist directly and indirectly in the continual hiring and development of technical talent.
* Create and execute appropriate quality plans, project plans, test strategies and processes for development activities in concert with business and project management efforts.

  
Candidate will be a leader, quick learner and be able to work independently. He/she should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. The candidate will need to balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Trellix**
  
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com.

We are looking for a Software Engineer (2+ Years) to join our Customer Digital Experience. In this role, you will help build and improve the applications that power Trellix’s global support network. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, deploy apps to the cloud, and get hands-on exposure to emerging AI tools.

* **Curious:** We maintain a continuous thirst for knowledge to fuel reimagination while staying engaged and caring about the people and technology around us.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement software solutions.

* Knowledge of markup and data serialization formats such as JSON and XML.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and Agile/JIRA workflows.
* Understanding of software development principles and methodologies.
* Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate effectively with other developers and stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB) and caching systems (Redis).
* Familiarity with orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
* Understanding of message queues and event streaming tools (MQTT, Kafka, or RabbitMQ).
Exposure to enterprise file transfer/integration tools like Globalscape.
Familiarity with WPF or AngularJS.  

Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer or GCP Associate).

***Company Benefits and Perks:***

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

***Our Commitment to You:***

title: Mainframe Data Modernization Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**  
  
As a Principal Data Modernization Architect, you will define and own the target-state data architecture for enterprise modernization and cloud transformation programs. You will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, guiding teams and executive stakeholders on legacy database transformation, migration strategies, and enterprise data governance.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Data Modernization Architecture:** Assess legacy data environments (DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM), define target-state architectures, develop modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformation, establish enterprise migration standards/frameworks, and guide target platform selection.
* **Database Transformation Strategy:** Design migration approaches for legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native services; drive database decomposition and domain separation; and govern schema transformation, data model redesign, metadata, data quality, and data integrity.
* **Data Migration & Coexistence:** Architect high-volume, near-zero-downtime migrations and cutovers using migration waves, Change Data Capture (CDC), and real-time synchronization to ensure data consistency during coexistence periods.
* **Data Architecture & Governance:** Establish enterprise data modeling, lineage, traceability, security, compliance, privacy, performance, scalability, backup, and disaster recovery (DR) standards while collaborating with application architects.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural oversight across modernization programs, conduct architecture reviews, approve transformation designs, mentor engineering and migration teams, and advise executive stakeholders on strategic decisions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Extensive experience defining target-state enterprise data architectures and modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformations.
* Deep hands-on expertise assessing and migrating legacy mainframe data platforms, including DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, and VSAM.
* Proven track record designing migrations from legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native databases.
* Strong expertise in database decomposition, data domain separation, schema transformation, and data model redesign.
* Demonstrated experience architecting high-volume, near-zero-downtime data migrations, coexistence architectures, and cutover strategies.
* Practical proficiency implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) and real-time data synchronization mechanisms.
* Solid background establishing enterprise data governance, lineage, metadata management, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience defining non-functional database standards, including performance, scalability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery (DR).  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing enterprise-wide migration patterns, frameworks, and architectural review boards.
* Strong background collaborating with application architects to align data and application modernization strategies.
* Proven leadership mentoring database engineers, migration specialists, and cross-functional modernization teams.
* Ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders on complex modernization recommendations and strategic investments.
* Experience managing data consistency and reconciliation across hybrid source and target environments during multi-wave migrations.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native data ecosystems and multi-cloud database services.
Track record governing large-scale enterprise programs with strict regulatory and data traceability requirements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl:**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important ,you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused , someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless , naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 15+ years in data and database architecture, including 7+ years leading enterprise-scale database migration, modernization, synchronization, and coexistence programs from mainframe environments.
* **Legacy Mainframe Technologies:** Deep expertise in IBM DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM, legacy mainframe data architectures, and mainframe data modeling.
* **Modern Database Platforms:** Strong proficiency across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Cosmos DB), and cloud-native database services.
* **Data Engineering & Migration:** Hands-on experience with data modeling, schema transformation, ETL/ELT design, Change Data Capture (CDC), data synchronization, and data migration frameworks.
* **Data Management & Governance:** Proven background in establishing data quality management and enterprise data governance frameworks.
* **Architecture & Operations:** Expertise in enterprise data architecture, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), database security, performance engineering, and capacity planning.
* **High-Volume Execution:** Demonstrated success designing and delivering high-volume migration solutions and complex cutover plans.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Mainframe Modernization Expertise:** Skilled in hierarchical-to-relational transformation, database decomposition strategies, relational-to-NoSQL architecture decisions, mainframe data encoding/data-type/structure transformation, and EBCDIC-to-ASCII/Unicode conversion.
* **Large-Scale Migration & Coexistence:** Experience executing multi-wave migrations using near-zero-downtime cutover strategies, parallel run/synchronization models, CDC architectures, and data reconciliation/validation frameworks.
* **Modernization Governance:** Background in data lineage, impact analysis, mainframe-to-cloud data coexistence, hybrid data architecture, data domain rationalization, and migration risk assessment/mitigation.
* **Industry & Program Governance:** Experience governing enterprise-wide data architecture and modernization programs in mission-critical industries (banking, insurance, retail, or healthcare).
* **Cloud & AI Tooling:** Hands-on experience with cloud database platforms on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, plus exposure to AI-assisted modernization and automated schema transformation tools.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - GenAI Platforms
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description**

We are Citi’s Core AI Platform Group, a start-up with the exciting mission of shaping the direction of travel for the entire bank under the Chief Operating Office. We define the AI and engineering strategy for the bank. We are a team of talented engineers, product managers, and SMEs, taking ambiguous concepts and making them real by engineering cutting-edge products at planetary scale.

We are solely focused on the most modern technology and engineering disciplines: generative AI, cloud-native architectures, security, modern app stacks, open-source, and the latest and greatest in the Kubernetes ecosystem.

Generative AI is a rapidly evolving space. As a Senior Golang Engineer, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for this domain. We ask that you share with us examples of projects that you have architected and scaled. Ideally, these examples should showcase clever distributed architectures, systematic evaluation of LLM behaviors at scale, and your ability to drive technical consensus across large organizations.

  
  

**Technical Skillset Required:**

9+ Years of Hands-on experience is a must have.

  
  

**Tech Skillsets required for the role**:

Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.

  
  

**You might be a good fit if you:**

* Bring distinguished, deep-dive software engineering expertise and a track record of architectural leadership.
* Thrive in a results-driven environment, where flexibility fuels impact and your technical decisions shape the enterprise.
* Are a game-changer and thought leader, ready to step beyond your designated role to influence the broader engineering culture.
* Love the synergy of pair programming and hands-on coding—you lead from the front and stay close to the codebase.
* Seize the opportunity to architect machine learning and GenAI applications at an unprecedented global scale.
* Possess a relentless passion to push the boundaries of machine learning and generative AI, bringing your knowledge to shape Citi’s future.
  

  

**What you’ll do within the team:**

* **Engineering at scale:** You will build scaled, robust services and platforms centred around generative AI. This may also include developing CLIs, SDKs, runtimes and more.
* **Thought Leadership:** Drive architectural vision and lead the 0-1 build of foundational, enterprise-grade AI platforms and products.
* **System Design:** Design and build high-quality, highly reliable, and secure distributed systems with developer and user experience at the center.
* **Strategic Direction:** Create "firsts" in the Generative AI space for Citi, acting as a core member of the team that defines the strategic technical direction for the entire bank.
* **Scale & Iterate:** Continually iterate and scale Generative AI products to handle massive throughput, whilst anticipating and listening to the complex needs of internal customers.
* **Cross-Org Influence:** You must be able to drive technical alignment across multiple engineering organizations, breaking down silos to deliver cohesive AI capabilities.
  

  

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed In This Role:**

* **Mastery of Modern Stacks:** Expert-level fluency in Golang is a must-have, with deep experience building concurrent, high-throughput systems. (Python is a strong desirable addition).
* **Cloud-Native & Infrastructure:** Deep expertise in the Kubernetes ecosystem, container orchestration, and modern security paradigms (e.g., Gatekeeper, zero-trust).
* **Applied GenAI:** Understanding of language models, fine-tuning methodologies, and RAG architectures, JIT context retrieval strategies will be useful.
* **AI Infrastructure:** Proven experience designing control planes, sandboxing systems for AI experimentation, and managing large-scale vector stores and search algorithms.
* **Data Engineering:** Extensive experience in large-scale ETL development and data pipeline architecture.
* **Security & Governance:** Experience maintaining and/or contributing to bug bounty, responsible disclosure programs, and AI safety/guardrail implementations.
* **Startup Agility:** Experience leading technical initiatives within fast-paced startup environments or driving startup-like agility within a large enterprise.
  

  

**What We Believe In:**

* We do not have boundaries between engineering and research; we expect our technical leaders to bridge the gap and contribute to both.
* We take a product-focused approach and care deeply about building solutions that are robust, scalable, and easy to use.
* We enjoy working in a fast-paced team tackling cutting-edge problems by constantly testing, learning, and adapting.
* We enjoy pair programming for our products; we are lean in our approach and actively remove bureaucracy where we see it.
* We believe in delivering fast, iterating, and pivoting as we go, rather than defining the perfect solution upfront.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test - Manager
description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming outstanding products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This, in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. We are, in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We’re looking for a talented individual who is passionate about crafting, implementing, and operating AI solutions that have a direct and measurable impact on Apple Sales and its customers. We’re seeking a visionary Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)/QE Engineering Manager to own and test end-to-end application workflows using AI. This role will focus on implementing and maintaining QE frameworks, instrumentation, and workflows that help us understand how well our applications perform, where they fail, and how they improve over time. This role will operate in both capacities, to augment existing AI roadmap, as well as innovate and trailblazing new frontier tech projects, crafting AI experiences that reduce time to insights and catalyze decision making.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a QE manager, you will build and lead a team of engineers as a part of a global horizontal Quality Engineering group focused on a breadth of technologies and applications including very highly scalable distributed applications, No-SQL platforms, internal search platforms, end customer facing websites and services, critical security systems, machine learning and anomaly detection systems, software-load balancing, among others. Build, develop, innovate, and retain a hard-working team of quality engineers and build an environment where they can thrive and succeed. Act as a role model for your team when it comes to getting things done and exceeding expectations. Your skills in relationship management and partnership should be outstanding as this role requires to quickly understand and respond to peer teams’ needs and work with management and engineering leadership, developers, quality engineers, project managers, and multi-functional teams who take ownership in building outstanding scalable solutions. You will work in a fast-paced software development environment and continuously enhance our automation infrastructure to move towards continuous deployment where every code change is thoroughly tested and considered ready to be deployed. You will be the quality DRI on product features. To be successful, you will need to supervise and communicate release readiness, identify any gaps, and consistently assess new and innovative ways to improve automation solutions. While the primary role is leading/managing employees, you should have deep technical knowledge of distributed systems and cloud computing, platform as a service, and microservices architecture. We expect that you have strong experience working with short release cycles, do not hesitate to code, and actively participate in design and code reviews.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 10+ years in Quality roles testing and automating large scale customer-facing systems with sophisticated distributed integrations
* 3+ years managing quality engineers responsible for qualifying features through the complete software development life cycle
* Ability to act as a leader to increase efficiency through process improvements and automation, increase test coverage through automation, reduce customer-impacting defects, make informed risk-based decisions, and improve chances of success and promote software testing standards and mentor engineers in the team
* Ability to build, drive and support automation test strategy. Dedication to delivering great software and releasing it quickly, efficiently, and with growing quality. (white box + black box, automation, functional, performance, stress testing)
* Excellent knowledge of QE automation architecture, methodologies, processes, and tools.
* Hands on in automating functional, system and integration tests. Experience in tools like Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber-JVM, Appium for API, Web, iOS and MacOS platforms.
* Experience creating multiple test frameworks from scratch. Experience in Java or Python, familiar with databases, SQL, and scripting languages.
* Understanding of REST and RESTful services.
* Applied knowledge of GenAI, micro-services, recommendation systems, and context engineering.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation concepts such as Golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and experience with different LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)
* Experience with CI/CD or release validation workflows, deployment process and code quality checking tools.
* Knowledge of project management, and productivity tools such as Wrike and Miro.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.
* Able to balance competing priorities, long-term projects, and ad hoc requirements.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, constantly evolving business environment.
* Working across global teams to ensure alignment of product development.
* We're looking for someone with an eagerness and ability to learn new skills and solve dynamic problems in an encouraging and expansive environment.
* Ability to collaborate and influence multi-functional teams within your area of responsibility.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Collaborate with multi-functional and globally distributed teams

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Highly organised, creative, motivated, and passionate about achieving results.
* Creative thinker and strong problem solver with meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
* An enthusiasm for user-focused design & high-quality products.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate close interaction with development teams, management, and other teams within Apple

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

description:

description:

We are seeking an experienced **Principal Software Engineer** to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance.

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation).
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products.
* Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization.
* Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment.
* Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives.

#### **Requirements**

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience.
* Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components.
* Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies.
* Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX.
* Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services.
* Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

title: AI Productivity Solutions Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**

Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company connecting patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management.

Backed by nearly 100 years of experience, with more than 48,000 employees in nearly 60 countries, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 20 on the Fortune 500, America's Most Innovative Companies #51, 11 Best GCCs to work for in India, Fortune Sector Leaders: Health Care #5, with a $254 billion. of revenue in FY26.

**About Cardinal Health International India (CHII)**

This role is part of the Information Security function for Cardinal Health International India Pvt Ltd (CHII).

Cardinal Health International India (CHII) is part of the Cardinal Heath Global Technology and Business Services (GTBS) team. CHII leverages technology to offer scalable and healthcare solutions to enhance efficiency and improve quality of care across the value chain.

Our vision is to build a world class capability center that is an intersection of tech-innovation and learning, empowering our people to build solutions which will solve healthcare’s most complex challenges.

**Position Summary**

Provides advanced technical support, diagnostics, validation, and consulting for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, enterprise search, Microsoft Graph-grounded experiences, and approved productivity AI integrations. The role operates below the architecture layer and focuses on product expertise, troubleshooting, supportability, pilots, repeatable diagnostic methods, and the development of approved skills and lightweight agents that improve the internal operations of AI Productivity & Collaboration Services.

**Strategic Purpose**

Make AI work reliably in Cardinal Health's productivity environment, and apply approved AI capabilities to improve the team's own service delivery. This role becomes a deep Microsoft Copilot product specialist and a succession feeder for broader platform architecture, while developing bounded, supportable skills and agents for internal team operations without duplicating the enterprise agent-development mandate of Enterprise Automation.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Serve as the advanced technical subject-matter expert for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Microsoft 365 search, Microsoft Graph grounding, and related productivity AI capabilities.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving licensing, identity, permissions, content access, search indexing, grounding behavior, tenant configuration, application context, and user experience.
* Develop repeatable diagnostic methods, test plans, health checks, escalation packages, known-issue records, and technical runbooks.
* Partner with Microsoft and internal platform teams on escalations, root-cause analysis, service incidents, product defects, and roadmap-related technical questions.
* Validate new Copilot capabilities, configuration changes, and pilot implementations against architecture, security, privacy, supportability, and operational-readiness requirements.
* Perform technical testing of grounded responses and search behavior, distinguishing platform, permission, indexing, retrieval, content-quality, and user-behavior causes.
* Provide technical consulting on solution feasibility, licensing dependencies, integration boundaries, support models, and implementation risks.
* Support build-to-run transition for approved productivity AI capabilities by documenting support procedures, monitoring needs, known limitations, and escalation paths.
* Create scripts, reports, and diagnostic utilities using supported administrative interfaces, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph where appropriate.
* Mentor support and engineering staff on Copilot concepts, troubleshooting methods, responsible use, and escalation practices.
* Design, configure, test, document, and maintain approved Copilot skills, declarative agents, and other lightweight agent experiences that streamline team operations, knowledge retrieval, service reporting, support triage, documentation, and recurring administrative work.
* Identify internal team processes suited to skills or agent assistance, and define requirements, data sources, permissions, success criteria, human-review controls, support ownership, and lifecycle expectations before implementation.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns, templates, test cases, monitoring approaches, and runbooks for team-operated skills and agents, including change control, versioning, access management, quality review, and retirement.
* Coordinate with Enterprise Automation when a use case requires enterprise-scale deployment, complex workflow orchestration, custom connectors, broader business ownership, or capabilities beyond the team's approved operating boundary.

**Key Accountabilities and Expected Outcomes**

* Faster resolution and stronger root-cause analysis for complex Copilot, search, and grounding issues.
* Repeatable technical validation and diagnostic patterns that support teams can reuse.
* More supportable pilot-to-production transitions for productivity AI capabilities.
* Reduced dependency on the AI Platform Architect for day-to-day deep technical investigation.
* Documented, supportable skills and lightweight agents that reduce manual effort and improve consistency within AI Productivity & Collaboration Services.

**Required Technical and Professional Competencies**

* Microsoft 365 administration and support across Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 Apps, Entra ID, and Microsoft Purview concepts.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Microsoft Graph, enterprise search, grounding, permissions, identity, licensing, and support diagnostics.
* PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, reporting, logging, technical testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* ITIL incident, problem, request, change, service transition, escalation, and root-cause-analysis practices.
* Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear guidance for support teams, content owners, business stakeholders, governance partners, and leaders.
* Configuration and lifecycle management of Copilot skills, declarative agents, prompts, knowledge sources, actions, permissions, test cases, and human-review controls within approved Microsoft platforms.
* Ability to assess internal operational processes for appropriate automation, define bounded agent behavior, validate output quality, document limitations, and transition solutions into a supportable run state.

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Four or more years of related IT experience, including significant Microsoft 365, productivity, collaboration, SaaS, or enterprise support experience.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting identity, permissions, search, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 administration, or complex cloud-service issues.
* Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Azure, Security, Power Platform, ITIL, or AI-related certifications are preferred.
* Experience configuring or supporting Copilot skills, declarative agents, low-code AI solutions, or comparable productivity automation capabilities is preferred.

title: Sr. Manager; Data Engineering
description:

The role leads the engineering journey from pilot to production, enabling secure, scalable, privacy-preserving data collaboration and reliable data exchange across on-premises and cloud environments.

Providing technical guidance across the Frontier Agentic Squad’s and extending platform leadership coverage across multiple region, this leader translates business priorities into architecture decisions, engineering roadmaps, and dependable production services. Success is measured through business opportunities enabled, platform reliability, delivery quality, and the growth and independence of engineering teams.

This is a technically engaged management role requiring the credibility to challenge designs, review critical code, guide complex incident resolution, and develop technical leads without becoming a delivery bottleneck. The Senior Manager partners with Product, Architecture, Operations and Infrastructure (O&I), Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy/Legal, and Finance to balance customer commitments, security, privacy, cost, and sustainable execution.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

* Guide architecture across AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, security, and cost.
* Oversee high-volume data exchange between on-premises and cloud platforms, ensuring data quality, interoperability, and failure recovery.
* Embed privacy, security, query governance, and data lifecycle controls into platform design and operation.
* Drive operational excellence through clear service-level objectives, observability, incident management, and tested disaster recovery.

* Experience designing and operating high-volume data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and distributed processing systems, including data validation, performance optimization, failure recovery, and idempotent processing.
* Working proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to review production code and guide testing, API design, version control, CI/CD, and secure development practices.
* Experience implementing secure data access, encryption, auditability, and data lifecycle governance in partnership with security, risk, privacy, or compliance teams.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and establishing monitoring, operational documentation, incident response, and reliability improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical leads, delegate ownership, resolve disagreements, and influence teams outside direct reporting lines.
* Experience translating business needs into technical roadmaps and measurable outcomes, with clear communication of architectural trade-offs and individual versus team contributions.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:

As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI/ML Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

**AI/ML Engineer | About You**

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy production-ready AI capabilities that automate complex enterprise workflows and turn business data into reliable, explainable, and actionable insights. You will develop solutions across Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, information extraction, recommendation and matching, and AI evaluation, while integrating these capabilities with enterprise systems. * Integrate AI models and services with enterprise applications through REST APIs, CRM platforms, data systems, and workflow applications, ensuring secure and reliable production operation.

* Partner with business, data, product, and engineering teams to continuously improve AI capabilities based on user feedback, operational metrics, model performance, and evolving business requirements.

* Experience developing APIs and enterprise integrations that connect AI services with CRM, data platforms, workflow systems, and other business applications.
* Experience with technical-document extraction, product or spare-part matching, CPQ/quotation workflows, CRM-based AI agents, cited answer generation, negotiation simulations, or governed enterprise AI solutions is highly desirable.

title: Senior Associate, Prize ( AI Build) , Livelihood Ecosystem
description:
**About the Team:**

https://thedelta.org.in/prize/ is a platform to draw talent, capital, and public attention towards the most pressing developmental problems in India. the^delta Prize aims to guide markets where they are needed the most, inducing population-scale solutions and innovations that have disproportionate impact on stagnant livelihood opportunities and ecosystems for underserved segments.

This role sits within Future Enterprises, the^delta Prize's vertical dedicated to India's MSME sector, and supports the AI platform within Samriddhi (AI for MSME prosperity). The platform connects youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities to career pathways, skilling, apprenticeships and jobs, while helping MSMEs access job-ready talent. The role reports to the Senior Manager, Platform, and works alongside the Director / Associate Director, AI & Digital Platforms and the Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem teams.

The platform is in its build phase, so priorities and processes will keep moving as the work progresses.

**Who are we solving for?**

Youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities, whose access to career guidance, skilling and jobs is limited by language, geography and the thin guidance available to them, and MSMEs that find it difficult to reach job-ready talent.

**What are we solving for?**

India's youth-to-work transition is fragmented: skilling remains supply-led while MSME demand for talent goes largely unmet, career guidance for tier 3–4 youth is thin and rarely available in their own language, and the landscape of job and skilling platforms is fragmented across incompatible systems. The platform is designed to address these together, on top of existing government and ecosystem infrastructure.

**Role and Responsibility:**

**What will you do?**

* Take ownership of the day-to-day coordination that keeps platform work moving, tracking tasks, deadlines and follow-ups across product, engineering and partner teams
* Support product delivery: maintain the backlog, prepare requirement documents and release notes as directed by the Senior Manager, and track open issues through to closure
* Support partner onboarding and contracting: coordinate agreements, paperwork and logistics for technology, skilling and employer partners
* Support the landscape scan: gather and structure information on existing job and skilling platforms using the team's framework, and keep the database current
* Coordinate user research: schedule and manage logistics for conversations and pilot sessions with youth and MSME employers in tier 3–4 cities, document the notes and consolidate findings
* Test platform features and AI responses in Hindi and English, and other languages where relevant, log issues in a structured way and follow up with the build team
* Maintain documentation, including meeting notes, process documents, partner trackers and decision logs
* Track platform usage and outcome data, and prepare inputs for regular reports
* Coordinate with the Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem teams, and with marketing, analytics and donor relations, to get assigned tasks done on time
* Support logistics for workshops, partner convenings and field visits, including travel to pilot locations
* Move quickly across many parts at once, close to the work as it happens

*(The actual role might evolve slightly based on your relevant experience and the overlap between organisational requirements and your interests.)*

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

***Core abilities & transferable skills***

* Strong execution skills: reliable, organised, and able to get things done without needing every step spelled out
* Comfort taking direction and working within processes and frameworks that already exist
* A major learner mindset: the work spans AI, workforce and MSME topics that will be new to many candidates, and the ability to pick things up quickly matters more than prior expertise
* High comfort with ambiguity and change
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools
* Clear written communication and strong documentation habits
* Professional, responsive and dependable stakeholder coordination
* Bias for action, paired with humility

title: Applied AI Solutions Engineer – PHB Commercial Transformation
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.

As an **Applied AI Solutions Engineer** , you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will help turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.

This is a forward-deployed engineering opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong technical expertise with visible business impact. You will move between commercial workflows, solution design, and hands-on development, owning the journey from identifying a business challenge to delivering solutions that users genuinely adopt and value.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI solutions that enable PHB commercial teams to work more effectively and create measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development**

* Work directly with PHB commercial teams to understand workflows, user needs, and business challenges, translating them into practical AI solutions.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows utilizing prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool usage, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop thin-slice solutions to rapidly validate user value and technical feasibility.
* Build iteratively with users, leveraging feedback and evidence to improve, redesign, or discontinue solutions where appropriate.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Securely connect AI solutions to enterprise platforms and data sources, including Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies with appropriate identity, security, and approval controls.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge sources, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Design and develop solutions with security, privacy, responsible AI, maintainability, and reuse in mind.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scale**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.
* Test solutions with end users and make data-driven decisions on whether to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives.
* Deploy, monitor, support, and continuously improve production solutions in partnership with Central IT, ComEx, and other enterprise stakeholders.
* Document solutions, technical patterns, and key learnings to support ongoing maintenance, reuse, and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

* Ability to work directly with business users and technical teams to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or comparable technologies.
