What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. title: SAP RISE SAP Basis Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As an SAP Basis Operations RISE Support Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the availability, stability, and performance of SAP environments. You will provide L1/L2 SAP Basis support, monitor business-critical SAP systems, manage incidents and alerts, and support outage recovery in a 24x7 production environment. You will work closely with SAP RISE operations, hyperscaler teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure SLA-driven service delivery.

  

**What will you do**

  

* Monitor SAP systems, applications, databases, interfaces, dashboards, and operational queues, proactively identifying potential service risks.
* Handle L1/L2 SAP Basis incidents, performing initial diagnosis, troubleshooting, resolution, escalation, and documentation according to SLA commitments.
* Participate in major incident and outage bridges, supporting impact analysis, service restoration, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and corrective actions.
* Perform SAP Basis operational activities including system monitoring, startup/shutdown, background jobs, spool administration, user locks, transports, and system maintenance. Monitor SAP HANA database health and performance and support system refreshes, client copies, kernel updates, and parameter reviews.
* Support approved changes and releases, including system readiness validation and transport movement across SAP landscapes.
* Coordinate with SAP RISE, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, customer, and technical support teams during incidents and service disruptions.
Work within ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, maintaining accurate tickets, operational documentation, SLA/OLA compliance, and service reports.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* 3–8 years of SAP Basis administration experience, preferably supporting 24x7 production environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP ECC, S/4HANA, BW, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA administration and monitoring.
* Experience with SAP system monitoring, performance troubleshooting, startup/shutdown procedures, Transport Management System (TMS), background jobs, and spool administration.
* Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Major Incident Handling, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and SLA-driven support.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments and troubleshooting infrastructure, database, application, and interface-related alerts.
* Understanding of the RISE with SAP operating model, including SAP-managed cloud environments, support boundaries, and customer responsibilities.
Experience working with technical teams and stakeholders during production incidents, outages, changes, and service restoration activities.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise**

  

* Exposure to RISE with SAP operations and managed service provider / AMS / MSM engagements.
* Experience with SAP Cloud ALM and SAP Focused Run for system monitoring and alert management.
* Familiarity with hyperscaler environments such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* SAP Certified Technology Associate – SAP System Administration certification is preferred.
* SAP HANA Administration certification is an advantage.
* ITIL Foundation Certification is desirable.
Strong understanding of proactive monitoring, preventive actions, operational reporting, service reviews, and continuous improvement in SAP production environments.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**In this role, you are part of**

The MR Recon Software team, a key part of the MR Domain SW department in MR R&D within Philips. MR R&D focuses on developing and enhancing MR products and solutions. We have defined aspirational goals and a “North Star” in line with customers’ most pressing needs. We work on improving (a) Speed, to ensure predictable and reduced cost per exam; (b) Comfort, to improve patient and staff satisfaction; and (c) Confidence, to support first-time-right diagnosis.

The MR Recon team works on new AI technologies and GPU implementations and is exploring cloud technology to meet future clinical needs. Team members have opportunities to grow as domain specialists or technical specialists.

* Design, develop, test, and maintain MR reconstruction software.

* Work with reconstruction algorithm developers and AI/ML, software, and systems teams to translate computationally intensive algorithms into efficient, scalable implementations.
* Investigate and resolve customer complaints.

Support project estimation, planning, and risk management activities.

MTech with 5+ years of relevant experience, or PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience.

title: Senior Staff AI Scientist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The ideal candidate is a PhD-trained AI scientist with 5–8+ years of post-PhD experience driving cutting-edge medical imaging and Physical AI research from conception to real-world clinical deployment. This individual operates as a technical authority and research leader, shaping AI strategy across imaging, embodied and physics-aware AI, foundation models, and multimodal healthcare systems, while mentoring senior scientists and influencing product and clinical roadmaps.  
They bring deep expertise in learning from real-world data and physical signals, including sensor fusion, spatiotemporal modeling, simulation-to-real transfer, and constraint-aware or physics-informed machine learning as applied to imaging hardware, acquisition pipelines, and clinical workflows. The role requires a strong ability to bridge algorithmic innovation with physical systems, such as scanners, devices, or procedural environments, ensuring robust performance under real-world variability and operational constraints.  
The candidate possesses a rare combination of deep technical excellence, a strong publication and patent record, and proven experience translating AI research into regulated, commercially deployed healthcare solutions. They have demonstrated success in taking models from research to production, accounting for physical robustness, safety, reliability, and regulatory requirements, and in collaborating closely with clinicians, engineers, and product teams to deliver clinically impactful AI systems.  
They possess a rare combination of deep technical excellence, strong publication and patent record, and proven experience translating AI research into regulated, commercially deployed healthcare solutions.  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Research & Technical Leadership:**

* Define and own the long-term research vision for **medical image analysis, Physical AI–enabled imaging systems, foundation models, and multimodal healthcare AI** across clinical domains.
* Architect and lead the development of state-of-the-art **detection, segmentation, classification, reconstruction, and quantitative imaging systems**, incorporating **physics-aware modeling, spatiotemporal reasoning, and sensor-informed learning**, deployed in real clinical workflows.
* Drive innovation across:
  + Vision and multimodal transformers
  + Large-scale foundation models
  + Self-supervised, weakly supervised, and semi-supervised learning
  + Physics-informed ML, constraint-aware learning, simulation-to-real transfer, and embodied perception paradigms relevant to medical imaging and procedural environments.
* Establish technical standards for **experimental rigor, physical robustness, uncertainty quantification, clinical validation, fairness, and generalization** across imaging devices, sites, and populations.

**Clinical Translation & Real-World Impact:**

* Partner deeply with clinicians, radiologists, pathologists, imaging scientists, and regulatory stakeholders to formulate **AI problem statements grounded in clinical workflows and physical realities of imaging systems**.
* Lead dataset and system design strategies including:
  + Multi-site and multi-device data curation
  + Annotation frameworks aligned with clinical and procedural context
  + Bias mitigation, domain shift analysis, and hardware- and protocol-aware generalization assessment.
* Guide AI solutions through clinical validation, regulatory pathways, and real-world deployment, ensuring **safety, robustness to physical variability, and compliance with regulated healthcare environments**.

**Organizational & Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Act as a **technical mentor and design reviewer** for senior scientists, postdocs, and junior researchers across AI, imaging, and Physical AI domains.
* Influence product direction, portfolio prioritization, and platform strategy in collaboration with **engineering, imaging hardware teams, MLOps, product, and clinical partners**.
* Serve as a go-to expert for **medical imaging AI and Physical AI systems**, advising on architecture decisions, risk trade-offs, and long-term strategy.
* Represent the organization externally through **publications, patents, invited talks, and collaborations** with academia, healthcare systems, and industry partners.

**Research Excellence & Thought Leadership:**

* Consistently publish in top-tier venues (e.g., MICCAI, CVPR, NeurIPS, TMI, MedIA, Radiology AI, Nature family journals), including work that bridges **learning-based AI with physical modeling and real-world systems**.
* Drive IP creation through high-value patents covering **algorithmic innovation, system-level design, and physics-aware or multimodal AI methods**.
* Stay ahead of emerging trends in **Physical AI, foundation models, multimodal and embodied AI, federated learning, regulatory science, and AI safety in healthcare**.

**Technical Expertise (Senior-Level Expectations):**

* Deep mastery of deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred) and large-scale **training, fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment**.
* Advanced expertise in medical image analysis across **2D/3D/4D imaging and multimodal MRI/CT/PET/X-ray/Ultrasound**, using MONAI, SimpleITK, OpenCV, and related tools.
* Proven experience with:
  + Vision and multimodal foundation models
  + Self-, weakly-, and semi-supervised learning at scale
  + Domain adaptation and generalization across institutions and devices
  + **Physics-informed ML, simulation-based learning, spatiotemporal modeling, sensor fusion, and uncertainty-aware inference**
* Strong understanding of **MLOps, experiment tracking, reproducibility, scalable research platforms**, and model lifecycle management.
* Solid grasp of **data governance, model risk management, privacy-preserving ML, regulatory expectations (FDA, CE, SaMD), and real-world safety considerations** for AI operating on physical systems.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Applied Physics, Robotics, or a closely related field.
* 5–8+ years of post-PhD experience in **medical imaging AI, healthcare AI, Physical AI, or applied AI research**.

**Required Skills:**

* Has led **large, system-level research initiatives** rather than isolated models, often spanning algorithms, data, and physical constraints.
* Strong publication and/or patent track record in top AI, imaging, or systems-oriented venues.
* Demonstrated history of **end-to-end ownership**: research ideation system design validation regulated, real-world deployment.
* Experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional, and clinically driven environments involving **both software and physical systems**.
* Comfortable making architecture and strategy decisions **under ambiguity and real-world constraints**.
* Balances scientific rigor with pragmatism, optimizing for **clinical impact, robustness, and deploy ability**.
* Recognized as a **trusted technical advisor** by engineering, clinical, imaging, and product leadership.

**Inclusion and Diversity:**

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

title: Customer Experience & Retention Manager
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Role**

Harness is growing its Digital and Commercial customer base, and we will not scale it by adding people in proportion. This role owns **customer experience and retention for a large book of Digital and Commercial customers**, and its main job is to **build and run the tech-touch engine that serves them**.

You will design automated journeys, health signals, in-product and email programs, and self-service resources that deliver onboarding, adoption, risk detection, renewal and expansion without a person in every interaction. You will use human time on the moments that matter: a customer stuck on a technical blocker, an at-risk account, a renewal negotiation. You will also feed what you learn back into the automation so those moments become rarer.

**Operating principle:** Automate by default, involve a human by exception. Every manual touch should either solve a high-value problem or teach us what to automate next.

**What You'll Own**

* **Tech-Touch Customer Experience Engine**

* Design, scale and optimize automated lifecycle programs: onboarding, activation, adoption, renewal and win-back. Run them through the CRM, the CS platform, email and in-product channels. Build triggered plays driven by product usage, milestones, health score, support signals and contract events.
* Own the segmentation and coverage model: which customers get automation only, automation plus on-demand human help, or direct engagement.
* Build the self-service layer: guides, templates, pipeline examples, office hours, webinars, community content and a knowledge base. Measure what gets used and fill the gaps.
* Run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, timing and channel) and report on what changes adoption and retention.
* Use AI-assisted workflows for summarisation, content personalisation, ticket and usage insight, and outreach drafting to raise throughput without losing quality.

* **Data-Driven Health, Risk & Prioritisation**

* Own the customer health model: define, validate and tune the signals (usage depth, feature adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment and commercial indicators).
* Turn the data into automated risk and opportunity alerts, and route them to the right play or person. Build dashboards that show portfolio health, coverage efficiency, adoption funnels and renewal risk. Run recovery plans for at-risk accounts, then capture the pattern as a repeatable, automated play.

* **Technical Enablement & Hands-On Support**

* Guide customers through product configuration, integrations (GitHub, GitLab, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools) and common pipeline issues when automation and self-service are not enough.
* Join technical discovery and proof-of-value work with Solutions Engineering and forward-deployed teams.
* Reproduce common issues, gather logs and configuration details, and escalate cleanly to Support and Engineering.
* Convert every recurring technical question into reusable enablement: a guide, template, in-product prompt or automated play.
* Turn recurring customer challenges into product feedback and prioritised requests.

* **Renewals, Retention & Commercial Ownership**

* Own renewal execution end to end: automated renewal journeys and reminders, risk assessment, commercial discussion and close, with human involvement focused on at-risk and strategic renewals. Identify expansion, cross-sell and right-sizing opportunities from usage signals, and trigger plays and handoffs to Account Executives.
* Coordinate quotes, Order Forms, approvals and procurement with internal stakeholders. Keep renewal forecasts, customer records and risk assessments accurate and current. Work with Account Executives and Revenue Operations to improve gross revenue retention and reduce preventable churn.

* **Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Revenue Operations to connect data, systems and messaging across the customer journey.
* Find manual, repetitive tasks and remove them through automation, integrations and tooling. Document playbooks and share best practices so the model scales across teams and segments.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years required (5+ years preferred)** in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Digital/Scaled CS, Solutions Consulting or a similar SaaS role. Experience managing a high-volume B2B SaaS portfolio, ideally in a digital, SMB, mid-market or commercial segment.
* Hands-on experience building automation in a CRM or CS platform (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Totango or similar), including journeys, triggers and health scoring.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with usage and engagement data, dashboards, funnels and cohort or segment analysis.
* Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals: Git, CI/CD pipelines, APIs and cloud platforms. Experience with SaaS renewals, retention and commercial discussions, and an understanding of subscription, licensing and billing models.
* Strong communication, troubleshooting and prioritisation skills in a high-volume environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with digital CS tooling: in-app guidance, email and marketing automation, community platforms and knowledge-base or content systems.
* Experience using SQL, BI tools, scripting or low-code automation to build and improve workflows. Experience applying AI or LLM-assisted workflows to customer communication, support or insight. Hands-on exposure to Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD platforms. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or GCP; REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and YAML configuration.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or DevSecOps concepts.
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects or implementation teams.

**Outcomes**

  

**Scale & efficiency**

Higher customers-per-manager coverage with stable or improving satisfaction. A growing share of lifecycle touches and renewals handled through automation. Fewer repeat manual tasks.

Faster onboarding and time to value, higher activation and feature adoption, and measurable use of self-service content.

title: Principal Applied Sciences Manager
description:
**Overview**

**Principal Applied Science Manager - Post-Training and Inference Optimization**

**Overview**

Microsoft Foundry helps developers and organizations build, deploy and operate AI solutions at scale. Join an engineering team building the infrastructure that makes model training and inference faster, more reliable and more efficient for customers.

As a Principal Applied Science Manager, you will lead an applied science team improving model and agent quality through post-training and reducing inference latency and cost. You will set scientific direction, develop scientists and remain hands-on in experiments and code. Partner with training, serving and product teams to turn research into reliable customer capabilities, measured by task success, response time and cost per successful task.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* Hire, coach and manage applied scientists. Set clear goals, give performance feedback and develop technical leaders who can take research through to production.
* Own the science roadmap across post-training and inference optimization. Translate customer needs into testable hypotheses, prioritize experiments and make investment decisions using measured quality and cost improvements.
* Lead supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning (RL). Develop reward models and task-based reward signals that improve reasoning, multi-turn task completion and tool-use correctness.
* Build data and feedback pipelines with engineering teams. Curate demonstrations, preference data, synthetic examples and agent interaction histories, with clear data permissions, versioning and separation between training and evaluation data.
* Establish reproducible evaluations with strong baselines and controlled comparisons. Measure generalization and safety, prevent evaluation-data leakage and detect models exploiting rewards without completing the intended task.
* Lead inference experiments in quantization, distillation and speculative decoding to reduce computation and memory use. Measure time to first token, generation speed, tail latency, throughput and cost under representative load, against explicit model-quality targets.
* Partner with systems engineers on distributed training, agent rollout generation, batching and caching. Reduce training GPU-hours and serving cost while preserving convergence, task quality and reliable recovery.
* Take successful experiments into production through staged releases, monitoring and rollback plans. Work with engineering teams to preserve data privacy, tenant isolation, streaming behavior and token-accounting correctness.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering or a related technical field AND 8+ years of relevant applied science, machine learning or engineering experience; OR Bachelor's Degree in a related technical field AND 10+ years of relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.

title: Manager - Innovations
description:
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications

  

We are looking for a Manager who lives at the intersection of network protocols and applied cryptography. This is a deeply hands-on role you will spend most of your time in the lab and in the code: reading RFCs, extending open-source stacks, wiring up IPsec, MACsec, WireGuard, TLS 1.3 and PQC overlays, and hardening the security of everything you touch. Not an architect-review role; a build, break, benchmark and ship role with real ownership of what runs in production. The role sits within Strategy & Innovations at Tata Communications and reports into the Network Architecture leadership. Key responsibilities

* Own security and cryptography depth develop and demonstrate a first-principles understanding of the primitives (symmetric ciphers, hashes, KEMs, signatures, PQC) and of the protocols that use them (TLS 1.3, IPsec, MACsec, WireGuard, QKD key delivery). Know when to apply which primitive, and why.

* Experiment with security protocols hands-on build, break, benchmark and tune IPsec (IKEv2, ESP), MACsec (802.1AE), WireGuard, TLS variants and PQC overlays in the lab; capture what works, what breaks, and what to change; publish findings back to the team.

* Implement and extend network protocols read IETF / IEEE RFCs end-to-end and turn them into production-quality code in C, C++, Rust or Python. Add features and capabilities to existing protocol implementations (routing daemons, tunnelling stacks, control planes, overlays).

* Improve the software stack profile, patch and harden open-source or in-house network / security stacks (strongSwan, wpa\_supplicant, kernel netfilter, libsodium, liboqs, and equivalents). Own the quality bar for the code you ship; contribute upstream where it makes sense.

* Design security into the code, not around it apply mutual authentication, key rotation, forward secrecy, replay protection and side-channel awareness at the protocol layer. Ensure every feature ships with a defensible security model, not a checklist.

* Ship code fast with AI-assisted development use prompt engineering, LLM-based coding assistants and code-review agents fluently, so features go from RFC to running code in days rather than weeks without compromising correctness or test coverage.

* Own delivery end-to-end take features from RFC to running code on schedule; carry code reviews, testing and CI/CD hygiene as first-class personal responsibilities. Required qualifications

* Education Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, Information Technology or a closely related engineering discipline. Consistent strong academic record (first-class / 65%+ or equivalent GPA) is expected.

* Experience 4-6 years of hands-on, post-degree experience in both network protocol engineering and applied network security / cryptography (not one or the other). Real code ownership on at least two production or open-source protocol / crypto stacks.

* Networking protocol depth solid working understanding of L2/L3 machinery (Ethernet, VLAN, VXLAN, IP/IPv6, TCP, QUIC, BGP, OSPF), tunnelling (GRE, IPsec, WireGuard), and how overlays compose over underlays. Comfortable reading packet captures and reasoning about wire format.

* Security and cryptography depth practical fluency with TLS 1.3, IPsec (IKEv2, ESP), MACsec (802.1AE), WireGuard; symmetric ciphers (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305), hashes (SHA-2/3, BLAKE), KEMs and signatures (ECDH, ECDSA, Ed25519, ML-KEM, ML-DSA); hands-on with OpenSSL, libsodium, liboqs and equivalent crypto libraries; key-management basics (HSM, KMS, PKCS#11).

* Programming proficiency production-quality code in at least one of C, C++, Rust or Python; comfortable with systems-level code, build systems (make, cargo, cmake), version control (git), unit / integration testing, and CI pipelines.

* RFC literacy able to read an IETF or IEEE specification end-to-end, identify exactly what needs to be built or changed, and translate it into working code and test cases.

* Cloud networking at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP at working depth: VPC/VNet design, transit gateway, private link, cloud firewalls, cloud-to-on-prem interconnect.

* Delivery discipline proven track record of shipping design and code projects on schedule; comfortable with structured design reviews, change management, and post-implementation review. Preferred (nice-to-have) qualifications Certifications: CCNP Enterprise / Security or CCIE (Cisco); Fortinet NSE 4-7; Palo Alto PCNSE; AWS Advanced Networking or Security Specialty; CISSP or CCSP; ITIL Foundation; PMP. Emerging technology exposure: Post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM, ML-DSA), quantum-safe key delivery; SASE architectures; container/Kubernetes networking (CNI, service mesh); observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK); automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python). Regulated-industry experience: Banking, telecom, healthcare or government network design carrying real compliance obligations. Skills, mindset and behaviours we look for

* Excellent communicator clear written English (design docs, proposals, customer decks) and confident spoken English (workshops, executive updates); ability to translate deep technical detail into business impact.

* Ownership and on-time delivery takes personal responsibility for outcomes; a demonstrated passion for closing work on schedule without compromising quality.

* Self-driven learner & AI-native builder plans and executes own upskilling; keeps pace with a fast-moving technology landscape; fluent in prompt engineering and LLM-based coding assistants to ship features faster and with fewer defects than traditional workflows would allow.

* Structured, collaborative, customer-centric decomposes ambiguous problems and defends choices with data; works well across pre-sales, engineering, operations and customer teams

The Associate Director of AI Science is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role dedicated to driving commercial value across our Home and Mobility verticals. Sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning and business strategy, this role focuses on leveraging propensity modeling and dynamic microsegmentation to unlock new revenue streams, optimize the customer lifecycle, and elevate customer lifetime value.

You will act as the crucial bridge between our technical AI Science teams and the Home and Mobility business units, ensuring that complex AI and data science capabilities are translated into adopted, scalable solutions that deliver measurable ROI and continuous business growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Business Strategy & Commercial Value Creation**

* **Monetize AI Capabilities:** Lead the strategic application of advanced propensity models (e.g., likelihood-to-buy, churn prediction, next-best-action, cross-sell/up-sell) to drive tangible growth and retention in the Home and Mobility sectors.
* **Define Microsegmentation Strategy:** Guide the development of highly granular, behavioral microsegments to personalize marketing efforts, optimize pricing strategies, and tailor product offerings in real-time.
* **ROI Accountability:** Establish frameworks to measure the commercial impact of deployed AI models. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) that demonstrate direct value creation, revenue lift, and cost optimization.
* **Lifecycle Optimization:** Embed AI-driven insights into critical touchpoints along the customer lifecycle, ensuring predictive interventions are timed perfectly with high-impact trigger events.

**Stakeholder Management & AI Adoption**

* **Executive Liaison:** Serve as the primary strategic advisor and translator between the AI Science function and Home/Mobility business leaders (Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Experience).
* **Drive Business Adoption:** Champion the operationalization of AI models. Overcome organizational silos and resistance by demonstrating clear business value, securing buy-in, and embedding AI tools directly into end-user workflows.
* **Storytelling with Data:** Translate highly technical machine learning concepts, model performance metrics, and statistical outputs into clear, compelling narratives and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.
* **Needs Translation:** Proactively identify business pain points within Home and Mobility and translate these into actionable data science projects, defining clear modeling requirements for the technical teams.

**Technical Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* **Model Lifecycle Strategy:** Oversee the business strategy for models deployed in high-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and relevance to shifting market dynamics.
* **Pipeline Integration:** Partner closely with Data Engineering, MLOps, and IT teams to ensure models are seamlessly deployed into production environments and marketing automation platforms.
* **Team Mentorship:** Provide strategic direction and business-context mentorship to data scientists and AI engineers, ensuring their technical execution remains tightly aligned with corporate objectives.

### **Core Competencies & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

* **Education:** Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field (an MBA with a strong quantitative focus is highly preferred).
* **Industry Experience:** 8+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI strategy, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership, product management, or business-facing role.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the telecommunications, broadband, or consumer technology industries, specifically within Home (e.g., fiber, smart home, IoT) and Mobility (e.g., 5G, wireless services) verticals.

**Technical & Business Skills**

* **AI/ML Fluency:** Strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, and LLM architecture. Must be highly conversant in how techniques utilizing frameworks like PyTorch and scikit-learn are applied to business problems, even if not writing production code daily.
* **Advanced Propensity & Segmentation:** Proven track record of designing, evaluating, and strategically deploying end-to-end propensity models and clustering techniques for large-scale customer bases.
* **Data Stack Familiarity:** Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), production MLOps tools, and large-scale data extraction processes.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Elite presentation skills with the ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.

### **What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* Successfully integrated at least three major propensity or microsegmentation models into the Home and Mobility go-to-market workflows.
* Established a regular cadence of AI performance reporting that clearly demonstrates incremental revenue lift or churn reduction to the executive team.
* Achieved a high adoption rate of AI-driven recommendations among business stakeholders, shifting the organizational culture toward proactive, model-driven decision-making.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

title: Senior Manager — SAP Basis and Cloud Leader
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

This role is responsible for the availability, performance, security, and technical operations of the SAP platform landscape. The leader governs SAP infrastructure, cloud services, environments, upgrades, monitoring, and disaster recovery capabilities to ensure uninterrupted business operations. As custodian of the SAP technical foundation, the role protects mission-critical applications supporting global operations. The position is essential for maintaining system resilience, scalability, and cybersecurity throughout the transformation journey. Reliable platform operations are fundamental to business continuity and long-term ERP success.

**Landscape operations and availability**

* Own end-to-end technical operations for the global S/4HANA landscape and connected SAP systems —

availability, stability, and service levels against business-agreed commitments.

* Manage the RISE with SAP relationship operationally: service level accountability, escalation, change

coordination, maintenance windows, and the shared responsibility model. Own the RACI boundary between

Xylem, SAP, the hyperscaler, and the AMS partner, and keep it explicit.

* Lead major incident management for technical outages, including bridge command, communication to

business leadership, and formal RCCA through to closed corrective actions.

* Own the technical calendar: release cycles, SAP upgrades and support packs, kernel and database patching,

and maintenance planning that respects business-critical periods such as period-end and peak shipping.

**Performance management and system optimization**

* Own system-level performance: work process configuration, memory and buffer parameters, dialog and

background workload balancing, RFC and gateway tuning, and system parameter optimization.

* Manage HANA database operations and optimization — memory management, delta merge behavior, table

partitioning and distribution, savepoint and log management, and workload class configuration.

* Own capacity management and sizing forecasts with SAP and the hyperscaler, based on real transaction

volumetrics from deployment waves rather than initial estimates.

* Lead data volume management, archiving, and data aging strategy to keep the landscape performant as

scope and history grow.

* Partner closely with the Business Performance Management Leader — they own transaction and code-level

performance, you own the platform it runs on. Neither problem gets solved by pointing at the other

**Backup, recovery, and resilience**

* Own the backup and recovery strategy end to end: backup design and scheduling, retention policy, log backup

management, and validated restore capability across all environments.

* Define and defend RPO and RTO commitments per system with the business, and prove them — restore

testing on a published cadence, not an assumed capability.

* Own high availability and disaster recovery architecture, including HA design review, DR runbooks, failover

procedures, and regular DR exercises with documented results.

* Ensure business continuity plans are current, tested, and understood by the people who would have to

execute them at three in the morning.

* Maintain audit-ready evidence of backup integrity, restore validation, and DR test outcomes.

**Landscape management and security operations**

* Own system landscape architecture, client strategy, system refresh and copy processes, and environment

provisioning for build, test, training, and deployment waves.

* Own transport landscape administration and change control in partnership with the ABAP and BTP team.
* Manage technical security operations: system hardening, patching cadence, certificate and encryption

management, secure integration configuration, and audit and compliance evidence.

* Partner with security and GRC on privileged access controls, including firefighter administration, emergency

access, and log review discipline within required windows.

* Own monitoring and observability across the landscape — Focused Run, Cloud ALM, EarlyWatch, and

integration with enterprise monitoring — with alerting that drives action rather than noise.

**Deployment and team leadership**

* Provide Basis readiness for every deployment wave: environment strategy, cutover technical planning,

downtime minimization, mock cutover support, and hypercare coverage.

* Lead a global Basis team across onshore and offshore with follow-the-sun coverage for production support.
* Manage AMS partner Basis delivery quality, staffing continuity, and adherence to Xylem operational standards.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 15+ years in SAP Basis and technical operations, with at least 5 years leading global teams.
* Deep hands-on S/4HANA Basis expertise — installation, migration, upgrade, and operations at global scale.
* Expert-level HANA database administration: memory and persistence management, performance monitoring,

partitioning, system replication, and troubleshooting.

* Proven ownership of backup, recovery, HA, and DR for business-critical SAP systems, including demonstrated

restore and failover testing rather than documented intent.

* Demonstrated production ownership through S/4HANA go-lives and hypercare in a multi-wave global program.
* Strong command of system performance tuning, capacity planning, and workload management.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager, Focused Run, and Cloud ALM for monitoring and technical operations.
* Landscape and transport management, system copy and refresh, and environment strategy at scale.
* Composure and command presence in a production outage, with the ability to communicate technical status to

business leadership without either minimizing or catastrophizing.

**Preferred**

* RISE with SAP private cloud operations experience and hyperscaler platform knowledge (Azure, AWS, or

GCP).

* SAP MaxAttention or Enterprise Support engagement management.
* Automation and infrastructure-as-code for SAP operations; scripting in shell, Python, or Ansible.
* BTP platform operations, connectivity, and Cloud Connector management.
* SAP security, GRC, and audit experience in a regulated or publicly listed environment.
* Manufacturing or industrial operations context, where plant downtime has immediate physical and revenue

consequence.

**Success in the First 12 Months**

Published availability and performance SLOs with the business, and delivery against them. A validated backup

and restore capability with tested RPO and RTO, not assumed. A completed DR exercise with documented

results and closed gaps. A clear, agreed RACI across Xylem, SAP, the hyperscaler, and AMS with no unowned

space in it. Reduced technical incident volume and faster mean time to resolution. And clean Basis readiness

through every deployment wave, with downtime inside committed windows.

**Operating Principles You Will Work Under**

* Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project

cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome.

* Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is

governed at the point of creation.

* Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails

enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting.

* Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control

integrity holds at deployment scale.

* Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized

value, not tickets closed or hours delivered.

* Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible,

are owned capabilities.

* Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current

deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Lead SW Architect
description:
The Lead Software Architect will be responsible for ensuring the design and development of software architecture aligns with business objectives and scalability. You will partner cross-functionally to define system requirements and design solutions that integrate seamlessly into complex engineering systems. You will be responsible for driving innovation through prototyping and evaluating new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to enhance development processes

  

**Job Description**

**Software Lead Architect (B4 / 8C)**

**Position Summary**

The Software Lead Architect owns the cloud architecture and technology roadmap for CLSS products and platforms. The core focus is scalable, secure, resilient cloud-native systems, complemented by AI-enabled development and architecture, including integration of generative AI and agents where they add product and engineering value.

As the technical authority across engineering teams, the architect partners with Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, and Cyber Security to govern platform design, modernization, and delivery. The role balances reliability, security, performance, cost, and enterprise requirements while enabling responsible adoption of AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of CLSS products and cloud platforms, including shared services, platform boundaries, integration patterns, deployment models, and AI capabilities where appropriate.
* Set architectural direction across engineering teams through reusable standards, frameworks, and clear domain ownership.
* Govern architecture reviews, decision rights, guardrails, exceptions, and conformance; maintain an auditable record of key decisions, risks, and trade-offs.

**Solution Design**

* Design cloud-native solutions using distributed systems, microservices, API-first and event-driven integration, containers, Kubernetes, and managed or serverless services; define data flows and architecture contracts.
* Design multi-tenant cloud services with tenant isolation, identity and access management, network security, data protection, and regional deployment; extend these controls to AI agents and tool access.
* Define scalability, availability, and performance requirements, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, disaster recovery, backup and restore, and failure testing across cloud services and integrations.
* Optimize cloud consumption through workload sizing, autoscaling, managed-service selection, FinOps, and cost-performance trade-offs, including model and tool usage costs for AI workloads.
* Enable safe platform evolution through API and service versioning, backward compatibility, data migration, and low-downtime deployment, including lifecycle management of integrated models and agents.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Accelerate cloud delivery with reusable reference architectures, platform services, infrastructure as code, and automation; enable AI-assisted development, testing, and documentation with engineering review and quality controls.
* Embed automated security and quality checks, deployment automation, and production observability into DevSecOps and CI/CD; track reliability, performance, cost, and architecture health, with evaluation gates for AI-enabled features.
* Lead production readiness and incident learning for business-critical cloud services; prioritize technical debt, platform modernization, systemic risks, and cross-team dependencies with engineering leaders.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, UX, System Architecture, and Cyber Security to translate business needs into cloud solutions and enterprise integrations, identifying suitable opportunities for AI-enabled workflows.
* Communicate architecture strategy, investment options, and trade-offs to senior leadership, linking platform investments to product outcomes, risk, and total cost of ownership; serve as the technical escalation point for cross-cutting decisions.

**Technology Strategy & AI Enablement**

* Define the cloud modernization and AI-enablement roadmap for CLSS; evaluate emerging technologies and prototype generative and Agentic AI use cases, including retrieval, orchestration, and tool integration, before production adoption.
* Establish responsible AI adoption guardrails for agent autonomy, human oversight, permissions, data access, prompt and model security, auditability, and regulatory compliance.

**Mentorship & Talent Development**

Build cloud architecture and AI-enabled engineering capability through mentoring, design coaching, and reusable guidance; lead a distributed architecture community supporting technical leadership development and succession.  



**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

**Experience & Key Skills**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in architecture, technical leadership, or solution design roles.
* Proven experience as a principal or lead architect delivering business-critical enterprise cloud platforms, with practical understanding of infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, and disaster recovery.
* Deep expertise in public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS, distributed systems, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, managed or serverless services, API and event-driven integration, data architecture, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* AI-enabled development and architecture skills, including AI-assisted engineering and hands-on Agentic AI integration: large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, tool use, lifecycle management, evaluation, and responsible AI controls within cloud platforms.
* Ability to align engineers and senior stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority, and clearly communicate architecture trade-offs, investment options, and risk decisions.
* Strong record of managing architecture decisions and technical risk when modernizing live enterprise cloud platforms and introducing new capabilities, including AI where appropriate.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Billing Ops Payment Lifecycle Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Join a team shaping the future of digital payments and drive your professional growth. Become a pivotal leader at the forefront of revolutionizing payment operations, where your expertise will help drive efficiency across our financial systems.  
  
As a Payment Lifecycle Associate II within Payments Operations, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our payment operations framework by streamlining processes, implementing new technologies, and developing operational functions. You will manage payment processing across various products, ensuring smooth fund transfers and reconciling purchase and sales options, futures, or securities, while leveraging your proficiency in automation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud awareness to ensure security and efficiency. Your ability to manage stakeholders, influence decisions, and handle conflicts will drive mutually beneficial outcomes, and your strategic planning skills will guide our direction and resource allocation decisions. Additionally, your proficiency in AI/ML will be utilized to solve complex problems and enhance processes, applying your knowledge in market product and process improvement to optimize our operations.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Lead the day-to-day **Invoice Clearing operations**, ensuring incoming payments are accurately and promptly matched and applied to outstanding invoices within established service levels and control requirements.
* Manage team capacity, productivity and daily work allocation, adjusting resources and priorities based on transaction volumes, ageing, risk and operational requirements.
* Monitor key performance and control indicators, including payment-matching timelines, outstanding and aged items, unmatched or unapplied payments, exceptions and processing errors.
* Drive the timely investigation and resolution of payment breaks and exceptions by coordinating with Billing, Operations, Finance, Client Service and other relevant stakeholders.

* Strong understanding of basic accounting principles, particularly payment application and reconciliation.
* Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including team management, performance management, coaching, mentoring and employee development.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with the ability to identify operational risks, control gaps, recurring exceptions and appropriate remediation.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, high transaction volumes, operational deadlines and escalations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to challenge existing processes and drive continuous improvement while maintaining appropriate operational controls.

* Experience in **Securities Services Billing** or a related banking operations environment.
* Knowledge of Securities Services products, including **Custody, Fund Administration and Fund Accounting**.
* Understanding of how billing, invoice-clearing and payment-application activities support Securities Services businesses.
* Experience managing unmatched payments, unapplied cash, ageing, reconciliation breaks and complex payment exceptions.

title: Machine Learning Manager (AI)
description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an AI & Machine Learning Manager with strong hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, data science and enterprise solution delivery. The role requires a techno-functional leader who can engage business stakeholders, identify high-value AI opportunities, shape solution architecture and guide engineering teams through development, deployment and adoption.

The candidate must combine sound technical judgement with business understanding. They will lead the end-to-end delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready AI solutions, while remaining close enough to the technology to review designs, challenge implementation choices and guide teams on engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**AI Strategy & Business Alignment**

* Work with business leaders and domain teams to identify, assess and prioritise AI/ML opportunities based on business value, feasibility, risk and expected return.
* Translate business problems into clear AI use cases, functional requirements, solution options, delivery plans and measurable success criteria.
* Define AI roadmaps and support business cases, proof-of-concept assessments and the transition of successful pilots into production solutions.

**AI/ML Solution Design & Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, testing and deployment of machine learning, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and Generative AI solutions.
* Guide the development of LLM-based applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, conversational systems and intelligent automation solutions.
* Provide hands-on technical direction across the AI lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, evaluation, integration and production release.
* Review solution designs, model approaches, code quality and deployment plans; resolve technical issues and guide teams on sound engineering practices.

**Architecture, Platforms & MLOps**

* Define and govern scalable AI solution architectures across cloud and enterprise platforms, with attention to performance, reliability, security and cost.
* Establish MLOps practices for model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and lifecycle management.
* Promote reusable components, model-serving patterns, prompt templates, evaluation frameworks and AI accelerators to improve delivery quality and speed.
* Work with data engineering, cloud, application, security and infrastructure teams to ensure reliable integration with enterprise systems and data platforms.

**Techno-Functional & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are reflected in solution design and delivery.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirement workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations and design discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Explain technical options, trade-offs, limitations, risks and expected outcomes in clear business terms, including to senior management.
* Drive user adoption, change management and the integration of AI solutions into business processes.

**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop AI engineers, ML engineers, data scientists and solution architects; set clear technical and delivery expectations.
* Own delivery planning, estimation, prioritisation, sprint execution, dependencies, risks and issue resolution across AI initiatives.
* Track delivery milestones, model quality, system performance, user adoption and business impact; drive corrective action where required.
* Build a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, documentation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

**AI Governance, Risk & Responsible AI**

* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy, security, explainability, fairness and human oversight into AI solution design and delivery.
* Establish controls for model validation, data usage, access, auditability, monitoring and change management in line with enterprise policies and applicable regulations.
* Work with risk, legal, compliance and information security teams to assess AI risks and support governance reviews before and after deployment.

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Substantial professional experience in AI/ML engineering, data science, Generative AI or enterprise technology delivery, including experience leading technical teams or complex initiatives.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, NLP, predictive modelling and Generative AI, with the ability to guide implementation decisions.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and practical experience with relevant AI/ML libraries and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn.
* Practical experience designing and delivering LLM-based applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search and AI agent patterns.
* Working knowledge of model evaluation, validation, deployment, monitoring, model drift and lifecycle management.
* Experience with MLOps concepts and tools for experiment tracking, model registry, CI/CD, deployment and production monitoring.
* Ability to elicit and analyse business requirements, define functional and non-functional needs, and convert them into technical designs and delivery plans.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, managing expectations, explaining technical trade-offs and presenting solution recommendations.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, delivery management and team leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications & Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric; equivalent AWS or Google Cloud experience is also relevant.
* Hands-on exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, vector databases and agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with MLflow, Azure ML, Kubeflow, Databricks Model Serving or comparable MLOps platforms.
* Experience delivering enterprise solutions in BFSI, insurance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing or other regulated environments.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI frameworks, model risk management, explainability, fairness testing and AI governance.
* Relevant cloud, AI engineering, machine learning or Databricks certifications.

**Core Technology Landscape**
-----------------------------

Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow | scikit-learn | NLP | Deep Learning | Predictive Analytics | Generative AI | LLMs | Azure OpenAI | Azure AI Foundry | Azure Machine Learning | Databricks | MLflow | RAG | Embeddings | Vector Databases | LangChain | LlamaIndex | Semantic Kernel | AI Agents | Prompt Engineering | MLOps | Model Serving | Git | CI/CD | Azure DevOps | Cloud Platforms | Power BI | Microsoft Fabric

title: AI Governance, Senior Associate
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We’re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.  
  
As a member of the Huron corporate team, you’ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.  
  
Join our team and create your future.

As AI adoption accelerates across the firm, an AI Governance Sr. Associate is needed to identify and refine the security controls, governance processes, and risk assessment practices necessary to ensure Huron leverages AI technologies in a manner that is consistent with our existing commitments to Privacy and Security.  
  
Description  
  
This individual is responsible for developing a scaled and consistent approach to: AI security controls, governance processes, risk assessments, and standards. The role requires close coordination with stakeholders across IT, Legal, Procurement, and the business units to ensure AI initiatives are evaluated for risk early, governed consistently, and supported with clear, practical standards and safeguards. The individual should be comfortable operating in an evolving regulatory and technical landscape, translating emerging AI risk concepts into practical governance structures that all stakeholders can rapidly adopt.

Key Responsibilities

AI security controls

* Develop and maintain security controls that are consistent with existing Huron standards specific to AI, including but not limited to agents, systems, models, AI-enabled tools, data handling, access, and use.
* Partner with IT and AI Business Teams to embed security requirements into AI development, procurement, and deployment workflows.
* Evaluate third-party AI tools and vendors for security and data handling risk, in coordination with the third-party risk function.
* Monitor the AI threat landscape and recommend control updates as new risks and techniques emerge.

Governance processes and standards

title: AI & Machine Learning Manager (Techno-Functional)
description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an AI & Machine Learning Manager with strong hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI, data science and enterprise solution delivery. The role requires a techno-functional leader who can engage business stakeholders, identify high-value AI opportunities, shape solution architecture and guide engineering teams through development, deployment and adoption.

The candidate must combine sound technical judgement with business understanding. They will lead the end-to-end delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready AI solutions, while remaining close enough to the technology to review designs, challenge implementation choices and guide teams on engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**AI Strategy & Business Alignment**

* Work with business leaders and domain teams to identify, assess and prioritise AI/ML opportunities based on business value, feasibility, risk and expected return.
* Translate business problems into clear AI use cases, functional requirements, solution options, delivery plans and measurable success criteria.

* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are reflected in solution design and delivery.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirement workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations and design discussions with business and technology stakeholders.

* Lead, mentor and develop AI engineers, ML engineers, data scientists and solution architects; set clear technical and delivery expectations.

* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy, security, explainability, fairness and human oversight into AI solution design and delivery.

title: Principal Engineer - AI ML and Cloud Security
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Domain focus: AI Platform & Cloud Security (CSPM, shadow AI and agent risk tiering across Azure and GCP).**

**Job Purpose**:

Support the AI Platform and Cloud Security team, which governs AI tool security posture and provides cloud security advisory across Azure and GCP. Hands-on analytical work: the shadow AI register, CSPM analysis, agent risk-tiering, and the findings and reporting the team governs through.

**About the team**:

AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US.

**What makes this role different. Hands-on analytical work in a team that advises and flags but does not remediate — the Azure and GCP platform teams own every fix you identify, so your influence comes from the quality of the finding and your persistence in chasing it, not from authority. You will run CSPM analysis in Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind, maintain the shadow AI register, and apply agent risk-tiering to AI deployments that are moving faster than the governance around them. Comfort with being the person who raises the problem and cannot close it is essential.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Run CSPM analysis across Azure and GCP in Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind, and produce findings clear enough for a platform team to act on without a follow-up meeting.
* Maintain the shadow AI register and run the discovery scans that populate it, across sanctioned and unsanctioned AI tooling.
* Apply agent and model risk-tiering to AI deployments and track each assessment through to a governance decision.
* Support LLM and API exposure risk assessments with analysis and evidence, referencing MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Support cloud IAM and entitlement review packs, including CIEM analysis of over-permissioned identities, and track outcomes to closure.
* Track remediation owned by the Azure and GCP platform teams and business units, and escalate where it stalls — this team advises and flags, it does not remediate.
* Produce KPI data and build Power BI dashboards for cloud and AI security posture, including drift against configuration baselines.
* Improve the team's analysis and reporting through automation in Python rather than only running it.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Design and build the automation and tooling that produces the posture, shadow AI and agent risk picture, documenting the trade-offs made rather than only operating what others built.
* Mentor junior analysts and engineers on cloud and AI posture work, and review their output before it is relied on.
* Apply GxP and data integrity expectations to posture reporting that covers validated systems.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 10+ years in cloud or platform security in a regulated environment — domain focus: AI Platform & Cloud Security (CSPM, shadow AI and agent risk tiering across Azure and GCP)
* CSPM analysis across Azure and GCP using Prisma Cloud, Wiz or Upwind — findings platform teams can act on, with remediation they own chased and escalated
* Maintaining the shadow AI register populated by discovery programmes — classifying AI tools, copilots and LLM APIs by data exposure and risk — and tracking agent risk-tiering to decision
* Analysing LLM and AI API exposure across Azure and GCP — Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, model endpoints, keys and network exposure — and supporting cloud IAM review packs
* Python, SQL or scripting for posture data, producing AI and cloud security KPIs and dashboards with audit-ready accuracy

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Cloud security certification such as CCSP, AZ-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* AI security posture management (AI-SPM) tooling and LLM API risk assessment
* Power BI or equivalent dashboarding
* Cloud IAM and AI/LLM security awareness

* Clear written findings and stakeholder communication with platform engineering teams
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: CSPM platforms including Prisma Cloud, Wiz and Upwind, Azure and GCP native security services, cloud infrastructure entitlement management, container and Kubernetes security, shadow AI discovery tooling, model and agent risk tiering, LLM and API exposure assessment, Python for analysis and automation.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, AI Platforms, Application Security, Cloud Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, LLM Orchestration, Microsoft Azure, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Sonrai CSPM, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

The deepest hands-on engineering role in AI Engineering. You personally build the most complex AI solutions Cyber Architecture and Solutions delivers, lead the hardest engineering problems in the agentic framework, and develop the reusable components the rest of the team builds on.

**About the team**:

AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Personally build the most complex AI solutions Cyber Architecture and Solutions delivers, using LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases and production Python.
