* Agent build in production Python and Kubernetes — LLM integration, prompt-to-action engineering, LangChain or LlamaIndex orchestration, tool and function calling, and evaluation of non-deterministic output
* RAG pipeline engineering end to end — chunking and embedding strategy, vector database and index design, retrieval tuning and evaluation, hallucination and grounding checks
* LLM application security in code — direct and indirect prompt injection defences, output validation, secrets handling, tool-call allow-listing and audit logging
* Delivering to architecture specification with tests and documentation to vendor-handover standard — raising design problems back to architecture rather than engineering around them, and mentoring analysts

* CI/CD pipelines for AI and ML platforms
* LLM evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent), fine-tuning and prompt optimisation
* AI red-teaming tools such as Garak or PyRIT
* Cloud platform engineering on Azure or GCP

**Domain focus: AI Agent Engineering (agent layer of the agentic framework); hands-on leadership of an agent engineering team (build, not design).**

**Job Purpose:**

  

Own the agent layer of the agentic framework — the build, not the design. You run the agent development pipeline: LLM integration, prompt-to-action engineering, agent evaluation and testing, and the reusable agent components the rest of the function depends on. You build GenAI security use cases including alert triage automation and threat summarisation.

**About the team.** AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. * Mentor the agent engineers and set the engineering standard for the agent layer by example — code review, evaluation discipline and documentation quality.
* Apply GxP and data integrity expectations to agents that touch validated systems or the records they produce.

* 15+ years in cyber security or AI engineering in a regulated environment — domain focus: AI Agent Engineering (agent layer of the agentic framework); hands-on leadership of an agent engineering team (build, not design)
* Agent engineering depth — LLM integration, prompt-to-action engineering, multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, memory and state management, RAG retrieval, prompt and model version control and reusable agent components
* Agent safety engineering — evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic behaviour, red-team testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, containment and rollback
* Building GenAI security use cases — alert triage automation, threat summarisation and automated investigation — from architecture specification to production, integrated cleanly with the AI platform layer
* Applying binding AI security standards to every agent — tool-invocation control, identity binding and least-privilege scoping — and preparing handover packages for a managed service

* Agent observability, audit traceability and guardrails
* AI red-teaming tools such as Garak or PyRIT
* Agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel or CrewAI

title: Mgr, Quality/Training Strategy, GO-AI Operations Integration
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality.  
  
As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output.

  

* Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces.

  

* Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality.

  

* Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews.

  

* Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation.

  

* Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output.

  

* Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience.

  

* Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure.

  
About the team  
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of team management experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
* Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or ML data quality.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent process improvement certification
* Experience designing measurement or audit frameworks at scale
* Experience applying GenAI or LLM-based tools to improve operational metrics
* Experience operating as an independent quality assurance function alongside an operations organization

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Scope: AI applications, agents, copilots, machine learning systems and AI platforms, built in-house or provided by vendors, including GxP-regulated uses.

* AI Security Risk Assessments: Assess AI systems for AI-specific threats, such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model theft, sensitive data leakage and agents acting beyond their intended authority, and evaluate attack surface and control effectiveness.

* Security Risk Treatment & Reporting: Document findings and recommendations; assess residual risk and treatment options; facilitate risk acceptance decisions with system owners; track findings through remediation; and produce clear reports and executive summaries.
* Frameworks & Compliance: Assess alignment with NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, the EU AI Act and Astellas AI policies; support audits; and maintain the AI risk assessment method and procedures.

  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.
* 8+ years in cybersecurity risk, GRC or security assessment.
* 5+ years assessing AI or cloud-based technologies.
* Good understanding of AI security threats and attack techniques.
* Strong report writing and the ability to explain risk to business and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in vendor or technology risk management, ideally using OneTrust.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with threat modeling and risk quantification methods (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, FAIR).

* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

description:

Your role  
Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Develop and enhance AI agent skills for PSoC™ devices using ModusToolbox™, including peripheral and clock configuration, low-power operation, capacitive touch sensing, connectivity features, and driver integration.

* Support firmware development, migration, and porting activities across Infineon MCU platforms.

Your profile  
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* 8–12 years of hands-on embedded software development experience, primarily in C, targeting Arm Cortex-M or comparable MCU platforms from any semiconductor vendor, with expertise in both bare-metal and RTOS-based environments such as FreeRTOS.
* Proven track record of delivering firmware for at least one battery-operated, connected consumer, or IoT product that has been successfully deployed.

* Design and implementation of automated testing frameworks for evaluating and validating AI-generated code.
* Experience with Machine Learning on MCUs, including frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers or NPUs like Arm Ethos-U.
* Familiarity with Zephyr RTOS, Matter, and Thread protocols.
* Knowledge of embedded graphics, human-machine interfaces (HMI), or audio processing applications on MCU platforms.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

AI Risk Engineer on Chevron’s Responsible AI (RAI) team partners with business and IT development teams to help ensure that AI and machine learning systems—including third-party tools, generative AI, and AI agents—are fair, transparent, accountable, secure, and aligned with Chevron’s ethical principles. Working at the intersection of AI/ML engineering, ethics, and policy, you will build and maintain the automation, scripts, and tooling that power Chevron’s AI impact assessment process, and help operationalize Responsible AI controls within our AI governance platform (Credo AI). You will collaborate closely with our Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy teams to ensure that AI solutions, vendors, and internal use cases adhere to Chevron guidelines, policies, and emerging regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build, maintain, and enhance the automation flows, scripts, and tooling that support Chevron’s AI impact assessment and Responsible AI review processes.
* Configure and administer Chevron’s AI governance platform (Credo AI)—adding risk scenarios, controls, and review workflows that enable teams to document mitigations, provide evidence, and track AI risks across the lifecycle.
* Design and operate review and approval checkpoints, including pre-production questionnaires and periodic re-reviews of AI use cases, streamlining through automation where possible.
* Establish and run model review processes for both pre-trained/foundation models and custom-built machine learning models.
* Assist in AI Discovery and maintain an inventory of AI models, agents, and use cases across the enterprise, ensuring proper documentation and lifecycle governance.
* Conduct ethical risk assessments and impact analyses for AI use cases, including alignment with regulations such as the EU AI Act and industry frameworks such as the IOGP Responsible Use of AI principles, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
* Evaluate AI vendors, models, and external AI access requests for fairness, security, and policy compliance, partnering with Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy.
* Influence the development and adoption of tools and methodologies to detect and mitigate bias, drift, and unintended consequences in machine learning and generative AI systems.
* Lead training, FAQs, and awareness campaigns—leveraging Teams and Copilot—to promote ethical AI practices and communicate process changes across business units.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate Responsible AI principles into product development and deployment workflows.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data science, analytics, or AI/ML engineering roles.
* Proficiency in Python and experience building automation, scripts, or data pipelines that integrate with enterprise platforms and APIs.
* Demonstrated ability to reason through ethical implications of AI systems and articulate trade-offs.
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams (e.g., cybersecurity, legal, privacy, policy) to embed Responsible AI principles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and enterprise compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, NIST, OECD).

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Python,Responsible AI,AI Governance

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

AI for Cybersecurity

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certifications in Responsible AI, Data/AI Ethics, Cybersecurity, or AI Governance.
* Experience developing and evaluating machine learning models using Python and libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI frameworks, tools, or applications, and with governing AI agents (e.g., agent registries, Microsoft Agents 365).
* Experience with AI governance or model-risk platforms (e.g., Credo AI) and workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate, Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of fairness, interpretability, and robustness techniques in AI.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure ML / Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, DataRobot).
* Familiarity with emerging AI regulations and industry frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, IOGP Responsible Use of AI).

* Proven ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments and make connections between disparate data sources.
* **Must-have:**Python; familiarity AI system implementation; familiarity with policies related to AI governance

  **Good-to-have:**certification in RAI, data/AI ethics, cybersecurity, or AI governance; Oil & Gas domain.

title: AI Copywriter
description:
**We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**

  

GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.

  

Then AI changed what "**upskilling**" even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not.

  

So, we built **Outskill**, our AI education arm, to close that gap, practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today Outskill is one of the largest AI education companies in the world: **16M+ learners across 160+ countries**, and programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation.

  

**Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028.**

  

**What that actually feels like day to day:** we're 300+ people, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.

  

If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.

  

**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------

AI is moving faster than most people can keep up with.

Every day, new models, tools, products, and ideas emerge. But knowing what happened is only half the story. The real skill lies in finding the right angle, understanding why something matters, and communicating it in a way that makes people want to read, watch, and learn more.

We're looking for someone who reads extensively, has strong English, understands storytelling, and can turn complex ideas into compelling content.

Someone who doesn't simply write words, but understands how ideas travel, what captures attention, and what makes content memorable.

**This is an opportunity to build, experiment, and develop your craft as part of Outskill's content team.**

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **1. Content & Copywriting**

* Write engaging content around AI, technology, and emerging developments.
* Turn complex ideas into clear, accessible, and compelling stories.
* Develop strong hooks, headlines, narratives, and angles.
* Experiment with different writing styles, formats, and approaches.
* Edit and refine content to improve clarity, accuracy, and readability.

### **2. Research & Storytelling**

* Explore interesting ideas and developments across the AI ecosystem.
* Understand the context behind what you're writing.
* Find perspectives that make a topic more interesting and valuable.
* Translate research into content that informs and engages.
* Collaborate with the team to develop new content ideas.

### **3. AI-Native Content Creation**

* Experiment with AI tools for research, writing, editing, and ideation.
* Build workflows that improve content quality and speed.
* Understand how to use AI without making content sound generic.
* Explore new formats and approaches to content creation.

### **4. Experimentation & Ownership**

* Test different hooks, narratives, and content formats.
* Learn from feedback and audience responses.
* Contribute ideas and take ownership of content projects.
* Help improve how the team researches, creates, and distributes content.

**What You Should Look For**
----------------------------

We're looking for someone who:

* Has strong written English and a genuine love for reading.
* Understands what makes content interesting and engaging.
* Has an instinct for storytelling, hooks, and headlines.
* Can explain complex ideas in simple language.
* Is curious about AI and emerging technologies.
* Understands internet culture and how ideas spread online.
* Enjoys experimenting and improving through feedback.
* Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions at every step.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience writing scripts, articles, social posts, or other content.
* A portfolio, personal blog, or published work.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity.
* An understanding of social media and content distribution.
* Experience working with a content or marketing team.

**What You'll Get Out of This**
-------------------------------

* Work directly with Outskill's content team.
* Develop your writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment.
* Build a deeper understanding of AI and its applications.
* Experiment with AI-powered content workflows.
* Take ownership of meaningful projects.
* Learn how research, content, and distribution work together.

**The Bottom Line**
-------------------

If you love reading, writing, discovering interesting ideas, and finding better ways to communicate them, this could be for you.

You don't need to know everything about AI or have years of professional experience.

**You need curiosity, strong writing instincts, and the willingness to keep experimenting.**

### **4. Experimentation & Building**

* Build repeatable research workflows.
* Explore new ways to track developments and identify interesting stories.
* Test different approaches to analysing and explaining AI developments.

**What You Should Look For**
----------------------------

We're looking for someone who:

* Loves reading and exploring new ideas.
* Enjoys spending time on Twitter/X, Reddit, Substack, and other online communities.
* Wants to understand how things work, not just what happened.
* Can evaluate sources and distinguish evidence from speculation.
* Has strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Can communicate findings clearly.
* Questions assumptions and develops independent perspectives.
* Takes initiative and enjoys investigating questions independently.

### **Good to Have**

* Familiarity with AI researchers, founders, developers, and companies.
* An interest in research papers, technical blogs, and AI communities.
* Experience exploring AI tools and experimenting with them.
* Experience writing research notes, articles, or explainers.
* Personal projects or collections of interesting discoveries.
* An understanding of how the AI ecosystem evolves.

**What You'll Get Out of This**
-------------------------------

* Build a deeper understanding of AI and the people shaping it.
* Work directly with Outskill's content team.
* Develop your research, analytical thinking, and communication skills.
* Learn to identify meaningful developments and connect ideas.
* Experiment with AI tools and build better research workflows.
* Take ownership of research projects and develop areas of expertise.
* Turn your curiosity into insights that help people understand AI.

**The Bottom Line**
-------------------

If you love exploring the internet, reading about new technologies, discovering interesting ideas, and understanding how things connect, this could be for you.

You don't need to know everything about AI. You need the curiosity to investigate, the patience to understand, and the ability to explain what you've discovered.

**You'll have the opportunity to turn curiosity into insight and help Outskill make sense of the AI world.**

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
About ECI
  
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
  
At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by our commitment to empowering our employees around the world.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**  
ECI has an exciting opportunity for a Network Operation Center Engineer - Monitoring, who will be responsible for providing 24x7 monitoring, operations, and support services for our global customers.
  
  
In this role, you will troubleshoot network and system devices, support LAN/WAN infrastructure, and respond to Level 1 and 2 service tickets. You will collaborate closely with your team and escalate issues to higher support levels as needed.
  
  
This is an onsite role.
  
  
**What you will do:**  

* Resolve Level 1 and 2 network and system support cases, incidents, and work orders related to end-user issues, both on-premises and in cloud infrastructure, following ECI-defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring a customer-centric approach. Manage incidents via the ServiceNow tool and adhere to client escalation procedures while handling direct customer calls.
* Validate incidents and requests from a centralized management system, addressing issues such as alarm verification, routing protocol/switching issues, connectivity problems, and hardware impairments.
* Perform initial troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network or system events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control processes for network device changes, IOS upgrades, disk expansions, and reboots, ensuring client approvals are obtained.
* Provide quality, timely, and accurate end-to-end support for all issues within your functional area, including documentation and tracking in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage third parties, such as ISPs, for circuit impairments and hardware/bandwidth issues.
* Coordinate continuously with collaboration teams and respond to emails promptly, ensuring clear communication with stakeholders.
* Provide input and feedback for the development and improvement of the department and ECI.

**Who you are:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience in network and system support and monitoring.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical information to non-technical audiences and summarize key information effectively.
* Proficient problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to analyze system problems and drive corrective actions.
* Good documentation skills and the ability to absorb and retain information quickly.
* Highly self-motivated and directed, willing to work in a 24x7x365 environment.
* Experience in configuration, management, and monitoring of routers, switches, Cisco ASA, FTDs, Palo Alto firewalls, and Meraki WLCs.
* Familiarity with server/workstation support, including Active Directory, LDAP, WMI, and SNMP in Windows and Linux environments.

Teradata delivers real business value with AI.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

We are seeking a strong technology leader as Director role to lead the strategy, development, and operation of Teradata Active Compute cloud platform. This leader will be responsible for building a highly scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient compute foundation for enterprise analytics, AI/ML, and data workloads across multiple public clouds.

Our cloud product is an enterprise-grade Teradata cloud data warehouse/analytics platform. We call it the active compute platform, which runs on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and is aimed at large, mission-critical workloads where predictable performance, governance, security, and workload management matter. Typical workloads include Enterprise data warehousing, Business intelligence and reporting, Large-scale SQL analytics, Customer/marketing analytics, Financial and operational analytics, Production ML/AI workloads, and Mixed workloads that need strong workload management.

Teradata improved its product portfolio and introduced additional compute capabilities as part of its newer Autonomous Knowledge Platform / Teradata Cloud architecture. The key idea is to have two different kinds of compute in the same governed environment rather than forcing every workload into one compute model. The product is intended for workloads that need to be available continuously and have predictable performance.

The leader we are looking for needs to help Teradata position itself not merely as a cloud data warehouse, but as an enterprise compute/data/AI platform where production and experimental workloads can coexist without compromising either performance or cost control.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the technical strategy and roadmap for Teradata Cloud Platform.
* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for compute orchestration, provisioning, scaling, workload management, reliability, and observability.
* Deliver a seamless experience across always-on production workloads and elastic, on-demand workloads.

The ideal leader we are looking for is a hands-on technical leader who combines deep distributed systems expertise with strong product and organizational leadership. They should be comfortable operating at the architecture level while also building teams, managing execution, and shaping the long-term strategy for enterprise cloud compute. This leader must embrace AI-driven development as a catalyst for engineering velocity and innovation, while fostering a results-oriented culture that encourages creative thinking, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

title: Junior Data Scincetist
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role:**

To contribute to the end-to-end development and product lifecycle management of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) systems as part of an R&D organization. The Junior Data Scientist supports the definition of intended algorithm performance, the development and curation of representative data and annotations, the development of AI/ML algorithms, and the generation of scientific evidence demonstrating stand-alone algorithm performance.

The candidate is expected to:

* Apply scientific, statistical, machine learning, and software engineering methods to develop and evaluate AI/ML algorithm components for defined product use cases.
* Work with experienced Data Scientists, product management, clinical or domain experts, software developers, and quality and regulatory functions to translate customer needs and the intended use into measurable algorithm performance targets.
* Support the definition, sourcing, curation, documentation, and maintenance of representative data cohorts and annotations required for training, tuning, and evaluation.
* Plan and execute reproducible scientific evaluations that provide objective evidence of algorithm performance, limitations, and suitability for the intended use.
* Contribute the Data Science work products and evidence required for integration of AI/ML algorithm components into products and for their verification, validation, regulatory release, and lifecycle monitoring.

**What are my responsibilities?**

As a Junior Data Scientist, you are required to:

* Support the finalization of product and algorithm concepts by translating customer needs, intended use, clinical or technical requirements, and applicable regulatory considerations into measurable state-of-the-art performance targets.
* Contribute to the definition of the AI/ML development and scientific evaluation strategy for assigned algorithm components under the guidance of experienced Data Scientists.
* Perform exploratory data analysis and data risk assessments to identify data gaps, quality issues, potential bias, confounding factors, outliers, and limitations that may affect algorithm development or evaluation.
* Define and document data needs for training, tuning, and evaluation, including relevant subgroups and acceptance criteria, so that data cohorts are representative of the intended use and aligned with the product and regulatory strategy.
* Support the specification of annotations, acceptance criteria, and quality controls; collaborate with qualified internal or external suppliers on sourcing data and annotations.
* Curate, version, maintain, and document representative data cohorts and ensure data provenance, traceability, quality, and fitness for purpose together with data management stakeholders.
* Design, implement, train, tune, and technically characterize AI/ML algorithm components using appropriate machine learning, deep learning, statistical, or generative AI methods.
* Define scientifically justified metrics, evaluation methods, test cases, and acceptance criteria to assess stand-alone algorithm performance, including relevant aspects such as accuracy, robustness, reliability, generalizability, explainability, bias, and subgroup performance.
* Implement and execute reproducible bench tests on representative evaluation cohorts and relevant subgroups as part of the verification and validation strategy.
* Analyze and interpret evaluation results, investigate failure modes, document residual limitations, and derive evidence-based recommendations for algorithm improvement and product decisions.
* Document development and evaluation activities and contribute to Data Science work products such as data management information, annotation specifications, scientific evaluation test cases, and scientific evaluation reports.
* Provide scientific evidence and technical input for product reviews and regulatory submissions and support responses to questions concerning data, annotations, evaluation methods, and stand-alone algorithm performance.
* Support the design and execution of clinical investigations, reader studies, or other studies when additional evidence is required by the product or regulatory strategy.
* Collaborate with software engineering and MLOps functions to establish reproducible pipelines, versioned artifacts, automated tests, controlled deployment, and integration of algorithm components into the product.
* Help define and implement monitoring metrics for detecting data anomalies, outliers, and algorithm performance drift across the product lifecycle.
* Regularly review advances in Data Science and AI and assess their applicability to the development and evaluation of AI/ML products.

**Qualification:**

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Informatics, or a related quantitative or engineering field. A Ph.D. is welcome but not required. The candidate should have completed university-level coursework or equivalent practical training in:

* Probability, statistics, and experimental design
* Artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning
* Linear algebra, optimization, and numerical methods
* Data structures, algorithms, and software programming
* Model evaluation, scientific methodology, and interpretation of empirical results

**Experience level:**

This is a junior R&D position. Relevant experience may have been gained through academic research, a thesis, internships, working-student assignments, or up to approximately three years of professional work in Data Science, machine learning, AI research, or AI/ML product development. Demonstrated hands-on experience in developing and scientifically evaluating AI/ML models is more important than a specific number of years.

**Desired Knowledge & Experience:**

* Sound understanding of machine learning, deep learning, statistical analysis, experimental design, and model evaluation.
* Active programming skills in Python and practical experience with libraries and frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
* Hands-on experience with the development workflow of AI/ML models, including data preparation, training, tuning, evaluation, error analysis, reproducibility, and documentation.

* Understanding of data quality, representativeness, bias, annotation quality, data provenance, and traceability in AI/ML development.
* Knowledge of Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) concepts and tooling, including source and data versioning, reproducible pipelines, experiment tracking, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring.
* Hands-on exposure to current Large Language Models and Generative AI, including foundation models, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and model adaptation or fine-tuning.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI, including tool-using models, multi-step workflows, orchestration, memory, and autonomous or semi-autonomous decision paths, is an advantage.
* Experience or strong interest in the systematic evaluation of LLM, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, including task-specific benchmarks, groundedness and factuality, robustness, reproducibility, human evaluation, safety and guardrail testing, tool-use correctness, and analysis of failure modes.
* Experience with databases and query languages such as SQL; knowledge of Kusto Query Language, Snowflake, or graph databases such as Neo4j is an advantage.
* Exposure to cloud-based data and AI environments, preferably Microsoft Azure, such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Monitor, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with structured and unstructured data, for example machine logs, event data, Parquet files, text data, or multimodal data.
* Knowledge of healthcare, medical technology, clinical data, or interoperability standards such as DICOM is preferred.
* Basic project management skills and familiarity with working in cross-functional R&D or product-development teams.

**Required Soft Skills & Other Capabilities:**

* Scientific mindset, strong analytical ability, and attention to detail.
* Commitment to objective evidence, reproducibility, traceability, data integrity, and responsible AI development.
* Curiosity and resilience to investigate unexpected results, challenge assumptions, and improve models based on evidence.
* Collaborative approach to working with Data Scientists, domain experts, software engineers, product management, and quality and regulatory stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently within an agreed scope and to seek guidance when technical, scientific, product, or regulatory implications require alignment.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain methods, results, uncertainties, limitations, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Lead Analysts - Data Management and Modeling
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for a Lead Data & AI Engineer to build trusted data and semantic foundations that turn enterprise AI into scalable business capability. You will combine data engineering, data-product thinking, dimensional and semantic modelling, application development, AI engineering, and practical data science. You will own delivery from raw data to AI-enabled decisions. This covers medallion architecture, reusable data products, semantic models, agents, and applications.

You will partner early with business, product, Data & Analytics, and technology stakeholders to define outcomes, success measures, and data needs. You will turn ambiguous challenges into technical designs, prototypes, and production solutions, and you will stay involved through adoption and improvement. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with mentoring responsibilities. It has no direct people management.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Deliver production-ready Data & AI solutions, staying hands-on in investigation, architecture, coding, modelling, testing, and implementation.
* Build AI-ready data foundations and agentic solutions grounded in structured data, governed measures, semantic metadata, and enterprise knowledge.
* Build production-ready Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, and tool/API orchestration patterns using enterprise engineering standards.
* Build analytical and AI-enabled applications using Fabric application capabilities, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks, integrated with semantic models, APIs, agents, and enterprise security.
* Build robust ELT/ETL pipelines using Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, dbt, Apache Airflow, or comparable technologies.
* Implement bronze, silver, and gold medallion layers with lineage and auditability. Integrate lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets using batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API patterns.
* Deliver reusable, domain-aligned data products with clear ownership, data contracts, quality controls, documentation, and consumption interfaces.
* Design dimensional models with explicit grain, conformed dimensions, facts, hierarchies, slowly changing dimensions, and bridge and relationship patterns.
* Build and optimize Fabric and Power BI semantic models with governed measures, DAX, relationships, and metadata, so analytics, applications, and AI share consistent business context.
* Explore data, frame hypotheses, engineer features, and apply segmentation, forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection where they support a business decision.
* Evaluate analytical and machine-learning approaches against suitable baselines using statistical reasoning, validation, and business-relevant measures. Explain limitations and integrate useful results into data products or applications.
* Collaborate with data scientists on deeper modelling needs. This is not a dedicated data scientist role.
* Lead end-to-end technical delivery: define scope, estimate and plan work, manage dependencies and risks, coordinate stakeholders, and own release readiness, adoption, and operational handover.
* Mentor engineers through architecture, design, and code reviews, debugging, testing, and production-readiness practices.
* Build data quality, observability, automated testing, lineage, security, privacy, responsible AI, version control, and CI/CD into every stage of delivery.
* Turn successful solutions into reusable data products, semantic assets, agent capabilities, and engineering accelerators.
* Start with the business decision or workflow, and co-shape outcomes, success measures, data needs, and adoption with stakeholders.
* Move from discovery to prototype to production, validating assumptions with real enterprise data and early feedback.
Measure success by business value, trusted metrics, adoption, engineering quality, and reuse. Solve immediate needs while strengthening reusable enterprise foundations.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, AI engineering, or closely related technical roles.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLMs, agents, RAG, and tool/API integration or orchestration.
* Experience building data-driven or AI-enabled applications using Fabric, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable analytical platforms, including lakehouse and warehouse patterns.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience delivering production-grade data solutions.
* Experience delivering data products through bronze, silver, and gold layers, with quality controls, lineage, and clear consumption interfaces.
* Strong dimensional modelling skills, including grain, facts, dimensions, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and many-to-many patterns.
* Proven enterprise semantic modelling experience, including governed business definitions and reusable measures. Proficiency in Power BI, DAX, and performance optimization, or equivalent technologies.
* Working knowledge of exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, feature engineering, and practical predictive methods such as forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection.
* Ability to frame hypotheses, select baselines and evaluation measures, validate results, communicate uncertainty, and work with data scientists on modelling approaches.
* Experience with orchestration, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, data quality, and operational support.
* Ability to lead technical workstreams as a hands-on senior individual contributor and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.
* Experience managing scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, releases, and operational handover, taking solutions from concept through adoption.
Clear communication with technical, business, and senior stakeholder audiences.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Git/GitHub, and automated deployment frameworks.
* Broader Power BI and Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, Direct Lake, and application capabilities.
* Experience with AI solutions grounded in semantic models, metadata, knowledge graphs, or governed enterprise data.
* Experience with agentic frameworks, model evaluation, observability, and responsible AI practices.
* Exposure to machine-learning experimentation, feature pipelines, and operationalizing lightweight predictive solutions.
* Knowledge of governance, privacy, security, lineage, and enterprise architecture.
* Experience delivering reusable data products and platforms in Agile or iterative models.
* Experience designing data contracts and consumption interfaces that enable reuse across analytics, applications, and AI solutions.
* Experience integrating lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets through batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API-based patterns, with end-to-end lineage and auditability.
* Experience optimizing dimensional and semantic models with conformed dimensions, hierarchies, bridge tables, and complex relationships.
* Experience evaluating analytical and AI-enabled solutions against suitable baselines and business-relevant measures, communicating limitations, and incorporating stakeholder feedback.
* Experience partnering with business and product stakeholders to take ambiguous needs from discovery and prototyping through production adoption and operational handover.
Experience creating reusable engineering accelerators and guiding engineers through architecture reviews, debugging, and production-readiness practices.

title: Engineer I, Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders at the front of the delivery pipeline — embedded with business unit teams, prototyping AI ideas at a days-to-weeks cadence and handing proven solutions off cleanly for scale-up.

The Engineer-I is a mid-level individual contributor in the FDE team. This role contributes to FDE engagements under the direction of more senior FDEs, learning the practice through hands-on work. Most prototyping is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine code, and learning to use them fluently is part of the role. The FDE does not carry use cases to long-term operations — clean handoff is part of the job.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Enterprise AI needs engineers who can contribute to embedded prototype work alongside domain experts. The role builds the pipeline of senior FDE capability the function needs as its portfolio grows.

* **Contributes to prototyping** under the direction of Lead and Senior FDEs — shipping working AI proofs of concept with BU teams.
* **Builds AI-native fluency** using AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows as the default mode of work.
* **Learns the FDE practice** from more senior team members through hands-on engagements and direct mentorship.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**FDE Engagement Contribution**

* **Contribute to BU use case engagements** — prototyping, demoing, refining — under the direction of more senior FDEs.
* **Embed with BU teams** alongside the Lead or Senior FDE, building working relationships with BU engineers and product owners.

**AI-Native Engineering**

* **Operate AI agent workflows** under guidance — contributing to multi-agent prototype delivery.
* **Use AI coding assistants** as the default mode of building; develop genuine fluency with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Databricks AI Assistant.

**Delivery & Handoff**

* **Contribute to clean handoff packages** for the Solutions Engineer — documentation, runbooks, and working software.
* **Apply existing patterns** from the FDE pattern library; contribute small refinements to patterns as experience develops.

**Governance & Learning**

* **Support Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report** conversations during prototyping alongside more senior FDEs.
* **Actively learn the FDE practice** from more senior team members; seek feedback and apply it rapidly.

**Required Experience**

* At least 5+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software.
* Working proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and prompt engineering.
* Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Customer-facing engineering work — startup, lab, or innovation-team background.
* Familiarity with regulated industry constraints.
* Contribution to reusable engineering patterns in a previous team.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**Skills**

AI Frameworks, Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning Algorithms, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Cloud, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including coding experience in Python and SQL.
* Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, Data Catalog, and AlloyDB).
* Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, including architecting data systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
* Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Knowledge of large language model (LLM)-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
* Experience in prompt developing, model evaluation, and the creative application of AI.
* Experience building applications on LLM over enterprise data (e.g., Gemini, agents, RAG, vector search) and evaluating them for quality, latency and cost.
* Experience migrating analytics, Spark or database workloads between platforms with measured cost or performance outcomes.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on the Data Cloud team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB). You will build the data foundations that agents depend on, and train and evaluate machine learning models on customer data. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and ship production data and machine learning workloads with customers, writing, testing, and performance-tuning PySpark, SQL and Python on BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner and AlloyDB.
* Present working proofs with customers’ data, including de-identifying sensitive data (e.g., PCI, PHI).
* Build the data foundation for agentic solutions, including lakehouse architectures, metadata, semantic context, and the access controls that let custom agents act on trusted data.
* Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and agentic components where they improve the customer’s business metric, with evaluation and monitoring in place.
* Refactor and migrate high-cost analytics, Spark and operational database workloads from other platforms onto Google Cloud engines, with measured price-performance results.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Post-doctoral Researcher role is a 12 to 24-month role designed to explore challenging problems for pushing frontiers of AI, while collaborating with DeepMind scientists and engineers. Your role will entail conducting human-computer interaction (HCI) research on how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to increasingly autonomous AI agents, designing and building novel interfaces and interaction techniques for human-agent collaboration, and evaluating them through rigorous user studies. Insights from your work will inform how agents learn from human feedback and remain safe and aligned with human intent, with potential application to products that might have a positive impact on billions of users.

At DeepMind, we're a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts and more, working together to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence, and fulfill our mission of building AI responsibility to benefit humanity. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, and collaborate with others on critical challenges, ensuring safety and ethics are the highest priority.

In particular, our AQUA team at DeepMind India works at the frontier of AI agents, focusing on autonomous self-improvement, reinforcement learning, and the safety and alignment of agents. We build agents that continually improve themselves by learning from their own experience, interactions, and feedback, and we develop methods to ensure that increasingly capable and autonomous agents remain safe, reliable, and aligned with human intent and values. We aim to bring our research into Google's cutting-edge models and products, while also disseminating our findings through publications at top ML conferences/journals.

--------------------

* Prototype novel interfaces and interaction techniques that help people steer, supervise, and collaborate with increasingly autonomous agents. Develop human-centered evaluation methods and metrics for the helpfulness, trustworthiness, safety, and alignment of agents.
* Translate insights from human studies into improvements in how agents learn from human feedback and improve themselves (e.g. reward modeling, preference elicitation, and human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning).

title: ALM Transformation Lead - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Functional Job Title** : Finance CoE-Treasury Asset Liability Management, Associate Vice President

**Reports to :** Finance COE Manager, AVP

**Department/ Division :** Finance CoE, Global Treasury, Asset Liability Management (ALM) Team

  

**Basic Purpose of Job:**

The Asset Liability Management (ALM) team within Global Treasury is responsible for optimizing the company’s balance sheet while maximizing net interest revenue (NIR) within our risk appetite and regulatory constraints. Key functions within ALM include balance sheet and NIR forecasting and interest rate risk (IRR) management which are supported by groups focused on data analytics, balance sheet modeling and senior management and Board reporting. ALM is also responsible for coordinating the company’s deposit pricing strategy, return on capital and funds transfer pricing methodologies and balance sheet strategy. ALM works closely with other functions across Global Treasury, Finance, Risk Management and Business Units.

This role sits at the intersection of Asset Liability Management, quantitative risk, technology, and business intelligence. This is a Senior Analyst contributor role within Treasury responsible for driving the end-to-end modernization of the ALM operating model — migrating manual, spreadsheet-intensive processes onto a cloud-powered, BI-driven platform anchored by QRM as the central calculation engine.

The role accelerates a transformation programme already underway. Immediate priorities include productionalising the Treasury Management Dashboard, executing the QRM Publish to MR integration to create a governed time-series dataset on cloud, and deploying Power BI on structured QRM outputs. Longer-term, the role will extend the ALM modernization model beyond ALM. The successful candidate will combine deep ALM domain expertise with hands-on QRM experience, Power BI or Tableau capability, and cloud data architecture knowledge.

  

### **Responsibilities & Tasks Include:**

**QRM Modernization & Integration**

* Lead the migration of complex Excel-based ALM calculations into QRM, including NII simulation, EVE sensitivity, gap analysis, and liquidity stress testing.

* Own the implementation of the QRM Publish to MR functionality — designing the data flow from QRM outputs back to input transactional data to create a structured, governed time-series dataset on cloud.

* Explore and deploy QRM's attribution walk modules for NII and EVE, enabling waterfall analysis from base to target positions for senior management reporting.

* Manage the end-to-end QRM environment including scenario libraries, behavioural model inputs, repricing terms, and rate assumptions — ensuring all inputs are sourced from the single unified data layer.

**Cloud & Data Architecture**

* Partner with Data and IT functions to design and execute the migration of QRM time-series outputs to cloud storage.

* Define the data architecture that stitches QRM outputs to input transactional data in the cloud, enabling full lineage, audit trail, and automated refresh.

* Establish and govern the single source of truth for ALM data — ensuring all downstream reporting, BI tools, and risk systems consume from one authoritative, reconciled dataset.

**Business Intelligence & Reporting**

* Deploy Power BI dashboards on top of structured QRM outputs and cloud-hosted time-series data, replacing manual Excel-heavy reporting workflows.

* Drive the productionalisation of the Treasury Management Dashboard (TMD), expanding coverage across ALM, Liquidity, CIO, and Capital functions.

* Build self-service reporting capability so analysts can drill into any metric by product, segment, currency, or maturity bucket without IT dependency.

**ALM Process & Analytics**

* Produce NII and EVE attribution analysis that explains rate risk movements driver-by-driver, linking risk metrics directly to commercial margin outcomes.

* Develop time-series analytics and trend reporting to support ALCO and board-level decision making, earnings preparation, and regulatory stress-test readiness.

* Tie interest rate risk reporting to commercial margin metrics on the asset and liability sides of the balance sheet, enabling integrated risk and return analysis.

**Stakeholder Management & Governance**

* Present progress and outcomes directly to the Treasurer, ALCO, and senior management, translating technical developments into business impact.

* Manage relationships with QRM vendors, cloud infrastructure teams (DART/IT), and BI platform owners.

* Track and report against audit findings, MRM items, and model risk governance requirements within the Treasury Management Dashboard

* Support headcount planning, IT budget management, and implementation milestone tracking

### **Job Requirements:**

### **Education and Experience:**

* 8–10 years of experience in Asset & Liability Management, Treasury, or interest rate risk at a bank, custodian, or financial institution

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

* CFA, FRM, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

### **Skills/ Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience with QRM (Quantitative Risk Management) including model configuration, scenario design, NII/EVE simulation, and ideally Publish to MR or attribution modules.

* Demonstrated experience leading or materially contributing to an ALM or treasury technology transformation — not just working within an established model but rebuilding or modernizing one.

* Experience designing or working with cloud-based data architectures for financial risk data — Azure, AWS, or GCP data lake environments.

* Able to take a highly technical QRM output or cloud architecture and communicate the business impact clearly to a Treasurer, CFO, or ALCO board.

* Track record of deploying BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) on large financial datasets to replace manual Excel-driven reporting.

* Comfortably owning a transformation programme end-to-end — from requirements definition through build, parallel run, sign-off, and decommissioning of legacy processes.

* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including IRRBB (BCBS 239), LCR, NSFR, and internal stress testing requirements.

* Surfaces issues early, manages stakeholder expectations transparently, and produces clear written materials for senior audiences without being asked.

* Works effectively across ALM, Liquidity, CIO, and Capital functions as well as IT, Data, Modeling, Risk, Audit, QRM vendor, and BI platform teams — this role is inherently cross-functional

title: Regional Research Economist, Economic Research
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Regional Research Economist at Anthropic, you will collaborate with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region to measure and understand AI’s effects on the economy and explore research-driven policy interventions. You will contribute to the development of the Anthropic Economic Index and its extension to generate regionally relevant insights, establish new methodologies to measure the usage, diffusion, and impact of AI throughout the economy, and work to broaden access to and usage of the insights generated by the Index. You will use frontier methods in econometrics, machine learning, and structural estimation. Such rigor will drive impact, shaping both policy discussions externally and informing Anthropic’s internal business and product decisions.

Our team combines rigorous empirical methods with novel measurement approaches. We’re building first-of-its-kind datasets tracking AI’s impact on labor markets, productivity, and economic transformation. Using our privacy-preserving measurement system (Clio), we analyze millions of real-world AI interactions to understand how AI augments and automates work across different occupations and tasks.

For this role, we’re looking for candidates who can combine rigorous economic analysis with novel measurement approaches to understand AI’s transformative effects on the economy. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at the intersection of empirical economics, technological change, and policy impact.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and maintain relationships with academic institutions, policy think tanks, and other research partners as the primary point of contact for these organizations on economic impact work in your region
* Advance research collaborations that answer country- or regional-specific economic impact questions
* Translate research insights into actionable recommendations for policy discussions
* Make fundamental contributions to the development and expansion of the Anthropic Economic Index, including country- and regional-specific analysis
* Design and collaborate on empirical research on AI’s economic effects with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region
* Develop new methodological approaches, in collaboration with partners in your region, for studying AI’s impact on labor markets and the future of work; productivity and task transformation; economic inequality and displacement; industry-specific disruption and adaptation; and aggregate economic trajectories (GDP, productivity, unemployment) under varying AI-adoption scenarios
* Work cross-functionally with other technical teams to improve our measurement infrastructure and data collection
* Amplify external engagement through research publications, policy briefs, and presentations to diverse stakeholders

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* PhD in Economics
* Strong track record of empirical research, particularly studies combining novel data sources and economic theory or implementing frontier methods in causal inference and machine learning
* Demonstrated experience working in, and relevant relationships across, the region
* Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar tools for large-scale data analysis
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex research projects from conception to publication
* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical findings to diverse audiences
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships across academic, policy, and industry communities

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience relevant to the study of AI’s impact on the economy, such as labor market analysis and occupational change; task-based approaches to technological transformation; large-scale data analysis and econometric methods; large language models for social science research; policy-relevant economic research; experimental and quasi-experimental methods for causal inference; macroeconomic modeling and time series forecasting; or agent-based modeling and large-scale simulation
* Experience working with novel datasets and measurement systems
* Comfort learning new technical tools and frameworks
* Strong interest in ensuring AI development benefits humanity
* Comfort working with AI systems and ability to think critically about their capabilities and limitations

**Representative projects**
---------------------------

* How Australia Uses Claude: Findings from the Anthropic Economic Index
* Anthropic Economic Index Report: Economic Primitives
* Anthropic Economic Index Report: Uneven Geographic and Enterprise AI Adoption
* Estimating AI productivity gains from Claude conversations
* The Anthropic Economic Index

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

**Overview**

The PROSE team is advancing the state of the art in program synthesis and shipping these innovations through flagship Microsoft products that impact millions of users worldwide. These products include the world’s most popular spreadsheet software Excel, the industry-leading IDEs Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code, the power platform suite of products including Power BI, PowerApps, PowerAutomate, and other software tools including Azure Data Studio, Azure Data Monitor, Azure Data Factory, PowerShell, and SQL Server Management Studio. The application domains range from developer productivity, business user low-code/no-code scenarios to even programming education. To power these features PROSE has developed a powerful and flexible framework for program synthesis that leverages techniques from both logical reasoning and machine learning (including LLMs) and combines them in unique ways to synthesize programs automatically. This approach has been recognized with frequent papers at top-tier conferences and awards, including best paper and test-of-time awards.

We invite early-career researchers having experience with machine learning or related areas to apply for a full-time position on the PROSE team at Microsoft. The recent success of large language models (LLMs) creates an opportunity to take a qualitative step forward, to extend dramatically the reach of what users can do with Copilots. Our team provides a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and real-world impact, solving customer problems on a global scale. **Associate Researchers II** collaborate with other researchers to design and carry out the research underlying state-of-the-art systems, and work together with world-class engineers to implement these systems in production. To learn more about our approach and culture see this award talk on the story behind one of the team’s early innovations: the Flash Fill feature in Excel.
