title: AI-ML Researcher
description:
**About AkzoNobel**

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2024 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Technology Integration Team develops and productizes reusable Color Technology Components that power AkzoNobel’s internal applications and external customer-facing tools, with focus areas in Colorimetric Engines/Building Blocks, Color Visualization, and AI/ML-enabled color services. The AI/ML Researcher owns the delivery of applied Machine Learning and statistical solutions for prioritized color and coatings use cases (e.g., formulation optimisation, pigment/raw material screening, quality prediction, and image-based inspection). The role translates business and R&D questions into well-structured datasets, validated ML models, and clear insights, and partners with engineering and product stakeholders to ensure solutions are deployment-ready, monitored, documented and usable in products and processes. Unlike generalist Researcher roles, this position brings dedicated applied ML/data science capability to the team, owning the end-to-end ML lifecycle from problem framing through deployment-ready model delivery.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* **Use case shaping & stakeholder partnering**

o Engage with R&D, lab teams, manufacturing and product/application stakeholders to translate needs into well-defined ML problems, required inputs/outputs, constraints, and measurable success criteria.

o Lead or co-lead end-to-end delivery for assigned use cases from discovery and scoping through experimentation, validation, and implementation readiness.

o Communicate trade-offs (accuracy vs. explainability, latency, cost, robustness) and guide stakeholders toward fit-for-purpose solutions.

* **Data preparation, analysis & modelling**

o Acquire, clean, integrate, and analyze data from R&D/lab systems, manufacturing sources, and internal datasets; assess data quality, bias, leakage risk, and suitability for modelling.

o Develop, benchmark, and validate ML models (supervised/unsupervised) including baseline creation, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and robustness checks.

* **Domain application (color/coatings)**

o Collaborate with color formulators, researchers, and lab teams to ensure modelling aligns with domain realities (measurement variability, protocols, material constraints).

o Define and drive dataset design/generation activities (e.g., DoE support, sampling strategy, labeling guidance, protocol awareness) to improve training data quality and coverage.

o Apply practical understanding of relevant color data types (spectral/Lab\*/ΔE and variability) when designing targets, features, and evaluation strategies (as applicable).

* **Computer vision (where relevant)**

o Deliver image-based modelling tasks (e.g., defect detection, surface uniformity, pigment recognition) using classical CV and deep learning methods; define evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria aligned to operational deployment.

o Ensure peer review and alignment with Senior Researchers/architects for high impact use cases and model choices that may affect product/process behavior.

* **Industrialization & production readiness**

o Drive implementation readiness of assigned models: reproducible training/inference code, model artifacts, data dependencies, parameterization, testing approach, and clear runbooks.

o Contribute to MLOps practices as defined by the team: version control, experiment tracking, model registry inputs, monitoring requirements, alert thresholds, and retraining triggers.

o Partner with application/software teams to integrate model outputs into components/services (APIs, batch pipelines, or embedded usage) and support post-deployment stabilization.

**Experience**
--------------

**Educational qualifications**

o Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operational Research, Engineering or related quantitative field.

**Relevant experience**

o Typically 5-7 years of experience applied machine learning / data science delivering solutions in industrial, manufacturing, R&D, engineering, or equivalent complex environments (or equivalent project portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership).

o Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (research, engineering, product) and delivering work in an agile/team setting.

**Required skills**

o Strong Python skills for data analysis and ML (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; TensorFlow/ PyTorch beneficial).

o Solid understanding of ML fundamentals (regression, classification, clustering, model validation, overfitting control) and statistical reasoning.

o Working knowledge of SQL and working with structured datasets; o Familiarity with data pipelines or cloud platforms (Azure/Databricks) is a plus.

o Computer vision knowledge (OpenCV, CNNs/segmentation) is a plus depending on scope.

o Familiarity with Git and reproducible workflows; exposure to MLflow/ experiment tracking is desirable.

o Strong communication skills: ability to present findings clearly and document assumptions/limitations.

o Domain familiarity with color science (CIE color spaces, spectral data, ΔE) is advantageous but not mandatory.

At AkzoNobel we are highly committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best self. We strive to embrace diversity in a context of tolerance. Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment. For this reason we train and educate on the implications of our Unconscious Bias in order for our TA and hiring managers to be mindful of them and take corrective actions when applicable. In our organization, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

Summary:

Our Technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. Whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our people play vital roles in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled **AWS Senior Security Engineer** to join our cloud security team. In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain robust security controls across our Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure. You will focus on Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), identity and access management, AI-driven automation and security implementation, and broad-spectrum architectural security across all core AWS services—ensuring our cloud workloads remain resilient against emerging threats while enabling rapid business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Implement and manage CSPM tools (e.g., Cortex XSIAM, AWS Security Hub, etc) to maintain real-time visibility into misconfigurations, compliance posture, and risk posture across multi-account environments.
* Establish baseline security practices across the breadth of AWS services (Compute, Storage, Database, Serverless, Networking, Messaging, and Governance) to guarantee defense-in-depth across the entire AWS ecosystem.
* Evaluate, integrate, and operationalize AI/ML capabilities (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Amazon Q, SageMaker, LLM security practices) to automate security workflows, incident response playbooks, and threat intelligence while securing AI pipelines and workloads.
* Architect, enforce, and audit fine-grained IAM policies, Service Control Policies (SCPs), role hierarchies, and temporary credentials adhering strictly to the principle of least privilege and CIEM principles.
* Configure and manage encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS, Secrets Manager, and Certificate Manager. Maintain secure VPC network architectures, security groups, Network ACLs, and AWS WAF configurations.
* Monitor security logs via CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config. Build automated incident response playbooks using EventBridge, Lambda, and SOAR tools to contain security incidents instantly.
* Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) directly into CI/CD deployment pipelines. Write and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Ensure multi-account cloud operations meet industry security standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) using AWS Control Tower and AWS Config rules.

Skills - Experience and Requirements:

* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise CSPM platforms (Prisma Cloud, Wiz, AWS Security Hub, AWS Config) for continuous risk assessment, misconfiguration detection, and compliance tracking.
* In-depth architectural security understanding of core and advanced AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, ECS/EKS, VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53, SNS/SQS, KMS, and IAM.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals and practical experience applying generative AI/LLM models or AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q) to automate security analysis, triage, and security operations.
* Deep mastery of AWS IAM, AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, SCPs, and Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) principles.
* Strong knowledge of VPC design, Subnets, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS WAF, and Shield.
* Proficiency with Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, or Boto3 for automating security controls and remediation workflows.

### **Professional Experience & Soft Skills**

* Must have 5+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security or cybersecurity engineering, with at least 3+ years explicitly focused on AWS, GCP environments.
* Proven ability to communicate security risks effectively and partner with developer teams to resolve issues without creating operational friction.
* Demonstrated track record of conducting post-incident root-cause analysis and driving continuous improvement.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* AWS Certified Security - Specialty
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* ISC2 Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA) / CISSP

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.**

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

ㅤ

**Staff Machine Learning Engineer**

We are looking for a passionate Staff Machine Learning Engineer to build, run and scale the production inference platform behind search and personalization for the global streaming app Max as well as ongoing and future streaming initiatives. Every recommendation, search result and personalized row a viewer sees is served by a model running on this

platform, and it has to answer in milliseconds for 100+ million users worldwide.

The team, ML Infrastructure & Tools (MLIT), owns the deployment, lifecycle and inference of models for the Search & Personalization organization. We build and operate a shared, self-service inference platform on Kubernetes that serves models across multiple frameworks and runtimes behind one common control plane and model lifecycle. You will be the technical owner of that serving runtime. You are excited about working in a fast[1]moving environment that fosters engineering and operational excellence, and you believe a platform is only done when data scientists can ship models on it without you in the critical path.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture and roadmap of the model serving runtime, supporting multiple ML frameworks and inference engines behind one control plane
* Lead large-scale migrations and rollouts of production models onto the platform with zero viewer-facing regressions
* Build and maintain serving backends, model configurations and batching strategies that meet strict tail-latency targets at high request volume
* Design autoscaling, capacity management and multi-region resilience for latency[1]critical serving across Max, Discovery+ and other WBD offerings
* Drive observability, cost optimization and performance tuning across the serving fleet, including hardware selection, GPU and CPU utilization, and model optimization
* Define the contract between model training and serving so a validated model artifact deploys to production through standard, automated paths
* Establish per-model SLOs with model owners and build the telemetry that proves them
* Collaborate with applied scientists, partner engineering teams and the core infrastructure team as the platform onboards new models, runtimes and markets
* Author, test, review and optimize production-level code in Python while executing best practices in version control, CI/CD and code integration
* Take part in the platform on-call rotation and lead incident reviews that result in design changes, not just fixes
* Contribute design documents and technical documentation to support architecture decisions, knowledge transfer and sharing
* Mentor engineers, raise the bar in design and code reviews, and represent the platform in cross-team architecture decisions

**What to Bring**

* 9+ years of industry experience
* 5+ years of experience building or operating production ML infrastructure or comparable low-latency, large-scale distributed systems with a large customer base
* Hands-on experience running model inference in production at scale
* Strong Kubernetes fundamentals and experience running GPU and CPU workloads on it
* Proven performance engineering skills: profiling, tail-latency analysis, batching and concurrency under load
* 7+ years of programming experience in Python, plus working fluency in a systems language such as C++, Go or Rust
* Good practical knowledge of the modern machine learning lifecycle, from training artifacts through deployment, rollout and monitoring
* Strong architectural and design skills, with a track record of leading multi-quarter technical initiatives across teams
* Operational maturity: experience owning a tier-1 service, including on-call
* Experience with one of the cloud platforms AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins etc.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable contributing to technical documentation and on-call support
* Ability to technically collaborate with partners across time zones

**Preferred**

* Experience extending an inference server with custom backends, or contributing to an open-source serving runtime
* Background in recommendation, ranking or search systems and their latency and freshness constraints
* Experience building an internal platform that other teams adopted self-service
* Working experience with global teams

**About Skydance**

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

title: Solution Specialist, Data & AI Practice
description:
**Role Summary:**

The Solutioning Support/Specialist, is an early/mid-career role in the Data & AI Practice with a clear commercial edge. The person here works alongside Senior SMEs and Practice Head to design Data, AI, and GenAI solutions, build credible client proposals, and convert business problems into structured learning and transformation journeys.

A strong Solutioning Specialist/Support will quickly become the person in product owners and pre-sales reach for during live pursuits — because the inputs they produce are crisp, accurate, and ready to use. Pitch-decks and proposals this person contributes to are well-structured and buyer-specific without significant rework; a current library of program structures and case study inserts exists and gets reused across pursuits; market intelligence on AI / GenAI lands in usable form, not as raw research dumps; and Senior SMEs trust this person with end-to-end ownership of mid-complexity proposals, not just individual sections.

He/she will be in the room for client discussions, contributing to live pursuits, and developing the kind of structured thinking and solutioning craft that scales into senior roles. Curiosity, ownership, and the ability to turn messy inputs into a crisp, buyer-ready output are what make this role valuable.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Solutioning & Proposal Development**

* Partner with Senior SMEs and Practice Leads to design end-to-end Data & AI solutions for client pursuits — contributing to structure, content, and commercial framing.
* Build client proposals, solution documents, and program structures that are well-organized, accurate, and ready to use without significant rework.
* Translate client requirements into structured, outcome-oriented learning journeys — adoption, capability uplift, and measurable business outcomes, not just module lists.
* Support customized offerings across Data Engineering, AI / ML, and GenAI and Agentic AI tracks; help assemble pursuits from existing accelerators rather than rebuilding from scratch.

**2. Client Engagement Support**

* Participate in client discussions, discovery calls, and requirement-gathering sessions — capture context with the rigour that makes the next conversation sharper.
* Convert business needs into solution frameworks and delivery models with guidance from Senior SMEs; document customer priorities so Practice and Sales can act on them.
* Support pitch decks, case studies, and success stories — buyer-specific, visually clean, and aligned to how the customer thinks about their own problem.
* Stay engaged through the proposal cycle and handoff to delivery; ensure no requirement gets lost between discovery and execution.

**3. Content & Program Structuring**

* Assist in designing curriculum outlines, learning journeys, and hands-on lab structures that hold up against real-world enterprise contexts.
* Work with internal and external SMEs to ensure content aligns with current industry trends, real use cases, and business outcomes — not generic technology overviews.
* Maintain a library of reusable program structures, slide assets, and case study inserts; flag gaps in the existing content library proactively.

**4. Research & Market Intelligence**

* Track trends across the AI / GenAI / LLM ecosystem and Data Engineering & Analytics — translate findings into usable inputs for outreach, pitching, and offering design.
* Identify new solution opportunities and product ideas based on market signals, customer asks, and competitor moves.
* Benchmark StackRoute's offerings against competitors; surface gaps and differentiation angles for Senior SMEs and Practice Leads to act on.

**5. Internal Collaboration**

* Work fluidly with Delivery, Sales, and external SMEs to ensure solutions designed on paper actually work in delivery — surface feasibility risks early, not late.
* Coordinate inputs across Practice teams during pursuit cycles; hand off to delivery with documentation that captures customer commitments and success metrics.

**Must Have Technical & Functional Skills:**

* Good understanding of terminologies in Data Engineering (ETL, pipelines, data lakes), Data Analytics & BI concepts, and Machine Learning fundamentals, AI tools ( not technical expertise but L1-L2 knowledge should be present from application standpoint).
* Awareness of GenAI / LLM vocabulary — prompt engineering, RAG, APIs — with enough depth to hold a credible first conversation with a technical stakeholder.
* Strong PowerPoint skills (client-ready decks), Excel for effort estimation and costing basics, and structured documentation — proposals, SoWs, one-pagers.
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking — breaks complex requirements into clear, communicable solutions.
* Comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; good storytelling and presentation instincts; understanding of L&D context is a plus.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required:**

* 5-15 years in the education products, or in solutioning, pre-sales, or consulting roles with exposure of 3-5 years in Data/AI/Analytics.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Nice to Have competences:**

* Prior pre-sales, proposal writing, or design development experience.
* Certifications in cloud, data, or AI platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or model-provider certifications).

**Core Competencies:**

* **Structured Thinking:** Organises ambiguous client and technical inputs into logical, buyer-relevant narratives. Builds proposals that flow from problem to solution.
* **Solution Articulation:** Translates Data & AI capabilities into crisp, persona-specific stories. Adapts the pitch for a CTO, L&D Head, or BU Head without losing substance.
* **Research & Synthesis:** Gathers and distils large volumes of information into sharp, usable outputs. Knows what to include and what to leave out.
* **Written Communication:** Writes a tight brief, a clean slide, and a clear email. Adapts register from internal working notes to buyer-facing collateral.
* **Curiosity & Learning Agility:** Picks up new tools, concepts, and sectors quickly. Tracks AI / GenAI shifts proactively rather than waiting to be told what to read.
* **Bias for Action:** Ships a useful 10-slide deck on time rather than a polished 20-slide deck that's late. Comfortable with iteration over perfection.

title: Senior Staff QA
description:
**About** **JazzX AI****:**

***Vision:*** *Enterprises operating on institutional intelligence—governed, self-improving, and scalable beyond individual expertise.*

JazzX AI is defining the future of enterprise work—by building AI-native digital workers that actually get the job done.

We believe enterprises don't scale expertise—they lose it. Knowledge stays trapped in individuals, judgment gets applied inconsistently, and the best talent spends time on work that should run itself. We're changing that.

JazzX AI transforms messy enterprise reality into institutional intelligence: governed digital workers that capture expert judgment, make every decision explainable, and continuously improve through real-world execution. The result is faster decisions, higher-quality outcomes, and reliable execution at scale—in domains where getting it wrong isn't an option.

We're starting with lending and due-diligence workflows—complex, regulated, high-stakes. From here, we're building the backbone for enterprise intelligence across industries.

This is early-stage, hard, and consequential work. If you want to be part of bringing AI systems to market that actually run in production, handle real complexity, and deliver real outcomes—not demos, not chatbots—JazzX AI is the place.

**About** **SAIGroup** **:**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a QA Lead who can architect the overall quality strategy for JazzX AI's platforms and AI-powered products. This role requires a blend of traditional QA expertise, AI/ML awareness, and strong leadership capabilities.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Release, Monitoring & Reliability**

* **Conduct RCA, maintain issues of dashboards, and drive continuous improvement in QA lifecycle.**

* **Collaborate with DevOps/ML Ops to monitor model drift, performance anomalies, and post-production behaviors.**

* **Documentation & Communication**

* **Prepare detailed QA documents: strategies, test plans, evaluation reports, and execution metrics.**

* **Provide clear communication of risks, quality insights, and impact analysis to leadership.**

**Required Qualifications**

* **12+ years of experience in Software QA.**

* **Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (Python/Java/JavaScript).**

* **Experienced in working with microservice-based architecture**

* **Working knowledge of AI/ML systems, including datasets, model evaluation, vector stores, RAG, and LLM operations.**

title: Senior Manager, Security Operations
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization covering Cloud & Network Security, Detection Engineering (SOC), and Identity & Access Management (IAM). We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0, run a continuous red-team and penetration-testing program with external partners, and work directly with customers on security architecture reviews and briefings. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a Senior Manager to own and lead three connected disciplines: **Cloud Security, IAM, and the Security Operations Center (Detection & Response)**. You will manage and grow engineers and leads across these areas, set technical direction, and be the accountable owner for how Harness secures its cloud infrastructure, controls access to it, and detects and responds to threats against it.

This is a player-coach role. You are expected to go deep technically, make architecture calls, and also build the team, the operating cadence, and the metrics that show security maturity improving quarter over quarter.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Cloud Security**

* Own the security architecture and posture of Harness's multi-cloud and Kubernetes-based production environments, including network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and hardened baselines.
* Drive secure-by-default infrastructure through policy-as-code (e.g., OPA), guardrails in CI/CD, and continuous posture management.
* Partner with Platform and SRE on dedicated-tenant and customer-hosted deployment models, including the controls that make those models safe at enterprise scale.
* Support the security of customer-facing runtime components such as the Harness Delegate, including token scoping, least-privilege execution, and containment of compromised components.

### **Identity & Access Management**

* Own the workforce and workload identity strategy: SSO, MFA, privileged access, just-in-time access, service-account and machine-identity lifecycle, and access reviews.
* Advance Zero Trust principles across internal systems and production, using a central authority model with human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions.
* Reduce standing privilege and credential sprawl; make least privilege measurable and auditable.

### **Security Operations & Detection Engineering**

* Lead the SOC and Detection Engineering function: detection coverage, alert quality, triage, incident response, and on-call readiness.
* Build detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and validate them through purple-team exercises and red-team findings.
* Own the incident response lifecycle, from runbooks and tabletop exercises to post-incident reviews that feed back into engineering and control improvements.
* Improve automation and tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud-native logging) to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

### **Leadership & Program Management**

* Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team; set clear expectations, growth paths, and a healthy on-call culture.
* Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and executive-ready reporting.
* Work with external red-team and penetration-testing partners to scope exercises, triage findings, and drive remediation to closure.
* Support customer trust: contribute to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews, and communicate the shared responsibility model clearly and credibly.
* Present security posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership, including the executive team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* 10+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or security operations, with 3+ years managing technical security teams.
* Deep hands-on experience securing AWS, GCP, and/or Azure and Kubernetes environments at scale.
* Strong IAM background: SSO/federation, privileged access management, workload identity, and Zero Trust architecture.
* Proven experience running or building detection and response capabilities, including incident command for significant events.
* Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native detection tooling, and with writing or reviewing detection logic.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

### **Preferred**

* Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
* Experience with policy-as-code (OPA/Rego), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD security.
* Experience with Enterprise Security.
* Familiarity with securing AI-enabled products and the supply chain around them.
* Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GCP/AWS security specialty, GIAC) are a plus, not a requirement.

title: Data and Splunk Engineer - Officer
description:
Job Description

**Data Engineer / Data Scientist/ Splunk Engineer , Officer**

**Role Level**

Officer

**Role Type**

Individual Contributor

**Focus Area**

Data Engineering & Data Science

**Skill Mix**

70% Data Engineering / Data Science; 30% Splunk Engineering

**Experience Target**

Approximately 10 years

**Who we are looking for**
==========================

**The Data Engineer / Data Scientist/ Splunk Engineer , Officer, will support enterprise cybersecurity observability and analytics by combining deep Splunk engineering expertise with scalable data engineering and applied data science capabilities. The role is weighted (70%) towards Databricks-based data engineering, advanced analytics, and practical machine-learning solutions that convert complex security telemetry into reliable, actionable intelligence. The remaining focus(30%) towards Splunk engineering, with responsibility for developing searches, dashboards, alerts, data models, telemetry onboarding, and platform monitoring.**

**What you will be responsible for**
====================================

As a Data Engineer / Data Scientist / Splunk Engineer , you will:

* Design, develop, optimize, and maintain Splunk SPL searches, dashboards, reports, alerts, data models, field extractions, lookups, macros, and reusable knowledge objects.

* Build and enhance security observability solutions across endpoint, web proxy, firewall, network, identity, cloud, vulnerability, threat intelligence, and other enterprise telemetry.

* Onboard and validate new data sources, covering source analysis, parsing, normalization, timestamp validation, field mapping, data quality, and search readiness.

* Troubleshoot ingestion failures, telemetry gaps, latency, duplication, parsing issues, search failures, and dashboard performance concerns.

* Improve Splunk performance using efficient SPL, data model acceleration, summary indexing, lookup optimization, and appropriate search scheduling.

* Develop proactive monitoring and alerting for Splunk platform health, ingestion volumes, search execution, dashboard availability, and operational service levels.

* Partner with SOC, threat intelligence, detection engineering, security platform, and data teams to improve detection readiness and operational analytics.

* Design and maintain scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud services.

* Build curated, analytics-ready datasets with strong controls for data quality, reconciliation, lineage, observability, testing, and performance.

* Integrate Splunk and Databricks workflows to support telemetry enrichment, historical analytics, aggregation, and downstream reporting.

* Perform exploratory analysis and feature engineering to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and risk indicators across cybersecurity datasets.

* Develop or support practical statistical and machine-learning use cases including anomaly detection, classification, clustering, prioritization, and entity correlation.

* Operationalize analytics through Git, CI/CD, automated testing, workflow orchestration, monitoring, documentation, and production support.

* Create clear technical documentation, dashboard guides, data dictionaries, operational runbooks, and knowledge-sharing materials.

* Mentor junior engineers, contribute to peer reviews, and promote reusable engineering and analytics practices.

  

**What we value**
=================

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong hands-on expertise in Splunk, including advanced SPL, dashboards, alerts, reports, data models, field extractions, lookups, macros, and performance optimization.

* Experience with enterprise-scale log ingestion, security telemetry onboarding, data validation, troubleshooting, and operational monitoring.

* Strong programming and data engineering skills using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Delta Lake, and distributed processing.

* Understanding of Lakehouse architecture, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, reconciliation, lineage, observability, and pipeline optimization.

* Practical knowledge of statistical analysis and machine-learning concepts such as feature engineering, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, and model evaluation.

* Understanding of cybersecurity data and workflows, including SIEM/SOAR, threat detection, endpoint telemetry, vulnerability data, identity events, incidents, and threat intelligence.

* Ability to independently own technical deliverables, resolve complex issues, collaborate across teams, and communicate effectively with technical and senior stakeholders.

* Strong focus on automation, documentation, operational excellence, governance, scalability, resiliency, and measurable outcomes.

**Education & Qualifications**
==============================

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Approximately 10 years of professional experience across Splunk engineering, security analytics, data engineering, data science, cybersecurity, cloud, or related technology disciplines.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Splunk engineering and advanced SPL in an enterprise environment.

* Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks or comparable data platforms, ETL/ELT, and large-scale data processing.

* Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably AWS or Azure, and with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience within a SOC, threat detection, threat intelligence, security operations, or cybersecurity analytics environment.

* Experience with Cribl or similar telemetry routing, shaping, enrichment, and pipeline technologies.

* Knowledge of security data normalization, MITRE ATT&CK concepts, incident enrichment, detection engineering, and SIEM/SOAR workflows.

* Exposure to MLflow, MLOps, Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, NLP, or graph analytics.

* Experience with Power BI or equivalent visualization and reporting technologies.

* Experience in financial services, regulated industries, or environments with strong privacy, governance, security, and audit requirements.

* Relevant Splunk, Databricks, cloud, data engineering, data science, or cybersecurity certifications.

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

**Splunk Engineering**

Advanced SPL, dashboards, reports, alerts, data models, field extractions, lookups, macros, onboarding, troubleshooting, optimization and platform monitoring.

**Data Engineering**

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Delta Lake, Lakehouse, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability.

**Data Science / ML**

Exploratory analysis, feature engineering, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, model evaluation and explainability.

**Cloud & DevOps**

AWS or Azure, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, scalable processing, workflow monitoring and production support.

**Cybersecurity Analytics**

Security telemetry, SIEM/SOAR, threat detection, endpoint and network data, vulnerability, identity, incident and threat intelligence datasets.

**Visualization & Reporting**

Splunk dashboards, Power BI or equivalent tools, operational metrics, trend analysis and stakeholder reporting.

**Additional Requirements**
===========================

* This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration and mentoring expectations.

* The role requires sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.

* The candidate should be comfortable balancing hands-on Splunk delivery, production data engineering, applied analytics, and stakeholder communication.

**Why this role is important to us**
====================================

**Cybersecurity depends on complete, reliable, and searchable telemetry supported by scalable data engineering and effective analytics. This role bridges Splunk Engineering, Data Engineering, and Data Science to strengthen observability, improve threat detection, accelerate investigation, and deliver trusted security insights for enterprise decision-making.**

**About State Street**

State Street is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, including investment servicing, investment management, investment research, and trading. We value collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and responsible technology. We are looking for technical talent who can solve meaningful problems, communicate clearly, and help build secure, scalable, data-driven capabilities for the future.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Snowflake Platform Administrator
description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Snowflake Platform Administrator to join our innovative team.

  

**Snowflake Platform Administrator | About You**

As a Snowflake Platform Administrator, you will be responsible for administering, governing, securing, and optimizing the enterprise Snowflake data platform. You will manage core platform operations while enabling governed data discovery, semantic access, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and AI capabilities through Snowflake Horizon Catalog and Cortex. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Security, Data Owners, and Data Stewards to ensure enterprise data assets are secure, discoverable, reliable, cost-effective, and accessible to authorized analytics applications, business users, and AI solutions.

**Snowflake Platform Administrator | Day-to-Day**

* Administer and optimize the Snowflake enterprise platform, including accounts, databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, platform configurations, performance, availability, consumption, and cost management.
* Configure and manage Snowflake Horizon Catalog, enabling metadata management, enterprise data discovery, searchable data assets, governed data products, and standardized business definitions.
* Implement and maintain Snowflake security and governance controls, including RBAC, role hierarchies, tagging, automated data classification, masking policies, row-access policies, least-privilege access, and sensitive-data protection.
* Configure and support semantic views and Snowflake Cortex capabilities, including Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, MCP Servers, governed metrics, dimensions, relationships, and secure access for AI applications and agents.
* Establish and monitor data quality, lineage, and governance controls, including data metric functions, freshness and completeness monitoring, column/object-level lineage, alerts, exception reporting, dependency analysis, and Snowsight dashboards.
* Administer Snowflake Marketplace and secure data sharing, including provider/consumer permissions, controlled data-product publication, usage monitoring, governance compliance, and associated costs.
* Drive platform operational excellence through automation, change management, security baselines, incident support, CI/CD practices, monitoring, and collaboration with Data Engineering teams to resolve metadata, lineage, performance, and platform issues.

**Snowflake Platform Administrator | Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of hands-on Snowflake administration experience within an enterprise environment, including platform configuration, SQL, Snowsight, warehouse management, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Horizon Catalog, metadata management, data discovery, object tagging, automated classification, and enterprise data governance capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of Snowflake security and access management, including RBAC, role hierarchies, masking, row-access policies, sensitive-data protection, identity management, and least-privilege access models.
* Experience configuring semantic views and Snowflake Cortex capabilities, including Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and governed data access for analytics and AI use cases.
* Experience implementing data quality monitoring, lineage, governed data sharing, Snowflake Marketplace, metadata reporting, and audit-ready governance controls; familiarity with DAMA-DMBOK principles is advantageous.
* Familiarity with APIs, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, cloud security, identity management, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; SnowPro certifications are preferred.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Independently designs, implements, and optimizes components within distributed systems to meet scalability, reliability, and operational requirements. Owns scoped features from design through production, validates behavior through performance, load, and fault-injection testing, and reviews peer implementations for correctness and resilience. Uses data plane platforms and distributed state technologies to support high-volume data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
Designs for failure and recovery using redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover. Configures retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts to handle network variability and dependency failures. Builds actionable telemetry, dashboards, and alerts; authors runbooks; and participates in on-call rotations, incident response, and root cause analysis. Uses operational findings to prevent recurrence and improve system reliability.
  
Develops automation and infrastructure-as-code tools for troubleshooting and maintenance. Applies encryption, access controls, and vulnerability remediation, and follows change management, security, compliance, and documentation standards. Resolves component-level issues independently and collaborates with senior engineers on broader architectural decisions and complex failures.

  

Key Responsibilities
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
  
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
  
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
–Implements performance and load testing.
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
  
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
  
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
  
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
  
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
  
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
  
Compliance & Security:
  
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
  
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
  
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
  
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

**Basic Qualification**

* 5+ years of industry experience working on commercial or open-source software.
* Strong fluency in C++ or Java or similar modern languages
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a deep understanding of Computer Science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and build control plane systems for cloud scale
* Strong systems programming skills, including experience with multi-threading and concurrency.
* A solid foundation in distributed systems concepts (e.g., consistency, scaling, failure recovery).
* Experience with implementation testing, debugging, and documentation, specifically within a Linux development environment.
* BS in Computer Science; Masters preferred
* Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems

title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under the guidance of senior engineers. Applies foundational scalability principles, conducts performance and load testing, and configures retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts to improve resilience to network variability. Delivers scoped features, develops fault-injection tests, and assists with data replication and synchronization.
  
Builds telemetry and alerts, maintains operational runbooks, and participates in on-call rotations with support. Uses automation and infrastructure-as-code scripts to troubleshoot issues. Follows established change management, security, and compliance procedures, including encryption, access controls, and remediation plans, and escalates complex issues appropriately.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:**  
–Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.
  
–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.
  
–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.
  
–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.
  
**System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:**  
–Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.
  
–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance
  
**System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:**  
–Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.
  
–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.
  
–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
  
**System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:**  
–Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.
  
–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**  
–Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.
  
–Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
–Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues.
  
–Participate in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
  
**Compliance & Security:**  
–Assist in implementing basic security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
  
–Assist in the execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, under supervision.
  
–Support the creation and updating of documentation to ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations.
  
**Automation & Change Management:**  
–Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)).
  
–Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance

**Basic Qualification**

* 3-5+ years of industry experience working on commercial or open-source software.
* Strong fluency in C++ or Java or similar modern languages
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a deep understanding of Computer Science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and build control plane systems for cloud scale
* Strong systems programming skills, including experience with multi-threading and concurrency.
* A solid foundation in distributed systems concepts (e.g., consistency, scaling, failure recovery).
* Experience with implementation testing, debugging, and documentation, specifically within a Linux development environment.
* BS in Computer Science; Masters preferred
* Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

As a Principal Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and senior technical advisor. You will translate customer business requirements into integrated solutions, assess cloud environments, identify gaps, and guide customers through cloud adoption and implementation.

You will provide technical leadership across the full solution lifecycle—from discovery and design through build, testing, deployment, and go-live—while coordinating cross-functional teams to remove blockers and drive successful customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to understand business goals, requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, translating them into practical technical and process solutions.
* Lead fit-gap assessments of customer cloud environments and develop roadmaps for cloud transition, implementation, and optimization.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and oversee end-to-end delivery across requirements intake, design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live.
* Design secure, scalable OCI architectures, including networking, security, identity and access management, and infrastructure frameworks.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to OCI, support cloud-adoption models, and recommend actions to remove delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third-party partners.
* Communicate solution options, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.
* Contribute to strategic planning, program governance, customer satisfaction, service delivery, and cross-functional team leadership.

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Mandatory**

* 11 years of experience in a customer-facing, consultative, or technology-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:
  + Bachelor’s degree in business, computer information systems, computer science, or a related field plus 7 years of relevant experience.
  + Master’s degree in a related field plus 5 years of relevant experience.
  + Doctorate in a related field plus 3 years of relevant experience.
* 8–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 5 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Hands-on expertise with OCI, including cloud architecture, workload deployment, networking, security, and IAM.
* Strong Terraform experience for provisioning and managing OCI resources.
* Proficiency in Bash, Python, Shell, or similar scripting and programming languages.
* Experience deploying and managing containerised workloads on Kubernetes, ideally Oracle Kubernetes Engine.
* Experience building observability dashboards and alerts with Prometheus and Grafana.
* Demonstrated experience leading business analysis, business-process design, and software delivery lifecycle activities.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs, coordinate stakeholders, manage resources, and deliver solutions on time and within budget.
* Strong client relationship, service delivery, incident response, account management, contract management, and compliance capabilities.
* Excellent analytical, written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to travel to customer and internal locations up to 25%.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* OCI or other relevant cloud certifications.
* Experience with modern CI/CD and DevOps tools and practices.
* At least one full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience supporting operating budgets or project financials.
* Deep familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on-premises offerings.
* Additional experience in IT service management and account management.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting secure workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I use Terraform and scripting tools such as Python, Bash, or Shell to provision and manage cloud infrastructure?
* Have I led a customer solution through discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live while coordinating multiple stakeholders?
* Am I comfortable translating customer business needs into technical architectures, cloud-adoption roadmaps, and actionable recommendations?
* Have I worked with Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM, security controls, and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana?

title: Industrial AI Leader - Manufacturing Industry Practice
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Capgemini Invent's Manufacturing Industry Practice is seeking a leader to own the end-to-end solutioning and delivery governance of Industrial AI engagements for manufacturing clients in India. The leader will translate plant and business problems into scalable AI architectures, shape proposals and client narratives, improve pursuit conversion, and remain accountable for solution integrity through delivery. Demand for AI-driven operational transformation in these sectors is growing rapidly. This is a business-critical, market-facing role for a senior leader who can credibly engage client leadership on Industrial AI strategy, architecture, OT/IT convergence, and enterprise-scale deployment, backed by hands-on operating experience in Steel and/or Cement.

The role sits at the intersection of manufacturing, consulting and technology. Working with Capgemini's manufacturing, data, AI, engineering and OT capabilities, the leader will shape multiple concurrent pursuits, lead client solution workshops, define architectures spanning the plant floor and enterprise, and oversee delivery from solution design through value realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a senior, market-facing Industrial AI solution leader for manufacturing clients in India, with Steel, Cement, Metals & Mining and other process industries as preferred sectors.
* Lead client-facing solution workshops and build trusted relationships with CXOs, operations leaders, plant heads, process engineers and technology stakeholders.
* Shape multiple concurrent pursuits and proposals, creating credible solution narratives, commercials and implementation roadmaps that improve pursuit conversion and win rate. Independent new-logo origination or ownership of an annual sales target is not the primary expectation.
* Contribute to industry forums, client workshops, practice assets and thought leadership to strengthen market credibility in Industrial AI.

------------------

* 15+ years of combined experience across hands-on industry operations and consulting or technology leadership.

* Ability to engage credibly from the boardroom to the plant floor, translating between CXO business priorities, operational realities, and technical architecture.

* Commercial acumen in deal shaping, pricing, business-case development, and engagement profitability.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a new offering and practice area, not just execute within one.

title: Integration Architect
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role**

The Integration Architect is Refold’s resident integration expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise problems. You’ve spent years in the integration space, know iPaaS platforms inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of APIs and how enterprise systems talk to each other. You set the technical approach where there’s no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts.

* Team: Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning enterprise architecture and implementations
* Building: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations at enterprise scale — the problems for which no playbook exists yet.
* You’ll work with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the architecture for the hardest problems. Design complex, mission-critical agentic AI integrations spanning Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, ServiceNow, and modern data ecosystems, especially where no playbook exists yet.
* Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important integrations.
* Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on data modelling, agentic orchestration, authentication, idempotency, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load.
* Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers’ security and compliance teams on VPC, mTLS, SSO, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture.
* Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across accounts and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap.
* Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into reference architectures, integration patterns, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base.
* Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews and technical deep dives.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6-10 years in integration engineering and solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in the integration space.
* Mandatory hands-on experience with iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, SnapLogic, Fivetran, TIBCO, and SAP CPI); you’ve architected and delivered enterprise integrations using an integration platform.
* Excellent, deep understanding of APIs and the integration landscape, REST, GraphQL, SOAP, webhooks, and auth models.
* A deep technical problem-solver, you design solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer.
* Deep expertise in enterprise integration architecture, data pipelines, and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders.
* Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration).
* Prior principal/staff solutions architect, lead integration engineer, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup.
* Direct experience integrating with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or ServiceNow.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
  
  
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Perform SAP BASIS administration activities across SAP landscapes (ECC, BW, Solution Manager, S/4HANA, Java systems).
* Monitor and maintain SAP systems to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
* Execute SAP kernel upgrades, support package implementations, and system refreshes/copies.
* Manage SAP transport activities and troubleshoot transport-related issues.
* Perform client administration, user administration, and security-related BASIS tasks.
* Monitor SAP background jobs, system logs, spool management, and interface connectivity.
* Support HANA database administration activities, including backups and recovery.
* Execute OS and database-level troubleshooting in collaboration with infrastructure teams.
* Participate in incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Support cloud-based SAP environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, SAP RISE) as required.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and operational reports.
Provide on-call support and participate in planned maintenance activities.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills**

  

* 3-5 years of SAP BASIS administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, and SAP HANA.
* Experience with system monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of SAP transport management and change management processes.
* Experience in system copy, client copy, refresh, upgrades, and patching activities.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix and Windows server administration.
* Understanding of backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability concepts.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or SAP RISE environments.
Good understanding of ITIL processes and ticketing tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* SAP BASIS or SAP HANA certification(not mandator. Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a plus.
* Experience in SAP RISE operations.
Strong communication, customer handling, and documentation skills.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist
description:
As a Senior ML Scientist at Wayfair, you’ll shape the future of how millions of customers discover, explore, and shop for their homes through intelligent, scalable AI systems.
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Wayfair is moving the world so that anyone can live in a home they love - a journey enabled by more than 3,000 Wayfair engineers and a data-centric culture. The Customer Technology (CT) science team builds and owns all the Machine learning (ML) products that power all search, marketing, and recommendations technology across Wayfair. Our algorithms tackle a varied & broad spectrum of challenges in the Wayfair marketplace; from empowering suppliers to easily add products to our catalog, to enabling our customers to discover and purchase a vast & diverse assortment of home goods, to driving marketing experiences customers love all at web scale.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Scientist to lead the development of the next generation of intelligent customer experiences at Wayfair. You will design and deploy large-scale machine learning systems that power personalization, recommendations, search, marketing decisioning, GenAI experiences, and other customer-facing products.
  
  
Working closely with engineers, product managers, platform teams, and fellow scientists, you will own highly ambiguous technical problems from research through production. You will shape technical strategy, mentor scientists through technical leadership, and help bring state-of-the-art machine learning research into production for millions of customers. The solutions you build will become foundational capabilities that are reused across multiple customer technology domains, enabling personalization and intelligent decision-making throughout the Wayfair ecosystem.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
\*
  
  
Lead the design, development, and deployment of large-scale machine learning systems across personalization, recommendations, search, ranking, generative AI, and customer decisioning.
  
\*
  
  
Drive technical strategy and architecture for foundational ML capabilities that are reused across multiple customer-facing products.
  
\*
  
  
Evaluate and adapt the latest advances in recommendation systems, representation learning, large language models, reinforcement learning, and foundation models to solve real-world customer problems.
  
\*
  
  
Partner closely with engineering and platform teams to productionize scalable ML systems and establish best practices for model training, inference, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  
\*
  
  
Lead experimentation through offline evaluation, online A/B testing, and long-term measurement of business impact.

This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Technical SME and Engineer for Engineering, EHS & Sustainability provides technical leadership for a product family, technology platform, programme or group of sites. The role leads solution design, implementation, validation and troubleshooting and ensures technical outputs align with approved architecture, product strategy and engineering standards.

The role coordinates engineers, site teams, Architects, Product Owners, Service Managers and suppliers and acts as the technical lead for complex delivery and operational issues.
