title: LEAD PRODUCT AI & DIGITAL PLATFORM-INDIA
description:
**The Role**
------------

We're seeking a Product Owner , AI, Agentic Capabilities & Customer Experience to define and execute the strategy for bringing advanced and proactive AI capabilities, including Agentic AI, to the Lumen Customer Portal and enterprise digital experiences. This critical role is about building the next generation of digital service, moving the customer experience from interaction-first to resolution-first, by leveraging AI and autonomous (agentic) capabilities to solve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end and drive significant operational efficiency. This individual will own the Generative AI and Agentic Roadmap and its required foundational platform components, ensuring seamless integration into the enterprise customer portal, developer portal, and underlying API products. The individual in this role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to drive development and integration, establish and maintain alignment between the customer experience and development roadmaps, and serve as a champion for safe, reliable, and high-quality autonomous experiences.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Architecting the AI Future: Work collaboratively and cross-functionally to define the vision for the Lumen Platform's Generative AI strategy, specifically focusing on how Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous/agentic systems can resolve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end, aligned with organizational goals and strategic priorities.
* Bridging Technical & Business Needs: Translate complex B2B customer journeys and business requirements (e.g., ticket creation, service modification, billing inquiries) into clear, actionable technical specifications for AI Agents, conversational interfaces, and workflow automation systems and their required underlying Tooling/APIs and orchestration logic.
* Deep Customer & AI Feedback Engagement: Engage regularly with customers and platform users to capture real-world feedback on AI accuracy, trust, and usability. Leverage these insights to inform the Agentic AI continuous learning and refinement roadmap, ensuring high user satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).
* Championing the AI Tooling Layer: Advocate for and drive an API-first strategy to ensure the platform provides a robust, governed, and structured Tooling Layer that AI models and autonomous agents can reliably call for action (e.g., defining API standards, taxonomy, and latency requirements for AI consumption).
* Driving AI Execution & Governance: Lead execution of the Generative AI and Agentic roadmap, defining detailed capabilities, LLM integration requirements, and Guardrails & Safety protocols (including Prompt Injection Prevention, data masking, and compliance checks) to mitigate risks like hallucination and data leakage.
* AI Performance & Lifecycle Management: Implement rigorous AI Governance and MLOps practices. Define and track key performance indicators including Task Success Rate, Hallucination Rate, Cost Per Interaction (CPI), and Agent Latency, ensuring solutions are robust, and changes are vetted against these metrics before release.
    
  Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve the end-to-end roadmap execution process, driving key learnings back into the organization.

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering); master's degree is a plus.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Technical Product Management or Software Engineering, including 3+ years directly defining and launching Generative AI capabilities (specifically Agentic AI, large-scale conversational interfaces, or autonomous workflows).
* Deep expertise in Generative AI architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns, and the design of AI 'tools' or functions for autonomous agents.
* Deep technical knowledge and understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL, Event Driven APIs), microservices architecture, and cloud platforms.
* Extensive experience with digital platforms, enterprise customer portals, and/or complex web applications, coupled with strong working knowledge of user experience design & research, and modern software development methodologies (Agile, DevOps).
* Proven ability to analyze complex technical data, identify and troubleshoot intricate technical issues, and develop scalable solutions that directly impact the customer and developer experience on the platform.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills that enable effective collaboration with diverse technical and non-technical teams, stakeholders, and customers. Ability to create clarity and drive focus in complex and dynamic technical contexts up, down, and across the organization.
* Ability to manage and lead multiple technical priorities and projects while delivering against tight timelines in a complex and dynamic environment.

The successful candidate will balance technical depth with people leadership: driving monitoring solutions, alerting mechanisms, and customer-focused incident detection tools, and raising the bar of the engineers around them. You will partner closely with cross-functional engineering teams to investigate and resolve incidents, drive root cause analyses, and champion solutions that improve customer reliability and stability of the Databricks Platform.

* Guide the design and implementation of customer-focused alerting pipelines and end-to-end observability workflows that expand detection coverage and reduce mean time to detection.

* Participate in growing the local team of Platform Monitoring Engineers, including hiring and onboarding.

* Production-level experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and proficiency in container and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Data Modelling Lead —[Procurement / Planning & Logistics /Manufacturing] Data
description:
Job Description:

**THE ROLE IN CONTEXT**

We are establishing a dedicated Data Modelling team inside GSC Data & Analytics to give our enterprise data a designed, governed structure — and to remove the single biggest constraint on our AI ambitions: data that is disconnected, inconsistently mastered and misaligned across systems.

This team is the connective tissue of the **Data Backbone**. In our strategy the Data Backbone is the **bridge** between today’s federated landscape and the clean, converged foundation that T.U.K (Titan · Unify · KunPeng) will deliver over the coming years. The bridge is what lets us run AI and autonomous planning *now* — by joining, organising and streamlining data across systems as they exist today, rather than waiting for convergence to finish.

That landscape is heterogeneous — SAP & Oracle ERPs, alongside best-of-breed platforms such as **Kinaxis** (planning) and **Manhattan** (logistics execution), procurement systems such as **Prism and Coupa**, and external data sources such as **Z2**. Bridging these — not just ERP-to-ERP — is the substance of the role.

The team is led by a Director, with three Data Modelling Leads owning distinct domain clusters. **This role is one of those three Leads, accountable for the [****Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing****] domain.**

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)**

You own how **[****Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing****] data connects across systems**. You understand how data in one system relates to data in another — despite non-standard master data, coverage gaps and structural differences — and you design the models and mappings that make it connectable, trustworthy and reusable. That mapping is held as an **enterprise asset**.

**The boundary that defines this team:** This team designs and owns the map — the logical and canonical models, the source-to-target mappings and the definitions — while GSC Data Engineering builds the pipelines and physical structures from those designs. You stay deep in the modelling craft, hands-on with real source data, rather than spread thin across pipeline build.

**Where your work sits**

* **You own, hands-on:** conceptual and logical data models, canonical entity and KPI definitions, source-to-target mapping specifications, business-rule and quality-rule definitions, lineage and metadata documentation.
* **You hand off and stay close:** well-specified designs go to Data Engineering (including its Technical Data Architects) to build — and you review the build back against the model, staying involved in how it is realised.

These are designed as genuine partnerships, not tickets into a void: Data Engineering builds to your designs and reviews with you, and the GSC Data Office owns fixing the source-data issues you surface. Your ownership of the map carries real influence over what gets built and what gets cleaned.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Enterprise Mapping & Canonical Modelling (the core of the role)**

* Design conceptual and logical data models for the [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] domain that reflect how the business actually operates.
* Produce source-to-target mappings across ERPs, best-of-breed platforms (e.g. Kinaxis, Manhattan, procurement systems) and external data sources (e.g. Z2), explicitly accounting for non-standard master data, coverage gaps and structural inconsistencies.
* Define canonical entities, business rules & KPI definitions so the same concept means the same thing across squads.

**Own the [****Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing****] Map as an Enterprise Asset**

* Maintain the mapping and models as a governed, versioned, reusable asset — not a one-off deliverable.
* Keep documentation, lineage and decision rationale transparent and traceable, so the map is trusted and auditable.

**Delivering to Demand, Within Projects**

* Extend the enterprise map incrementally — object by object, area by area — predominantly in response to demand (AI use cases and business projects), rather than as a single big-bang build.
* Deliver your modelling within project constructs and squads to time-bound commitments, managing dependencies and priorities so modelling keeps pace with delivery.
* Balance this demand-driven delivery with the proactive, foundational modelling that no single project triggers — the work that stands up the backbone itself.

**Business Requirements, Backbone Coverage & Data Quality (with the GSC Data Office)**

* Translate [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] business requirements into the data needed to meet them — the essential link between what the business asks for and what the backbone must hold.
* Determine whether that data already exists in the Data Backbone; where it does not, partner with the GSC Data Office to determine the authoritative data source and set it up. *(The Data Office owns authoritative-source identification; this role connects it to the business need.)*
* Surface and diagnose join-level data-quality issues — where and why data fails to connect across systems — so the Data Office and domains can remediate the underlying transactional source issues.

**Design–Build Handoff with Data Engineering (clear RACI)**

* Translate your models into build-ready specifications and hand them to Data Engineering (including its Technical Data Architects), who build the physical structures and pipelines.
* Review engineered outputs against the design; own the “what and how-connected,” while Engineering owns the build.

**Cross-System & Cross-Domain Harmonisation**

* Own [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] deeply; harmonise definitions, business rules and master data at the seams with the other two domain Leads.
* Align your domain to the enterprise standards set with the Director, so the three domain maps compose into one coherent backbone.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Translation**

* Work with business SMEs, the GSC Data Office, Data Engineering (including Technical Data Architects) and the BI & AI teams to capture requirements, align definitions and validate models.
* Act as the translator between business meaning and canonical data structure — simplifying complex technical concepts for non-technical partners.

**Standards, Tooling & Thought Leadership**

* Set modelling standards, templates, metadata standards and lineage practices for the [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] domain.
* Lead disciplined use of enterprise modelling tools (Erwin, ER/Studio, PowerDesigner) as a working expert.

**Enable AI & Autonomous Planning**

* Ensure models make [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] data joinable and trustworthy enough for AI and autonomous-supply chain use cases — data a machine can act on.
* **As the backbone matures (forward-looking):** design enterprise semantic models that support analytics and AI/ML — a growth area for the role rather than a day-one focus.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Essential**

* **8–12+ years** of hands-on data modelling experience, operating as a senior working expert.
* **Cross-system / integration / canonical modelling** as your core strength — source-to-target mapping and bridging heterogeneous systems, not warehouse build alone.
* **Deep understanding of how source systems structure data across a heterogeneous landscape** — SAP ERPs plus best-of-breed and external systems (e.g. Kinaxis, Manhattan, procurement platforms, ERPs)
* **Master data / MDM literacy** — comfortable designing around non-standard master data and coverage limitations.
* **A partnering mindset on data quality and authoritative sources** — able to translate business needs into backbone coverage and diagnose why data won’t join, working alongside the GSC Data Office.
* Grounding in **relational, Kimball dimensional and Data Vault 2.0** modelling as foundations.
* Strong data governance instincts — metadata, lineage, definitions and standards.

**Advantageous**

* SQL fluency, and the ability to design for cloud data platforms (AWS, Databricks) and semantic layers — understanding and designing for these, rather than building them.
* Experience contributing to a data backbone, control tower or enterprise-integration programme.

**Ways of Working**

* Structured, detail-oriented, with a strong problem-solving mindset.
* A clear communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts for business and technical audiences alike.
* Proven ability to operate in a global, matrixed organisation and harmonise across domains.

**WHY JOIN**

* Build the connective tissue of the Data Backbone — the bridge that lets GSC run AI and autonomous planning now, ahead of full T.U.K convergence.
* Own an enterprise asset end to end: the map of how [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] data connects across the supply chain.
* Shape enterprise-wide modelling standards from the ground up in a newly formed, strategically-backed team — turning disconnected data into a foundation that machines can reason on.

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. As a Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Chief technology Office team, you lead multiple teams and manage day-to-day implementation activities by identifying and escalating issues and ensuring your team's work adheres to compliance standards, business requirements, and tactical best practices.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
* Leads team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices and SDLC/TLM automation to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes, while setting expectations for human validation, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and consistent use of reusable patterns across teams.

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience

* Experience leading responsible adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and delivery tools across engineering teams, including defining ways of working (review/validation expectations), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of data.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and governance expectations; ability to coach engineers on compliant and effective usage.
* Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

* Hands on experience in Full stack Development
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems preferred.

title: Security Transformation Specialist
description:
**Domain**

Cloud Security, Vulnerability Management and Compliance

**Role Summary**

The Security Transformation Specialist supports vulnerability and compliance programs by translating security standards into measurable controls, developing and validating controls across cloud and on-premises environments, and driving remediation with business and technology stakeholders. The role serves as a technical subject-matter expert for vulnerability and compliance operations while contributing to automation, reporting, governance and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience in cloud security and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) platforms such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud.
* Strong expertise in Qualys Policy Compliance, including policy assessment, control validation and investigation of compliance findings.
* Good understanding of cloud-native security, operating-system-level security and security configuration standards.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Solid networking and/or server administration knowledge, including the OSI model, encryption, common protocols, ports and network security concepts.
* Ability to interpret security standards and convert requirements into testable technical controls and scenarios.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to coordinate across geographically distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Working knowledge of Python and/or shell scripting for automation, data handling and control validation.
* Experience with security-control development, cloud query languages, reporting and workflow automation.
* Relevant security certifications such as CCSP, CEH or CompTIA Security+.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* Work with CSPM platforms and Qualys Policy Compliance to support control development, assessment and operational compliance activities.
* Interpret organizational security standards and translate requirements into control logic, test scenarios and measurable validation criteria.
* Develop, test and validate cloud-native and operating-system security controls before production deployment.
* Present new or enhanced controls in governance and review forums, clearly explaining the requirement, logic, test evidence, coverage and expected impact.
* Investigate false positives, approved variances, scan inaccuracies and control exceptions; document findings and coordinate corrective action.
* Partner with server, network, cloud, database and application teams to address vulnerabilities, configuration gaps and compliance findings.
* Provide remediation guidance and respond to stakeholder questions related to vulnerability patching and configuration changes required to align with organizational security standards.
* Act as a primary point of contact for vulnerability and compliance operational queries and coordinate issues through resolution.
* Conduct periodic reviews with business stakeholders covering risk posture, remediation progress, aging items, dependencies and blockers.
* Collaborate with tool vendors and internal platform teams to troubleshoot product issues, coverage gaps, scan failures and inaccurate findings.
* Facilitate discussions on security-control gaps and recommend practical remediation or control-enhancement options.
* Perform user acceptance testing for security-control enhancements using predefined scenarios and maintain clear evidence of results.
* Monitor assessment and scan coverage to help ensure in-scope infrastructure assets are evaluated according to the defined schedule.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, dashboards, control evidence and governance records.
* Support governance and audit-readiness activities through regular reviews of processes, controls, evidence and operational performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, automate repeatable activities and strengthen the overall security posture.
* Perform authorized administrative and operational activities within security tools in accordance with documented procedures and access controls.

**Technical Experience**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, compliance operations, cloud security.
* Practical experience with Qualys Policy Compliance and at least one CSPM platform, preferably Wiz or Prisma Cloud.
* Experience validating security controls across cloud platforms, servers, operating systems and network technologies.
* Exposure to issue tracking, evidence management, reporting and governance workflows.

**Professional Competencies**

* Analytical problem-solving and attention to detail.
* Ownership and accountability for assigned controls, findings and stakeholder commitments.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage dependencies and communicate risks or blockers promptly.
* Clear documentation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on quality, consistency and measurable outcomes.

  
To be filled by recruiter

title: Platform Engineer I
description:
About Blackhawk Network:

Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.

Overview:

Our Operations Command Centre (OCC) is looking for a Platform Engineer with strong technical foundations, exceptional problem-solving ability, and a passion for building reliable systems.

This is not a traditional Platform Engineering or NOC role.

You'll split your time between engineering solutions and operating our production platforms—maintaining the health of BHN's production services while building the automation, observability, and AI-driven capabilities that make incidents less frequent, easier to diagnose, and faster to resolve.

As part of the OCC, you'll play an active role in Major Incident Management, partnering with engineering teams to diagnose and restore production services during critical incidents. Outside of incident response, you'll build dashboards, improve monitoring, develop automation, analyse operational data, and engineer intelligent tooling that continuously improves platform reliability.

This role provides exceptional exposure to large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability platforms, automation, AI-assisted software development, and production engineering.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex technical problems, and want to accelerate your engineering career, we'd love to hear from you

Responsibilities:

Major Incident Response & Production Operations

* Participate in the 24×7 on-call rotation supporting BHN's production platforms.
* Monitor prohealth using modern observability platforms.
* Lead or support Majoduction r Incident bridges, coordinating technical teams during high-severity production incidents.
* Perform technical triage, identify probable causes, and drive rapid service restoration.
* Communicate clearly with engineers, leadership, and business stakeholders throughout incidents.
* Lead post-incident reviews focused on learning and continuous improvement.
* Identify recurring operational pain points and engineer permanent solutions.

Platform Engineering & Automation

* Develop automation that reduces manual operational effort.
* Build internal engineering tools that improve developer productivity and platform reliability.
* Create dashboards, alerts, health scores, and operational insights.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment safety.
* Automate operational workflows and repetitive tasks.
* Build self-service capabilities for engineering teams.
* Develop auto-remediation and self-healing capabilities.
* Continuously improve platform reliability through engineering rather than manual intervention.

Observability & Reliability Engineering

* Design alerts that detect customer-impacting issues early while minimising alert fatigue.
* Improve platform visibility through metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Analyse production behaviour to identify reliability improvements.
* Develop operational KPIs and engineering health metrics.
* Define and measure Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Use operational data to drive engineering decisions and improve platform resilience.

AI Engineering & Intelligent Operations

* Use AI-assisted software development tools to improve engineering productivity.
* Develop AI-powered incident summarisation and communication capabilities.
* Build intelligent root cause analysis and diagnostic tooling.
* Create operational copilots and engineering assistants.
* Enhance alerts with contextual intelligence.
* Automate diagnostics and operational workflows.
* Build AI-driven orchestration and auto-remediation capabilities.
* Develop engineering knowledge systems that improve troubleshooting and accelerate learning.

You'll Gain Experience Across

* Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD Engineering
* Infrastructure as Code
* Observability & Monitoring
* Major Incident Management
* Production Operations
* Reliability Engineering (SRE)
* Automation Engineering
* AI Engineering
* Large-scale Distributed Systems

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Engineering, Technical Operations, or a similar technical role.
* Strong Linux fundamentals.
* Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, Bash, or a similar language.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with exposure to production support or Major Incident Management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Experience using modern AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar AI-assisted development platforms

title: Data Product Strategy and Design Lead
description:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Data Product Strategy and Design Lead.**

**In this role, you will:**

* The jobholder is responsible to collaborate and work closely with Data Domain Product Owners to develop the product strategy for each data domain, with the objective of providing a consistent and efficient data service to our data consumers.
* Apply a cross-domain lens to the product strategy to identify opportunities for co-design, re-utilisation of existing IT services, and efficient implementation.
* Establish, define and enforce robust design principles, based on a clear understanding of the data consumers’ needs and priorities, while overlaying their own vision of a coherent and practical service model.
* Partner and work closely with Domain-aligned product owners to produce high-quality design proposals and provide robust challenge on the proposed designs.
* Lead and drive the development of business microservices, deployed via APIs, that enable services to be self-contained by implementing a single business capability within a clearly defined business purpose.
* Maintain and continuously enhance business services blueprint and micro-service catalogue.
* Define a set standardised documentation in support of new design proposals and produce summarised Design Authority submissions.
* Proactively engage and collaborate with Data Domain leads and Consumers to ensure full alignment of objectives and priorities and foster strong working relationships based on mutual trust and support.
* Contribute to ensure the Data Product team is seen as a thought leader for the design of effective data services, and as delivering tangible improvements for the MSS business.

**To be successful you will:**

* Deep understanding of reference and market data processes and architecture; Strong knowledge of the data needs in a corporate and institutional banking environment; Understanding of front-to-back system and data architecture, as well as the various data domains supporting the MSS business.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of the external environment – regulatory, political, industry, innovation etc; Proven strategic thinker with subject matter expertise - demonstrates an understanding of market trends and innovations; Have excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to communicate effectively and confidently at all levels.
* Demonstrate a strong ‘can do’ attitude, high level of motivation to solve difficult problems, meet aggressive deadlines and targets; Well-developed planning and time management skills to progress multiple initiatives in parallel.
* Be tenacious in approach with the ability to challenge the norm / present viable alternative approaches; Have a high level of drive and intrinsic motivation to ensure successful delivery of initiatives; Business process analysis using swim lane techniques ideally with a recognised CASE tool
* Conceptual and Logical data modelling; Functional / Technical story writing; API analysis and design; Artificial Intelligence analysis and design experience (Semantic modelling, Meta Data design, Knowledge graph experience).
* Minimum 10 years of management experience in managing teams & stakeholders; Excellent communication - Both verbal and written; Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to manage relationship with senior stakeholders across different geographies
* Ability to negotiate and collaborate in order to meet organizational goals; Ability to take difficult decisions in a complex operational environment; Strong business and commercial orientation.
* Good presentation skills, Strong analytical skills with a problem-solving capability & drive solutions; Very good prioritizing, planning and organizing skills; Proven experience in product management and problem-solving; Strong orientation on risk management.
* Ability to manage resources to continually improve service and enable productivity gains; Ability to quickly, understand the process and add value to the business; Experience of working in a data function interfacing with Global Markets and/or Global Banking systems and processes will be useful, though not critical.
* Candidate should be a graduate; Proven Client Service Experience & Stakeholder Management; Exposure to Global Markets products; Ability to work on complex queries to resolve issues .
* Experienced in Risk and Operations Management; Ability to interpret complex changes in regulatory guidelines and assess impact; Ability to plan and manage multiple tasks with competing deadlines ; Should be effective in guidance and stakeholder management.
* Experience of managing crisis situations and take appropriate /timely decision ; Ability to work under pressure ;Self-motivated and ability to inspire others; Ability to work independently and a flexible approach to working hours and responsibilities; Good understanding of regulatory requirements and Global Standards; Ability to interpret complex data.

title: Global AI Solution Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

**Mission of the Role**

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

**Work model:** #LI Hybrid **Area:** This role contributes to AU IS in AU.

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

title: Senior AI/ML Trainer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate Senior Technical Trainer with good hands-on to join our expert team. Candidate will drive knowledge adoption across customers, partners, and internal teams delivering high-impact training in AI/ML, Deep Learning, and the rapidly evolving Generative AI & Agentic AI landscape.**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct engaging in-person and virtual training sessions across a range of learner profiles
* Deliver workshops and bootcamps on AI/ML, Deep Learning, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI systems and LLMOps.
* Design and develop training materials, including slide decks, hands-on labs, demo notebooks, video walkthroughs, and assessments aligned towards current industry trends and customer needs.
* Build modular, reusable learning content covering GenAI application development, RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and multi-agent orchestration, LLMOps.
* Integrate real-world use cases and project-based learning into every module, ensuring practical applicability.
* Work closely with internal and external Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to draft training proposals and curate content aligned with enterprise skilling goals.
* Train and mentor internal trainers and partner faculty to scale delivery across regions and formats.

**Requirements (Must- have):**

* ML and Deep learning frameworks: Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras
* Neural network architectures: CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers
* ML workflows: data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and optimization
* Working knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs): GPT, Llama, Mistral, Gemini, Claude, etc.
* Prompt Engineering: zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and advanced prompting patterns
* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate), embedding models, chunking strategies
* LLM Fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF

Agentic AI & Frameworks:

* Building and teaching AI Agents — tool use, memory, planning, and reasoning loops
* Hands-on familiarity with at least two or more Agentic AI frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen (Microsoft), OpenAI Agents SDK or Anthropic Claude SDK
* Hands-on knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, and function calling patterns
* Hands-on knowledge of Multi-Agent system design and its nuances and LLMOps

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in AI/ML model development, GenAI application building, or data science workflows
* Proven track record of delivering technical training, workshops, or bootcamps especially in AI/ML or GenAI domains
* Experience with cloud-based AI/ML platforms (AWS Sagemaker, Azure AI Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, etc.) is highly recommended.
* Having any of professional cloud certifications is a plus
* Prior experience developing content for professional certifications or enterprise skilling programs is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong facilitation skills - comfortable engaging beginners as well as seasoned engineers in the same session
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for real-world applicability

**Good to have:**

* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or public learning resources (blogs, notebooks, talks)
* Experience with AI governance, responsible AI practices, or bias/safety considerations in LLMs
* Active community presence (LinkedIn, Hugging Face, GitHub, etc.)

Pay: ₹665,000.00 - ₹1,940,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Firefly FDE
description:
The Opportunity
  
Join our “DevOps for Content” revolution, where we partner with global brands and agencies to transform their end-to-end creative workflows—from ideation through activation—to unlock the GenAI-powered Content Supply Chain.
  
As a Manager, Forward Deployed AI Engineering, you will lead, mentor, and inspire a team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers (FDEs)—creative technologists who prototype, build, and launch GenAI-powered solutions and products directly with customers. Your mission is to cultivate top engineering talent, instill a culture of rapid innovation and delivery excellence, and ensure every engagement drives measurable business impact.
  
This role requires strong, hands-on technical leadership, people mentorship, and the ability to scale GenAI adoption in enterprise environments. You’ll partner closely with the Director, Forward Deployed AI Engineering, to build a world-class product engineering org with customer-facing DNA. If you thrive on growing talent, scaling engineering excellence, and translating latest AI research into real-world solutions, this is your stage. What You’ll Do Team Leadership
  

* Recruit, coach, and empower a high-performing team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers (and select Forward Deployed AI Architects).
* Act as both mentor and peer-level engineer—reviewing code, shaping architectures, and guiding engineers on technical depth, delivery velocity, and customer impact.
* Cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, experimentation, and AI tinkering, ensuring the team stays at the frontier of generative AI and enterprise delivery.
* Develop future leaders by strengthening technical judgment, customer-facing confidence, and multi-functional influence. Customer Engagement & Technical Delivery
* Sponsor and engage directly in strategic customer programs. Roll up your sleeves to build, prototype, and launch solutions and products with your engineers when customer concerns or critical achievements arise.
* Ensure your teams apply Forward Deployed Engineering principles: embedded collaboration, rapid prototyping, iterative feedback, and production-grade handoffs.
* Serve as the point of contact for technical and delivery challenges, balancing innovation with governance, reliability, and scale when addressing blocking issues.
* Champion delivery excellence—every engagement must tie back to measurable value realization and customer adoption. Technical Leadership & Standards
* Define and enforce engineering standards across pods, including CI/CD pipelines, reusable frameworks, architecture playbooks, and model governance practices.
* Partner with Directors of Forward Deployed Engineering and Architecture to align technical approaches across the org and codify patterns into scalable, reusable assets.
* Funnel field-proven innovations and standards into Adobe Firefly and GenStudio roadmaps—ensuring product strategy is shaped by customer reality. Thought Leadership & Cross-Team Enablement
* Stay at the forefront of generative AI, creative automation, and enterprise integration—keeping your teams current and inspired.
* Foster internal knowledge sharing—publishing playbooks, reusable modules, and lessons learned that accelerate the entire organization.
* Represent your team in customer workshops, internal reviews, and external forums, showcasing the engineering craft and thought leadership of the FDE org. What You Bring

* GenAI Mastery – Direct experience with modern AI technologies, including LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Llama, Mistral), diffusion models (Firefly, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E), RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
* Adobe Platform Fluency – Strong working knowledge of Adobe Firefly APIs, Creative Cloud SDKs, GenStudio for Performance Marketing, and enterprise integration patterns.
* DevOps & Delivery Excellence – Expertise in cloud deployments (AWS, Azure), CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and enterprise-grade delivery with governance, security, and monitoring.
* Customer-Facing Leadership – Track record of engaging directly with enterprise customers, simplifying technical complexity, and earning trust as both an engineer and a strategic partner.
* Culture Builder – Ability to cultivate a high-performance, customer-obsessed culture grounded in engineering excellence, continuous learning, and open collaboration.
* Startup DNA – Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; relentless about finding faster, better, more innovative ways to deliver impact for customers and scale patterns across the org.
* Flexibility & Presence – Adaptable and energized by balancing hands-on engineering with people leadership. Willingness to travel up to 30% to support customers and teams in person.

title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
* Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
* Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:**

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
* Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:**

* **Hunt for high-value AI opportunities** within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
* **Develop deep domain pattern recognition** so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:**

* **Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

  

**Engineering Partnership & Enablement**

* **Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain.** Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end.** Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
* **Surface re-use and platform leverage** when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
* **Design the human–digital split.** Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Communication**

* **Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders.** Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

**Measurement, Learning & Iteration**

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Machine Learning Engineer / Researcher (IR-556)
description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe. We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net

Our client is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and diverse industries through data-driven strategies, cutting-edge analytics, and advanced AI solutions. This role sits within a focused research initiative dedicated to adapting small language models (SLMs) to specialized, high-value domain applications.

 **Requirements**  

* Experience: 3+ years in Machine Learning Engineering or Applied ML, with hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models.
* Core Tech Stack: Advanced Python and PyTorch proficiency.
* Frameworks & Ecosystem: Deep fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem, including Transformers, PEFT, Datasets, Accelerate, and TRL.
* Fine-Tuning Expertise: Practical command of SFT with LoRA/QLoRA, alongside the judgment to reason about CPT and RL/preference methods.
* Model Selection: Strong understanding of base model architectures, tokenizer design, pre-training data distributions, licensing, and context window requirements.
* Data Engineering for ML: Proven experience building training pipelines (curation, cleaning, synthetic data generation, and formatting).
* Evaluation & Serving: Ability to design executable correctness evaluations, paired with hands-on experience serving and quantizing models using at least one modern inference framework.
* Research Fluency: Comfort reading recent ML research papers and translating state-of-the-art methods into working code.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Continued Pre-Training (CPT) on large domain corpora.
* Experience with Reinforcement Learning / preference optimization for LLMs (reward modeling, DPO, GRPO, or verifiable-reward setups).
* Experience with structured-output generation, code generation (e.g., SQL/DDL), or domain classification fine-tuning.
* Familiarity with distributed training frameworks (DeepSpeed, FSDP).
* Knowledge distillation experience transferring capabilities from large teacher models to small student models.
* Experience with on-device or edge deployment.
* Active open-source contributions to machine learning tooling, libraries, or published models.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own the Model Adaptation Lifecycle: Drive end-to-end adaptation of SLMs to specialized domain tasks, choosing the right base models, training strategies, and architectures.
* Apply Efficient Fine-Tuning: Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods with a mathematically grounded understanding of low-rank adaptation (LoRA, QLoRA, rank selection, parameterization, scaling, and accuracy–efficiency trade-offs).
* Select Strategy per Task: Determine and sequence optimal adaptation strategies - including Continued Pre-Training (CPT), Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and RL/preference tuning (DPO, GRPO, RLHF).
* Curate & Synthesize Data: Clean, curate, format, and generate high-quality datasets, including synthetic data generation when domain data is scarce.
* Design Functional Evaluations: Build task-specific benchmarks grounded in functional, executable correctness rather than loss curves or perplexity alone, maintaining regression tracking across versions.
* Leverage Knowledge Transfer: Use larger models as teachers to transfer capabilities to SLMs via distillation, structured pruning, and quantization.
* Deploy & Optimize Serving: Stand up and optimize inference infrastructure across GPU, CPU, and edge targets using frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, or TensorRT-LLM.
* Pipeline Reproducibility & Research Execution: Break target tasks into milestones with clear criteria, maintaining reproducible pipelines with data/config versioning, checkpointing, and experiment tracking.
* Translate recent literature into reproducible experiments.

  
**Benefits**  

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

title: Dist Engr-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are seeking a visionary **Distinguished Engineer, AI Science** to lead the technical strategy, research, and development of our next-generation AI architecture focused on Customer Base Management (CVM). As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be the foremost technical authority in the organization, driving the evolution from traditional machine learning to advanced Agentic, Predictive, and Prescriptive AI systems.

You will design autonomous, AI-driven engines that maximize the lifetime value of our customer base, architecting systems that not only predict customer behavior but prescribe dynamic, real-time interventions and execute them autonomously via multi-agent frameworks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Visionary Technical Leadership & AI Strategy**

* Serve as the chief technical architect and visionary for all AI science initiatives related to Base Management, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), churn mitigation, and cross-sell/upsell monetization.
* Define the multi-year roadmap for integrating Agentic AI (autonomous agents, LLM-driven decision engines) into our core base management platforms.
* Bridge the gap between foundational AI research and enterprise-scale commercial impact, advising C-level executives on AI investments and technology bets.

**2. Advanced AI Modeling & Agentic Architecture**

* **Agentic AI:** Architect multi-agent systems and LLM-backed autonomous pipelines capable of executing complex customer lifecycle interventions without human-in-the-loop dependencies.
* **Predictive AI:** Oversee the development of state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence modeling, probabilistic models) for extreme-accuracy forecasting of churn, propensity, and customer lifecycle events.
* **Prescriptive AI:** Design large-scale optimization and reinforcement learning (RL) engines that determine the "Next Best Action" (NBA), Next Best Offer (NBO), and dynamic pricing strategies in real-time.
* Pioneer the use of Generative AI for hyper-personalized base communication, ensuring safety, compliance, and brand alignment within agentic workflows.

**3. Base Management Innovation**

* Transform traditional Customer Value Management (CVM) into a continuous, real-time, AI-native discipline.
* Develop scalable algorithms for causal inference and uplift modeling to ensure AI interventions generate true incremental value (A/B testing at scale).
* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deploy AI solutions that fundamentally alter the economics of customer retention and growth.

**4. Mentorship & Eminence**

* Act as a technical mentor and sponsor for Principal Scientists, Senior Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Scientists across the organization.
* Drive a culture of engineering and scientific excellence, establishing rigorous standards for model validation, MLOps, AI safety, and ethical AI.
* Represent the company in the broader AI community through conference presentations, whitepapers, open-source contributions, and patent filings.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a closely related highly quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 12+ years of applied R&D experience in AI/ML, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role (Principal Engineer, Chief Scientist, or equivalent).
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of Base Management, Customer Value Management (CVM), algorithmic marketing, and lifecycle optimization.
* **Technical Mastery:**Expertise in **Predictive AI** (Deep Learning, NLP, Time-Series forecasting, Graph Neural Networks).Expertise in **Prescriptive AI** (Reinforcement Learning, Contextual Bandits, Mathematical Optimization, Operations Research).Cutting-edge knowledge of **Agentic AI** (LLMs, LangChain/LlamaIndex, multi-agent frameworks like AutoGen, tool-augmented language models).
* **Engineering Prowess:** Proven track record of architecting and deploying ultra-low latency, high-throughput AI systems into production. Fluency in Python, C++, or similar, and deep familiarity with scalable cloud architectures (AWS/GCP/Azure) and MLOps platforms.
* **Impact:** Demonstrable history of driving hundreds of millions of dollars in enterprise value through the application of AI to customer bases.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Recognized industry eminence (e.g., highly cited publications at NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, ACL, or strong portfolio of impactful patents).
* Experience transitioning legacy rule-based business logic systems into fully autonomous RL or Agentic AI decision engines.
* Deep expertise in Causal ML and Double Machine Learning for uplift modeling.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
