title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

**Mission of the Role**

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a **hands-on AI/ML Engineer** to join our **Information Systems (IS)**.

This is a **specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.

If you have experience with **Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!

**Work model:** Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from **SAP and Salesforce** to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from **Snowflake** and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including **Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions**.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, **cost monitoring, root-cause analysis**, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**

**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with **Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry**: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with **Snowflake AI/ML tools** (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating **SAP and Salesforce** data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
* Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects.
* A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture.
* Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!
  
  
We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to:
  
  
Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue
  
Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations
  
Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions
  
Use and evolve best-in-breed technology
  
Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)
  
Develop a career path in new and relevant ways
  
Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Development Engineer (P3) at Zillow, you are a key contributor to your team’s success. You independently deliver non-trivial features and improvements, design solutions to well-scoped problems, and help teammates succeed. You are respected for the quality of your work and your thoughtful participation in team discussions. This role is about mastering your craft, deepening your technical impact, and building the foundation for future growth. In this role you will:

  

* Work on revenue-generating features that make a real impact on the business, while growing your technical expertise.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Be trusted to take ownership of meaningful projects, contribute to system design discussions, and strengthen the reliability and performance of our advertising platforms.
* Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors).
* Ship experiments safely through A/B trial platforms with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions.
* Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases.
* Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing and onboarding.
* Continuously learn: seek feedback, and deepen your knowledge of ad technology, front-end performance, and distributed systems

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years designing, coding, and debugging production web applications and backend services.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end development with React and TypeScript; experience with micro-frontend architectures, server-side rendering, and web performance optimization.
* Solid backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).
* Experience with AWS and container/Kubernetes-based platforms, CI/CD (GitLab or similar), and observability tooling such as Datadog.
* Rigorous about quality: unit and integration testing (Jest, Playwright or equivalent), code review, monitoring.

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) builds high-performance GPU platforms for demanding AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads. We are seeking a Senior Software Development engineer to join the Raw Metal Cloud (RMC) team and help deliver reliable, scalable AI infrastructure.

RMC builds the software platform that manages the AI infrastructure lifecycle, from hardware onboarding and inventory through networking, provisioning, validation, rack certification, and customer handoff. Our work connects physical infrastructure with distributed orchestration services, enabling GPU capacity to become ready for customer workloads efficiently and reliably.

As an IC4 engineer on the RMC team, you will own the design, development, and operate telemetry services supporting data center telemetry, device management, and hardware lifecycle automation. You will build reliable software that provides visibility into power, thermal, cooling, and device health conditions, helping teams detect issues and improve infrastructure readiness. Your work will help reduce manual intervention, improve infrastructure readiness, and increase the speed and predictability of GPU capacity delivery.

As an IC4 engineer, you will independently own defined service components from design through production, collaborate with senior engineers on technical decisions, and deliver secure, scalable solutions supporting data center deployments.

We value clear technical judgment, simple designs, ownership, and collaboration. You will have the opportunity to influence RMC’s technical direction, mentor engineers, and build software with a direct impact on OCI’s AI infrastructure.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop backend services and APIs for collecting, processing, and publishing telemetry from ILOM, Powershelf, PSU, PQM, BMS and related infrastructure devices.
* Build reliable telemetry integrations with monitoring platforms and storage services, including Poseidon.
* Develop device initialization, configuration, certificate provisioning, and certificate rotation workflows.
* Implement device health monitoring and automate device repair workflows.
* Build operational tools, dashboards, and alarms to improve troubleshooting and reduce manual effort.
* Improve service scalability, availability, and performance through load testing, failure handling, and performance tuning.
* Write automated unit and integration tests, review code, and maintain technical documentation and runbooks.
* Troubleshoot production issues and collaborate with infrastructure, security, hardware, and operations teams.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining production software, with ownership of service components from design through deployment.
* Strong programming skills in Java, python or a comparable backend language.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, concurrency, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience developing REST APIs, integrating services, and handling asynchronous data processing.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query optimization.
* Familiarity with Linux, networking fundamentals, TLS, and certificate-based authentication.
* Experience with automated testing, Git, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting using logs and metrics.
* Ability to translate requirements into maintainable solutions and communicate effectively across global teams.
* Experience designing for fault tolerance, concurrency, state management, and recovery in distributed environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives from requirements and architecture through production delivery.
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and across organizational boundaries.
* A record of technical ownership, sound engineering judgment, and mentoring other engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with OCI or another cloud platform, object storage, and infrastructure automation.
* Familiarity with telemetry pipelines, monitoring systems, time-series data, and alerting.
* Experience with hardware management interfaces or protocols such as ILOM, Redfish, gNMI, or MQTT.
* Knowledge of PKI, mutual TLS, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Experience building React and TypeScript interfaces for operational tools.
* Exposure to data center power systems, cooling infrastructure, or hardware repair automation.

**About Eigenstate AI**

Eigenstate AI is building a vision-native Industrial Intelligence platform for manufacturing. We use computer vision, video analytics and edge AI to help factories understand production activity, throughput, utilization, process adherence and operational losses. The role involves practical work on real shop-floor video data and customer pilots.

**Role purpose**

Build, test, fine-tune and integrate computer vision capabilities under the guidance of the technical lead. This is an individual-contributor engineering role, not a people-management or independent platform-architecture role.

**Key responsibilities**

· Implement computer vision features for object/person detection, tracking, segmentation, activity recognition and event counting.

· Evaluate and fine-tune open-source models (for example YOLO-family architectures) for industrial video use cases.

· Develop Python/OpenCV preprocessing, inference, post-processing and temporal event logic for production cycles and operator states.

· Prepare and curate datasets; coordinate annotation guidelines, train/validation splits and model experiments.

· Test model predictions against manually verified ground truth; calculate precision, recall, counting error and event-level accuracy.

· Investigate false positives, missed events, occlusion, camera-angle limitations and lighting changes; document root causes and fixes.

· Support RTSP/video ingestion, GPU inference, Linux deployment and integration with application APIs under team guidance.

· Write maintainable, modular, version-controlled code, tests and technical documentation.

· Contribute reusable algorithms, labeled datasets, evaluation tools and domain-specific logic to Eigenstate’s proprietary IP, respecting open-source licenses.

· Collaborate with QA, annotation, application engineers and software developers to deliver pilot milestones.

Essential skills

· Hands-on working experience with C++ and a strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP/OOPS) concepts.

title: AI/ML Engineer (Data Engineering + AI Focus)
description:
Data AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Engineering involves the use of algorithms and statistical models to enable systems to analyze data, learn patterns, and make data-driven predictions or decisions without explicit human programming. AI/ML applications leverage vast amounts of data to identify insights, automate processes, and solve complex problems across a wide range of fields, including healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and more. AI/ML processes transform raw data into actionable intelligence, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent solutions. Data AI/ML combines advanced statistical modeling, computational power, and data engineering to build intelligent systems that can learn, adapt, and automate decisions.

AI/ML Engineer (Data Engineering + AI Focus)

A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains.
  
  
Today, we have more than 180 nationalities represented in our workforce across 131 Countries and this mean, we have elevated level of responsibility to continue to build inclusive workforce that is truly representative of our customers and their customers and our vendor partners too.
  
  
The Brief

In this role as an AI/ML Engineer within the Global Data & Analytics (GDA) team, you will build and scale data-intensive AI/ML solutions that power intelligent decision-making across Maersk’s supply chain ecosystem.

This role combines strong data engineering foundations with applied AI/ML expertise, enabling the development of robust data pipelines, scalable ML systems, and production-grade AI applications.

You will work on designing reliable data platforms, enabling high-quality data availability, and embedding advanced analytics and AI capabilities into business workflows.

Key Responsibilities:

* Partner with business, product, and engineering teams to define scalable data and AI/ML solutions aligned with measurable business outcomes.

* Architect and optimize large-scale data processing systems on cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and manage MLOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, and automated retraining.
* Work with LLMs and Generative AI systems, integrating them into production workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
* Design and maintain data models (batch and streaming) that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and observability across pipelines and ML systems.
* Optimize infrastructure and workloads for cost, scalability, and performance, including efficient use of compute and storage.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy solutions using containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews and best practices.

We are looking for:

* 7+ years of experience across Data Engineering and AI/ML engineering in production environments.
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with hands-on expertise in Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing.
* Deep experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), including services for data engineering, ML, and distributed systems (e.g., Databricks, Synapse, EMR, S3, ADF, etc.).

CORE SKILLS Programming: Writing code to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data, often using languages like Python, R, and SQL. Proficiency Level: Proficient AI & Machine Learning: Creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Using Machine learning (ML), a subset of AI that uses algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data Proficiency Level: Proficient Data Analysis: Inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information, draw conclusions, and support decision-making Proficiency Level: Foundational Machine Learning Pipelines: Using automated workflows that manage the end-to-end process of training and deploying machine learning models. Proficiency Level: Proficient Model Deployment: Making a trained machine learning model available for use in production environments. Proficiency Level: Proficient SPECIALIZED SKILLS Big Data Technologies: Using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the process of software development, including building, testing, and deploying code Natural Language Processing (NLP): Focusing on the interaction between computers and humans through natural language. Data Architecture: Designing and structuring of data systems, ensuring that data is stored, managed, and utilized efficiently Data Processing Frameworks: Using tools and libraries to process large data sets efficiently, such as Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark. Technical Documentation: Creating and maintaining documentation that explains the functionality, use, and maintenance of software or systems. Deep Learning: Using a subset of machine learning involving neural networks with many layers, used to model complex patterns in data. Statistical Analysis: Collecting and analyzing data to identify patterns and trends, and to make informed decisions. Data Engineering: Designing and building systems for collecting, storing, and analyzing data at scale. Definition of Proficiency Levels: Foundational: This is the entry level of the skill, typically expected when starting a new role or working with the skill for the first time. You rely on strong manager support, coaching, and training as you build the capability to progress to higher proficiency levels. Proficient: This is the level at which you are considered effective in the skill. You demonstrate more than just functional competence—you begin to have a noticeable impact in your role by applying the skill consistently and meaningfully. You require only minimal support, coaching, or training to apply the skill successfully. Advanced: This is the level where you move beyond meeting expectations to actively leading, influencing, and delivering considerable impact across the wider business. You are seen as a role model, demonstrate the skill independently, and require little to no manager support.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Photos
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Detection Engineer – Early Career**
=====================================

  
  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Digital Sol/Serv Line Sr Manager
description:
**Title:** Technical Solutions Architect
  
  
**Practice:** AI Contact Center Transformation
  
**Focus:** Technical Architecture, Platform Engineering, Integration Design (Presales Early Delivery)
  
  
ROLE SUMMARY
  
  
The Technical Solutions Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing, validating, and architecting AI-powered contact center solutions that are scalable, secure, and operationally sound. You translate business requirements into detailed technical blueprints, working closely with presales teams, Solution Consultants, and client IT/engineering stakeholders to ensure solutions are feasible, performant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Your primary focus is on the technical design and integration strategy—ensuring that AI agents, CCaaS platforms, CRM systems, and enterprise data layers work together seamlessly. You will lead technical discovery, design solution architectures, validate integrations, and provide the engineering guardrails that enable successful delivery by POD teams.
  
  
You ensure that what we sell can actually be built—and built well.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
1. Technical Discovery Infrastructure Assessment
  

* Lead technical discovery sessions with client IT, telephony, and infrastructure teams to assess current environment and readiness.
* Evaluate existing CCaaS platforms (Genesys Cloud/Engage, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Twilio, etc.) for AI agent integration capabilities.
* Assess CRM such as ServiceNow/MS Dynamics/Salesforce, knowledge base, and backend system APIs for data accessibility, and integration feasibility.
* Analyze telephony infrastructure (SIP trunking, IVR legacy systems, call routing) and identify migration or integration requirements.
* Identify technical risks, constraints, and dependencies (network latency, API rate limits, data compliance, PII/PCI requirements).

2. AI Agent CCaaS Platform Architecture Design
  

* Design end-to-end technical architectures for AI agent deployments, including conversational AI platforms, LLM orchestration, knowledge retrieval (RAG), and real-time integrations.
* Define integration patterns between AI agent platforms and CCaaS environments.
* Architect omnichannel solutions spanning voice, chat, SMS, and digital channels with consistent agent behavior and context management.
* Design call flow logic, escalation routing, fallback strategies, and human-in-the-loop handoff mechanisms.
* Define data flow diagrams, API contracts, authentication/authorization schemes (OAuth, API keys, SSO), and middleware requirements.

3. Integration Data Architecture
  

* Design integration architecture for connecting AI agents to backend systems: CRMs, ERPs, billing systems, knowledge bases, and ticketing platforms.
* Define data schemas, payload structures, and real-time vs. batch integration strategies.
* Architect secure data handling for PII, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR-compliant environments, including data masking, encryption, and audit logging.

4. Platform Selection Technical Validation
  

* Conduct technical proof-of-concepts (POCs) and feasibility studies to validate platform capabilities, integration complexity, and performance benchmarks.
* Assess CCaaS native AI capabilities vs. third-party AI agent platforms to determine optimal architecture.
* Define build vs. buy strategies for conversational components, analytics, and quality management tools.

5. Presales Technical Enablement RFP Response
  

* Partner with Solution Consultants during presales to provide technical depth, validate feasibility, and design proposed architectures.
* Lead technical portions of client presentations, solution demos, and architecture review sessions.
* Author technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs, including architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and infrastructure requirements.
* Articulate technical differentiators, platform advantages, and engineering best practices to client technical stakeholders.
* Defend solution designs against client technical objections and provide alternative approaches when needed.

6. SOW Scoping Engineering Handoff
  

* Define detailed technical scope for Statements of Work (SOWs), including integration points, data requirements, infrastructure dependencies, and deliverables.
* Specify technical assumptions, constraints, and exclusions to protect delivery feasibility and margins.
* Create engineering handoff documentation: architecture diagrams, integration specs, API documentation, and technical requirements.
* Conduct transition sessions with Delivery PODs to ensure technical intent, design rationale, and risk mitigation strategies are clearly understood.
* Participate in design reviews and critical milestones (e.g., technical design approval, integration validation, UAT) to ensure delivery aligns with architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Presales, or Platform Engineering, with a focus on contact center or enterprise communication platforms.
* Deep CCaaS Expertise: Hands-on experience with at least two major CCaaS platforms (Genesys Cloud/Engage, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Twilio Flex, Cisco Webex Contact Center).
* AI Agent Conversational AI Knowledge: Familiarity with AI agent platforms, LLM orchestration, NLU/NLP, intent recognition, dialogue management, and knowledge retrieval (RAG).
* Integration Architecture: Proven experience designing RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware , and real-time data integration patterns.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and defend architectural decisions with technical teams.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; understanding of compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AI agent platforms
* Hands-on experience with telephony protocols
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, utilities) with PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR compliance requirements.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect) or CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Five9, NICE).

KEY SUCCESS METRICS
  

* Quality and feasibility of technical architectures and integration designs.
* Client technical stakeholder confidence in proposed solution and delivery approach.
* Accuracy of technical scoping in SOWs (minimal scope creep or technical surprises during delivery).
* Successful engineering handoffs with clear, actionable technical documentation.
* Delivery POD velocity and technical alignment with original architecture vision.
* Contribution to won deals through technical credibility and solution differentiation.

title: Vulnerability Management Security Sr. Analyst
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

**Vulnerability Assessment & Scanning**

* Plan, schedule, and execute vulnerability scans across network, endpoint, server, and cloud environments using tools such as Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Perform authenticated and unauthenticated scans, ensuring coverage across all in-scope assets.
* Conduct ad hoc scans following remediation activities to validate closure of identified vulnerabilities.
* Maintain and continuously improve scan coverage, ensuring no asset gaps in the vulnerability programme.

**Analysis & Risk Prioritisation**

* Analyse scan results and assess vulnerabilities based on CVSS scores, exploit availability, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Correlate vulnerability findings with threat intelligence feeds to identify actively exploited vulnerabilities that require expedited remediation.
* Differentiate and prioritise Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity vulnerabilities in line with client SLAs and organisational risk appetite.
* Provide contextual risk analysis beyond automated scoring, considering the environment and compensating controls in place.

**Remediation Management & Follow-up**

* Assign remediation tasks to relevant resolver teams and track progress through to closure.
* Conduct regular follow-up with resolver teams to ensure patch deployment, configuration changes, or compensating controls are applied within agreed timelines.
* Escalate overdue or high-risk items to management and client stakeholders as appropriate.
* Validate remediation completeness through rescan confirmation and update records accordingly.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare and deliver monthly, weekly, and ad hoc vulnerability management reports for client and internal stakeholders, including trend analysis, SLA performance, and risk posture summaries.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date vulnerability records across ticketing and vulnerability management platforms.
* Support governance meetings, monthly business reviews, and audit activities with relevant vulnerability data and evidence.
* Track and report on KPIs such as mean time to remediate (MTTR), vulnerability age, and scan coverage.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for client queries related to vulnerability findings, remediation status, and risk assessment.
* Provide guidance and recommendations to resolver teams and clients on remediation approaches, patch management, and risk acceptance.
* Participate in client calls and governance forums, presenting vulnerability posture and remediation progress clearly and concisely.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain and continuously improve vulnerability management SOPs, playbooks, and process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to automate or streamline scanning, reporting, and remediation tracking workflows.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, CVEs, threat actor activity, and vendor advisories, and communicate relevant intelligence to the team and stakeholders.
* Support tool evaluations, onboarding of new scan targets, and integration of new clients or entities into the vulnerability programme.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

* 4–6 years of experience in cybersecurity with at least 2–3 years focused on vulnerability management.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools — Nessus Professional, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, Defender or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of network protocols, operating systems (Windows, Linux), and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with ITSM and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow for remediation tracking.
* Strong analytical and report-writing skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in a managed security services or client-facing environment is preferred.

title: Specialist - IT - Engineering
description:

We're looking for a Backend Engineer who has built and run production systems at scale. You'll own services end-to-end: design, build, deploy, monitor and be able to address prod issues on priority. We also want someone who treats AI-assisted development as a core part of the modern engineering, and who has a track record of stepping up as a technical leader.

**What Is Expected:**

* Design, build, and operate distributed microservices running on Kubernetes in AWS
* Own services through their full lifecycle: architecture, coding, testing, deployment, on-call, and iteration based on production feedback
* Design and evolve event-driven pipelines using Kafka (or similar streaming systems)
* Work across the AWS stack (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, Lambda, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch, etc.) and make informed trade-offs on cost, scalability, and reliability
* Use AI coding assistants and internal AI tooling to accelerate development, review, and debugging - and help the team adopt them effectively
* Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML capabilities (e.g., LLM-based features, intelligent automation, agentic workflows) where they solve real product or engineering problems
* Drive technical decisions on your team: propose designs, run design reviews, and push back constructively when needed
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions
* Take ownership of incidents - from detection through root-cause analysis and postmortems - and drive follow-through on action items
* Partner with product, SRE/DevOps, and other engineering teams to plan and deliver roadmap work
* Demonstrated ownership: Has driven a project or service from design through production and long-term maintenance
* Has taken point on a production incident - led triage, communicated status, and driven the postmortem/fix

**Required Qualifications**

**Core Engineering**

* 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience
* Strong experience designing and operating microservices architectures in production
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deployments, services, config/secrets management, autoscaling, load balancing, debugging pods/nodes in production)
* Proficiency with Apache Kafka or equivalent (event streaming, partitioning, consumer groups, schema management)
* Strong working knowledge of AWS - RDS, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC/networking basics, and at least one compute/orchestration service (ECS, EKS, or Lambda)
* Solid understanding of relational databases (schema design, indexing, query optimization, migrations) — RDS/Postgres or MySQL preferred
* Proficiency in at least one backend language commonly used (e.g., Java, Go, Python, Node.js)
* Understanding of API design (REST and/or gRPC), authentication/authorization patterns, and API versioning
* Practical experience with observability — structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, Open Telemetry)
* Comfort with asynchronous, event-driven, and eventually-consistent system design
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar)
* Security fundamentals: secrets management, least-privilege IAM, dependency/vulnerability scanning and remediation

**AI Fluency**

* Regular hands-on use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Kiro, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) in real development workflows
* Working understanding of core AI/LLM concepts: prompting, embeddings, RAG, tool use/function calling, and agentic workflows — enough to evaluate where they add value and where they don't
* Judgment about AI tool limitations and knows when to trust AI-generated code vs. when to verify manually, especially around security, correctness, and data handling

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in migrating workloads to Cloud, DB migrations etc
* Experience with service mesh (Istio/Gloo), API gateways, or multi-region/multi-AZ architectures
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps practices in AWS
* Experience with NoSQL stores (DynamoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) alongside RDS
* Experience building or integrating with LLM-based features in production

title: Senior Manager, AI Build, the^delta Prize
description:
**About the Team:**

https://thedelta.org.in/prize/ is a platform to draw talent, capital, and public attention towards the most pressing developmental problems in India. the^delta Prize aims to guide markets where they are needed the most, inducing population-scale solutions and innovations that have disproportionate impact on stagnant livelihood opportunities and ecosystems for underserved segments. We research, design and conduct tech-based scale-up competitions to discover and innovate disruptive solutions, and pull in capital to solve the most complex problems in India, faster.

This role sits within Future Enterprises, the^delta Prize's vertical dedicated to India's MSME sector, and leads day-to-day product and delivery of the AI platform within Samriddhi (AI for MSME prosperity). Samriddhi runs through two approaches: Grand Challenges, and an AI-first platform that connects youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities to career pathways, skilling, apprenticeships and jobs, while helping MSMEs access job-ready talent. The role reports to the Director / Associate Director, AI & Digital Platforms, and works closely with the Senior Managers leading Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem.

**Who are we solving for?**

Youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities, whose access to career guidance, skilling and jobs is limited by language, geography and the thin guidance available to them. The platform also serves MSMEs that find it difficult to articulate their hiring requirements and reach job-ready talent.

**What are we solving for?**

India's youth-to-work transition is fragmented across three points. Skilling remains supply-led while MSME demand for talent goes largely unmet. Career guidance for tier 3–4 youth is thin, rarely personalised, and rarely available in the youth's own language or in a voice-first format. The existing landscape of job and skilling platforms is fragmented, with several credible players serving overlapping segments through incompatible systems, which makes duplication the main design risk.

The platform is designed to address these three points together, and to run on top of existing government-led skilling councils, job and skilling networks and education-employment infrastructure instead of building parallel rails. The ambition is to reach 10–12 million young people over three years.

**Role and Responsibility:**

**What will you do?**

* Own day-to-day product delivery of the AI platform, translating the Director's direction into roadmaps, requirements, sprint priorities and release plans
* Work hands-on with engineering and AI partners: write product requirements, review architecture and technical trade-offs, test builds, and hold partners to agreed timelines and quality
* Lead the design, build and evaluation of the platform's AI features, including LLM-based conversational and recommendation features, retrieval over structured and unstructured data, and multilingual and voice-first interaction, with prompt design, evaluation benchmarks and human-in-the-loop review
* Run structured user research with youth and MSME employers in tier 3–4 cities, and convert the findings into product decisions
* Lead the landscape scan of existing job and skilling platforms across function, technology used, UI/UX design intent and ownership model, and turn it into build, buy, partner or integrate recommendations
* Scope and manage integrations with government and ecosystem digital infrastructure, using open APIs and interoperable data standards
* Define product metrics (adoption, retention, completion, placement outcomes and AI response quality), set up analytics, and report on them regularly
* Establish Responsible AI practices for every AI feature shipped, covering transparency, fairness testing, safety and escalation processes, and data privacy and consent
* Onboard platform partners across technology, skilling, employers and institutions, and maintain those relationships through continuous engagement
* Interface with the Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem teams, and with marketing, analytics, impact and donor relations, on areas critical to the platform's success
* Manage and mentor the Senior Associate on the platform team

*(The actual role might evolve slightly based on your relevant experience and the overlap between organisational requirements and your interests.)*

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

***Core abilities & transferable skills***

* Strong product judgement: ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements and priorities
* Working fluency in AI and LLM systems, enough to make and challenge consequential technical decisions with engineering partners
* Ability to evaluate AI quality in a structured way, including in Indian languages and voice-first settings
* Exceptional stakeholder and relationship management skills across technology partners, government bodies and institutions
* Ability to think in first principles and understand second- and third-order change or impact
* Comfort managing flux and change in a platform that will evolve as it is built
* Bias for action, paired with humility

***Apply if you have:***

* Graduate or postgraduate degree
* 8–12 years of experience in product, technology or platform roles in high-performing set-ups, including direct ownership of at least one shipped digital product used at scale
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation and monitoring of model outputs, and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Working understanding of APIs, data pipelines and platform architecture, sufficient to review technical decisions made by engineering partners
* Experience managing external engineering or AI partners, without relying on a large in-house technology team
* Experience with user research and analytics-led product iteration
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and proficiency in documentation and presentation tools
* Willingness to travel to pilot locations in tier 3–4 geographies
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment
* Comfort with some degree of ambiguity in the absence of perfect information

***Would be great if you have:***

* Experience building multilingual, voice-first or low-bandwidth products for Indian languages
* Experience with DPI/DPGs, open or interoperable platforms, or government digital systems
* Experience in edtech, skilling, jobs, livelihoods or MSME-facing products
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks and practices
* Work experience in a tech start-up
* Prior experience in the social or impact sector
* Interest in developmental economics and India's youth employment and MSME landscape

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals, irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

Requisition #: 343990

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:

* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi

* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
